jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Role Description

As a Distinguished Solution Architect, you will be one of the most senior and experienced solution architecture practitioners within the Solution Engineering organization. You will play a defining role in helping Salesforce's most strategic customers become Agentic Enterprises by designing transformative, enterprise architectures that leverage the full Salesforce Platform, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, and other platform capabilities.
This is not simply an execution role. At the Distinguished level, you are expected to shape architectural strategy, influence Salesforce's product and technology direction, and serve as a recognized authority on enterprise solution architecture both internally and externally. You will work on Salesforce's most complex, high-value customer engagements across industries and business models—from pre-sales through adoption—while leading executive-level architecture conversations with business and technology leaders.
You will be a central member of the Solution Engineering Architecture organization, whose mission is to inspire, architect, prove, and enable customer success. You will model what it means to be a trusted technical advisor, helping organizations realize measurable business outcomes through the Salesforce Platform and AI-powered transformation.

Why This Role?

Modern customer experiences span every stage of the customer lifecycle and increasingly rely on connected data, AI, automation, and digital engagement. These experiences require integrated architectures that leverage the breadth of the Salesforce Platform alongside enterprise applications, data platforms, integration technologies, and partner ecosystems.
As a Distinguished Solution Architect, you will establish enterprise architecture patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that accelerate customer success across the Salesforce ecosystem.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

Strategic Architecture Leadership

  • Define and lead enterprise solution architecture strategy for Salesforce's most strategic and complex customer engagements.
  • Architect end-to-end Agentic Enterprise solutions leveraging Agentforce, Data Cloud, and the broader Salesforce Platform.
  • Design enterprise AI interoperability and scalable architectures across Salesforce and third-party ecosystems.
  • Develop thought leadership on enterprise architecture, AI governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI.
  • Create reusable architecture frameworks, reference architectures, best practices, and implementation patterns used across Solution Engineering.

Customer Engagement

  • Lead executive architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and strategic solution design engagements.
  • Translate complex business challenges into scalable enterprise solution architectures and transformation roadmaps.
  • Build compelling solution proposals that balance immediate business value with long-term architectural strategy.
  • Partner with executive stakeholders to shape technical strategy before active sales cycles begin.
  • Design solutions focused on customer adoption, consumption, business outcomes, and long-term success.
  • Provide architectural governance and implementation guidance for Salesforce Professional Services and partner organizations.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate across Solution Engineering, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and the partner ecosystem.
  • Influence Salesforce product strategy, architecture standards, and technical best practices.
  • Establish architectural governance and technical handoff standards that ensure solution integrity throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Contribute to AI Centers of Excellence, innovation initiatives, and technical strategy programs.

Thought Leadership & Enablement

  • Publish thought leadership on enterprise architecture, AI transformation, Agentforce, Data Cloud, and Salesforce platform strategy.
  • Lead architecture enablement programs, architecture forums, and technical education initiatives.
  • Mentor Solution Architects and Solution Engineers while establishing standards for architectural excellence.
  • Represent Salesforce at executive briefings, conferences, customer events, and industry forums.

Operational Excellence

  • Achieve annual business objectives and strategic customer engagement goals.
  • Maintain accurate architectural documentation and customer engagement records.
  • Continuously expand expertise across Salesforce technologies, AI capabilities, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related technical discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Solution Engineering, Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Technical Consulting, Software Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.
  • Extensive experience designing enterprise solutions for complex business and technology environments.
  • Deep expertise across multiple Salesforce platform capabilities, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, MuleSoft, Slack, Tableau, Platform technologies, and AI capabilities.
  • Experience designing scalable enterprise solutions across public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.

Technical Knowledge

  • Knowledge of enterprise applications, relational databases, ERP technologies, APIs, integration patterns, middleware, event-driven architectures, and modern enterprise application design.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise AI architecture, autonomous agents, AI governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI.
  • Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, Master Data Management, analytics, data governance, and AI-ready data strategies.

Communication & Leadership

  • Strong oral, written, presentation, collaboration, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive and technical audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams to solve complex technical problems in diverse and dynamic organizational environments.
  • Experience influencing executive stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, business executives, and enterprise architects.
  • Demonstrated organizational impact through reusable architecture assets, frameworks, standards, or thought leadership adopted beyond an immediate team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce certifications across one or more product domains.
  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or progress toward advanced Architect certifications.
  • Previous experience as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent customer-facing technical leadership role.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications, analytics platforms, collaboration tools, and partner technologies.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent methodologies.
  • Experience with design thinking, value-based selling, executive consulting, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Software development experience with modern programming languages and enterprise application development.
  • Experience working with AI-powered development tools and modern engineering practices.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. jobs.title: Sales Solutions Architect | Strategic Accounts
jobs.excerpt: What's the role? The HERE Business & Solution Architecture team helps customers achieve their business objectives through the use of HERE products and services.
jobs.description:
What's the role?

The HERE Business & Solution Architecture team helps customers achieve their business objectives through the use of HERE products and services. As a Strategic Accounts Sales Solution Architect, you will work directly with HERE's largest and most complex customers to understand business and technical requirements, design solutions, validate architectures, and help customers successfully adopt HERE technologies.

You will partner closely with Account Executives, Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and customer technical teams throughout the sales cycle. Success in this role requires a strong combination of technical knowledge, customer-facing communication skills, solution design capabilities, and the ability to navigate complex customer environments.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex customer problems, is comfortable operating in ambiguous situations, and approaches customer engagements with curiosity and a partnership mindset. Successful candidates are energized by learning new domains, asking thoughtful questions, and working collaboratively with customers to define the best path forward when requirements, solutions, or outcomes are not always clearly defined.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Technical Discovery

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and collaborative partner during customer engagements, helping customers navigate technical decisions, explore options, and evaluate tradeoffs.
  • Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customer business objectives, solution requirements, operational workflows, and success criteria.
  • Demonstrate curiosity by asking thoughtful questions, challenging assumptions, and helping customers clarify needs that may not yet be fully defined.
  • Identify technical challenges, integration requirements, risks, and dependencies that may impact solution design or delivery.
  • Document customer requirements and translate them into actionable technical recommendations.
  • Collaborate with account teams to understand customer goals and define solutions that address business and technical objectives.

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures using HERE APIs, SDKs, platform services, map content, and partner technologies.
  • Create and present architecture diagrams, technical workflows, integration approaches, and solution recommendations.
  • Evaluate multiple solution options and provide guidance on technical tradeoffs and best practices.
  • Support customer architecture reviews and technical decision-making activities.
  • Define implementation assumptions, dependencies, scalability considerations, and operational requirements.
  • Work with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to validate solution feasibility and identify the best path forward for customer use cases.

Technical Validation & Demonstrations

  • Lead product demonstrations, technical workshops, evaluations, and proof-of-concept activities.
  • Develop validation plans that establish clear objectives, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.
  • Work hands-on with customer teams to validate proposed solutions and demonstrate HERE capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues during evaluations and coordinate with internal teams to resolve blockers.
  • Produce customer-facing deliverables including architecture documents, validation results, technical recommendations, and implementation guidance.
  • Help customers make informed technical decisions by clearly communicating options, tradeoffs, assumptions, and risks.

Strategic Account Support

  • Support strategic account teams by partnering with customers to understand their business challenges, explore solution options, validate approaches, and make informed technical decisions.
  • Contribute technical insights to account planning activities and customer roadmap discussions.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to ensure proposed solutions align with customer goals, business objectives, and technical requirements.
  • Help identify expansion opportunities by understanding customer business priorities and technical needs.
  • Support competitive evaluations by articulating HERE's technical strengths and differentiators.
  • Contribute to technical win strategies by helping customers gain confidence in proposed solutions through discovery, validation, demonstrations, and proof-of-concepts.

Risk Identification & Solution Readiness

  • Identify integration, data, performance, security, and operational risks early in the sales process.
  • Validate assumptions and help customers understand implementation considerations before deployment.
  • Document open technical questions, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Support smooth transitions from presales to implementation through clear technical documentation and handoff materials.
  • Help create clear technical decision paths that reduce uncertainty and enable successful customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Represent customer requirements, feedback, and market insights to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Contribute reusable technical assets such as reference architectures, demo content, technical guides, best practices, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Share lessons learned and technical expertise across the organization.
  • Stay current on HERE products, industry trends, cloud technologies, and competitive solutions.
  • Participate in team initiatives that improve technical readiness, customer engagement, and solution delivery.

Who are you?

You are curious, customer-centric, and enjoy solving complex problems. You are comfortable operating in situations where not all the answers are known upfront and can bring structure and clarity to ambiguous challenges.

You enjoy learning new technologies, understanding customer businesses, and exploring multiple approaches to solving a problem. Rather than immediately jumping to an answer, you ask thoughtful questions, seek to understand the broader context, and work collaboratively with customers to identify the best path forward.

You build relationships based on collaboration and trust, working alongside customers to solve problems rather than simply recommending products. You build credibility by listening, communicating openly, and helping customers make informed technical decisions. Whether leading a workshop, designing a solution, or supporting a proof-of-concept, you are focused on achieving successful outcomes together.

You are equally comfortable engaging with developers, architects, product managers, and business stakeholders and can adapt your communication style to meet the needs of your audience.

You thrive in customer-facing environments where every challenge is different, enjoy working across teams, and are motivated by helping customers solve meaningful business problems.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solution Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Professional Services Consultant, Technical Consultant, or Software Engineer.
  • Experience designing and validating enterprise software solutions.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, web services, cloud technologies, and modern software architectures.
  • Experience leading technical discovery, solution design, evaluations, workshops, or proof-of-concept engagements.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including Sales, Product, Engineering, Services, and Customer Success organizations.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting complex customer engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, GIS, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting strategic, enterprise, or large-account customers.
  • Experience with location technologies, mapping, GIS, routing, navigation, mobility, logistics, retail, transportation, supply chain, or related industries.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience integrating APIs, SDKs, or enterprise platforms into customer applications and workflows.
  • Familiarity with data architectures, system integrations, and modern application development practices.
  • Programming or scripting experience in JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar languages.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, workshops, and customer-facing architecture presentations.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple functions.

Why HERE?

HERE combines global location data, enterprise-grade technology and deep real-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.

The expected base salary range for this position is $121,000 to $173,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower customers to achieve better outcomes, from helping businesses optimize operations and assets to enabling smarter decisions through location intelligence. Our platform powers solutions across transportation, logistics, retail, mobility, technology, and many other industries.

At HERE, we help customers solve complex business challenges through technology, data, and innovation. If you enjoy working with customers, solving difficult problems, and helping shape solutions that have real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

jobs.excerpt: About the Team The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals.
jobs.description:
About the Team
The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.
Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

  • Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
  • Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
  • Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
  • Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead

About the Job
As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
  • Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
  • Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
  • Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
  • Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
  • Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

We are looking for:

  • Strong experience designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
  • Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.

Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

We are looking for a business-first, analytically strong consultant who can work directly with business leaders to understand complex decisions, challenge conventional thinking, and rapidly translate business needs into data- and AI-enabled solutions.

This is not a traditional requirements-gathering role. The consultant will be expected to understand how the business operates, identify the decisions that matter, determine what information and analysis are needed, and rapidly mobilize AI/Agentic tools, data and specialist teams to solve the problem.

The ideal candidate has operated in an environment where they have regularly used data and analysis to support business decisions and is excited about learning and applying emerging AI technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Understand the business and the decision: Engage business stakeholders to understand objectives, economics, processes, constraints and the decisions they are trying to make—not simply document stated requirements.
  • Challenge and structure problems: Ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and convert ambiguous business issues into clear hypotheses, analyses and decision frameworks.
  • Use data to develop insights: Explore and interpret data, conduct rapid analyses, identify patterns and translate findings into business implications and recommendations.
  • Rapidly prototype solutions: Use GenAI, Agentic AI, analytics and low-code/no-code tools to rapidly explore ideas, analyze information and develop working prototypes.
  • Orchestrate expertise: Recognize when deeper expertise is required and effectively leverage data scientists, engineers, domain experts, product teams and AI agents rather than attempting to build everything independently.
  • Drive from insight to action: Communicate findings in simple business language, recommend actions and work with stakeholders to translate recommendations into measurable business outcomes.
  • Continuously learn: Rapidly experiment with emerging AI and technology capabilities and identify where they can materially improve business decision-making.

Requirements

8-10 years of experience in business analytics, strategy/management consulting, commercial analytics, operations, supply chain, finance, marketing/customer analytics, product management or a similar decision-oriented business environment.

The person should demonstrate:

  • Strong business curiosity and problem-solving ability.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Strong analytical orientation and comfort working hands-on with data.
  • Ability to move from business question → hypothesis → analysis → insight → decision/action.
  • Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively rather than simply accepting requirements.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity and solving loosely defined problems.
  • Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills.
  • Working familiarity with analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, BI/visualization tools and/or Python.
  • Strong interest and hands-on aptitude with GenAI, AI agents and emerging productivity/development tools.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly without needing to be a deep software engineer.
  • Ability to bring together business, analytics, technology and specialist teams to deliver solutions rapidly.

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

jobs.excerpt: AHL + Saaf AI — Mortgage Lending, ReimaginedSaaf AI is building the future of mortgage lending by combining cutting-edge AI with proven lending operations.
jobs.description:
AHL + Saaf AI — Mortgage Lending, Reimagined

Saaf AI is building the future of mortgage lending by combining cutting-edge AI with proven lending operations. Saaf AI is part of American Heritage Lending, a top-10 private lender processing billions in loan volume, with 15+ years of growth. We are backed by some of the largest asset managers and funds and are growing fast.

We're not experimenting with AI. We're deploying it. From underwriting to document processing to borrower experience, all are shaped by AI. If you want to work somewhere that uses AI as a core building material — you're in the right place.

The Role

We're hiring a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer to design and ship AI-powered products and agents from end to end. This isn't an ML research role or a prompt-engineering sandbox. It's a hands-on builder role — you own the full arc from "here's a business problem" to "here's a working AI system in production."

Mortgage lending is one of the last industries to be meaningfully transformed by AI. The problems are hard, the data is rich, and the stakes are real. You'll work directly on the things that matter most: automating underwriting decisions, building intelligent borrower-facing experiences, creating agents that navigate complex loan workflows, and using AI to compress tasks that currently take days into minutes.

This role is right for you if:

  • You've shipped AI-powered products or agents to production — not just prototypes

  • You think in systems: LLM calls, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and feedback loops are design primitives to you

  • You move fast and take ownership — you'd rather build the thing than debate the spec

  • You want to be in a market where AI genuinely changes lives, not just optimizes click-through rates

What You'll Build

AI Agents & Autonomous Workflows

Mortgage lending is a process-heavy industry — condition management, document review, borrower communication, underwriting analysis. You'll design and ship agents that automate or accelerate these workflows end to end:

  • Build multi-step LLM agents that can navigate loan files, evaluate conditions, flag exceptions, and surface recommendations to underwriters

  • Design agentic workflows with tool use, structured output, memory, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints — not one-shot prompts

  • Integrate AI agents with internal systems, external data sources, and third-party APIs to close the loop between insight and action

AI-Powered Document & Data Intelligence

Mortgage processing is document-intensive. You'll build the AI layer that makes documents machine-readable and actionable:

  • Extend and improve document extraction pipelines — income documents, appraisals, title, and more — using the latest extraction and classification models

  • Build retrieval-augmented systems that let underwriters and borrowers query complex loan files in natural language

  • Design feedback mechanisms that use reviewer corrections to improve extraction accuracy over time

Borrower & Loan Officer Experience

You'll use AI to make the borrower journey faster, clearer, and less stressful — and give loan officers AI-powered tools that make them dramatically more effective:

  • Build AI-generated task lists and smart checklists that adapt to each borrower's loan scenario

  • Create intelligent routing and prioritization — which loan needs attention now, which borrower is at risk of drop-off, which condition is the blocker

  • Design conversational AI experiences that guide borrowers through complex decisions without requiring a loan officer on every interaction

AI Evaluation & Quality Systems

You'll care about whether the AI actually works — not just whether it runs:

  • Build evaluation frameworks that measure AI output quality against ground truth, not just latency

  • Design human review workflows where AI confidence is low, and use those reviews to create labeled training data

  • Monitor production AI performance — accuracy, coverage, failure modes — and iterate relentlessly

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • AI systems builder: You've shipped LLM-powered features or agents to production. You've dealt with the real problems — latency, hallucination, evaluation, prompt regression, retrieval quality — not just the demos.

  • Strong Python: You write clean, production-quality Python. You're comfortable with async, APIs, data structures, and the engineering discipline that real systems require.

  • LLM tooling fluency: You've worked with the major LLM APIs and at least one agent orchestration framework. You know what structured output, tool calling, RAG, and evals look like in practice.

  • Product thinking: You can go from "here's a business process" to "here's an AI system design" without needing someone to translate. You think about the user, not just the model.

  • Ownership without guardrails: You drive features end to end — requirements, design, implementation, deployment, monitoring. You don't hand off to other teams at the hard parts.

  • Fast iteration: You ship early, measure, and improve. You're energized by short feedback loops and impatient with unnecessary process.

Strong Preferences

  • Experience in fintech, lending, insurance, or another regulated industry

  • Full-stack experience — comfortable building lightweight UIs, APIs, or internal tools when needed

  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS preferred) — you can containerize, deploy, and operate the systems you build

  • Experience with document understanding — OCR, extraction models, structured data from unstructured sources

  • Background in building human-in-the-loop systems — review workflows, feedback capture, and data flywheel design

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with mortgage or real estate data

  • Familiarity with workflow automation tools (n8n or similar)

  • Exposure to fine-tuning or model adaptation for domain-specific tasks

  • Experience building AI products that handle PII and navigate regulatory requirements (FCRA, GLBA)

Why Saaf

Mortgage AI is still wide open. Unlike ad tech or e-commerce, where AI optimization is a rounding error, in mortgage lending an AI system that works changes whether a family gets their home. The problems are complex, the data is rich, and the solutions don't exist yet. You'll build them.

You'll push the limits of what AI agents can actually do. Not summarization. Not chatbots. Real agents navigating real loan files, making real recommendations, running complex multi-step workflows across multiple systems. The kind of AI engineering that makes you a better engineer.

AI-first means AI-first. Every engineer here uses AI to build AI. Claude Code, agentic workflows, AI-assisted code review — we don't add AI to our process, AI is our process. The team you'll join is already operating at the frontier.

Direct impact on a $2 trillion industry. Your work will touch every loan we process. When you make underwriting faster, thousands of borrowers get answers sooner. When you improve document extraction, loan officers spend less time on paperwork and more time helping people.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-first with flexible hours

  • $2,000/year professional development budget

  • Home office setup stipend

Overview:

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Controller to work for a middle-market private equity firm that specializes in investing in founder-led and family-owned businesses across a range of stages, including control (majority ownership) and non-control investments in businesses. You will work with their portfolio companies that typically have a $5-$40 million target revenue and $1-$4 million target EBITDA. These portfolio companies span across sectors such as business services, consumer products, healthcare, niche manufacturing, and value-added distribution.

You will step into newly acquired businesses and help quickly build, stabilize, and improve their accounting functions. This is not a traditional Controller role. You will work across multiple businesses and industries, typically joining a company around the time of an acquisition and serving as the interim Controller for approximately 90 days. Your focus will be to create a reliable accounting foundation, improve processes and systems, address technical accounting issues, and successfully transition the function to a permanent Controller.

This role provides the opportunity to work across a variety of businesses and industries rather than remaining in one company long term. You will have the chance to make an immediate impact, solve meaningful problems, build stronger accounting foundations, and move on to new challenges. It can also provide significant exposure to operating leadership and potential opportunities for continued growth into broader finance and operational roles. This is a highly hands-on role where you should be willing to roll up your sleeves. You will be creating structure and process in ambiguous or fast-changing environments. You should be comfortable walking into unfamiliar situations and quickly determining what needs to be done. If you enjoy variety, thrive in fast-paced environments, and like solving problems, building structure, and making an immediate impact, this could be a great opportunity.

Responsibilities:

  • You will take a hands-on approach to stabilizing and managing the accounting function during a critical period of transition.
  • Step into an interim Controller role before or immediately following an acquisition.
  • Assess the current accounting environment, systems, processes, controls, and team capabilities.
  • Take ownership of the general ledger, month-end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, and supporting schedules.
  • Identify and resolve historical accounting, reporting, and classification issues.

  • After a successful transition, you will move on to support the next business or acquisition.

  • Strong hands-on experience with general ledger management, month-end close, reconciliations, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Experience stabilizing or improving accounting functions in growing, changing, or underdeveloped environments.

Position Overview: We are seeking an experienced Technical Analyst to support the delivery of a complex Field Service Management (FSM) platform implementation for a utilities client. This role bridges business requirements and technical execution — translating functional needs into technical specifications, supporting solution configuration, and ensuring the platform is implemented correctly, tested thoroughly, and delivered successfully. The ideal candidate will bring strong analytical and technical skills, hands-on FSM platform experience, implementation project experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively across a cross-functional delivery team including the Technical Project Manager, Solution Architect, Product Developers, and Product Solution Architects.
Key Responsibilities:
Requirements & Technical Analysis:
  • Analyze and document detailed technical and functional requirements for the FSM platform implementation, working closely with business stakeholders and the Solution Architect.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications, configuration workbooks, user stories, and functional design documents.
  • Conduct gap analysis between out-of-the-box FSM platform capabilities and client-specific business requirements.
  • Support development of solution design documents, data mapping specifications, and integration requirements.
Solution Configuration & Implementation Support:
  • Support configuration of the FSM platform (e.g., scheduling rules, work order types, service territories, mobile workflows, dispatch logic) based on approved designs.
  • Partner with Product Developers and Product Solution Architects to validate that technical builds align with documented requirements and architecture standards.

Testing & Quality Assurance:
  • Develop test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate FSM platform functionality against business requirements.
  • Lead or support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing cycles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with the Technical Project Manager to provide status updates, flag risks/issues, and support project planning and reporting.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

  • Contribute to lessons-learned sessions and continuous improvement of implementation methodology and reusable assets.
Deployment & Hypercare Support

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.

Required Skills and Experience:
  • 7+ years of experience in a Technical Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar technical delivery role within enterprise software implementations.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or supporting Field Service Management (FSM) or workforce management platforms (e.g., Salesforce Field Service, ServiceMax, IFS Field Service Management, Oracle Field Service Cloud, ClickSoftware).
  • Experience within the utilities industry (electric, gas, water) is strongly preferred, particularly with field operations, mobile workforce, or asset management systems.
  • Proven experience working on full implementation lifecycles: requirements gathering, design, configuration/build, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
  • Experience working in a consulting or systems integrator environment supporting client-facing delivery engagements.
  • Strong technical analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business needs into technical solutions.
  • Solid understanding of system integration concepts (APIs, middleware, data mapping/ETL) relevant to utilities technology ecosystems.

At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an Operations Manager, Client Successto join our Wisdo team. The Operations Manager supports the full Client Success function, spanning Coaching and other client-facing programs, by managing the data, reporting, lifecycle design, and operational processes that help the team run smoothly and scale. This role partners directly with Client Success leadership and cross-functional teams to define how customer performance, outcomes, and contractual commitments are measured, monitored, and reported, while keeping cross-functional work organized, on track, and clearly communicated to stakeholders.To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Client Success leadership to translate strategy into operational processes and workflows spanning Coaching and other client-facing programs, and lead their implementation across the team.
  • Own and continuously improve operational workflows, including scheduling and program delivery structures.
  • Own end-to-end reporting on client activation, engagement, retention, outcomes, and operational performance across all Client Success programs.
  • Use dashboards and analytics tools (e.g., Looker or Mixpanel) to monitor program and operational performance and give leadership real-time visibility, partnering with Product on build out as needed.
  • Analyze client and engagement data using Excel, Google Sheets, and existing dashboards to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and drive operational or program improvements based on those insights.
  • Monitor client health indicators and proactively surface insights and risks to Client Success leadership to inform strategic decisions.
  • Build, document, and maintain Client Success processes and SOPs that reduce manual effort and increase consistency across the team.
  • Lead forecasting, capacity planning, and performance tracking through accurate data and reporting.
  • Help define scope, timelines, and ownership for cross-functional Client Success initiatives, and keep work on track.
  • Manage preparation and delivery of materials — including timelines and version control — for external review or approval processes required by client or partner agreements (e.g., payor audits, URAC/NCQA-related documentation, SOC 2 evidence requests).
  • Maintain documentation and status updates so stakeholders across Client Success and cross-functional partners have a clear, current view of progress.
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Engineering, Finance, and Sales to align on data definitions, reporting needs, and operational priorities.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years of experience in Operations, Analytics, Project Management, or a related role, with a track record of owning processes and projects independently.
  • Demonstrated experience working with dashboards and analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to monitor performance and communicate insights to leadership.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a genuine interest in process improvement.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, digital health, behavioral health, or another regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with SLAs, KPIs, or outcomes-based reporting in a payor or health plan context.
  • Experience with CRM or coaching/engagement platforms.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $75,000 - $85,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

ABOUT MERCY CORPS

Mercy Corps is a leading global organisation powered by the belief that a better world is possible. In conflict, in disaster, in hardship, in more than 30 countries around the world, we partner to put bold solutions into action — helping people triumph over adversity and build stronger communities from within. Now, and for the future.

THE POSITION

The Fundraising Team at Mercy Corps leads efforts to secure restricted and unrestricted funding while strengthening our relationship with supporters and enhancing our global brand. The Fundraising Operations function provides the systems, processes, data and financial support that enable effective and compliant fundraising.

As Fundraising Operations Officer, you will provide essential operational support across gift processing, donor database management, financial reconciliation, data selections, reporting and campaign analysis. You will be responsible for delivering accurate and timely operational processes, maintaining high-quality donor data, and providing analysis and information to support fundraising activity and decision-making.

The role requires a highly organised and detail-oriented individual who is confident working with data, systems and financial information. You will be expected to manage your own workload, identify and resolve issues, contribute to improvements in processes and systems, and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation.

Experience working with a fundraising CRM or relational database, financial processing and data analysis is desirable. Experience in the charity sector and with Raiser’s Edge is advantageous but not essential.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Database Management

  • Maintain accurate and complete donor and fundraising data within Raiser’s Edge and other relevant systems.
  • Process data imports and updates from internal and external sources, ensuring data is accurate and meets agreed requirements.
  • Carry out routine database checks and diagnostics, identifying and resolving data quality issues.
  • Support colleagues with day-to-day use of fundraising systems and provide guidance on agreed processes and procedures.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of database processes, procedures and documentation.

Gift Processing

·Process donations and related transactions accurately and within agreed timescales.

·Support the recording and reconciliation of fundraising income received through different payment channels.

·Process donor refunds, cancellations, amendments and other gift-related transactions as required.

·Support gift processing and acknowledgement activity during busy periods or in the absence of colleagues.

·Ensure gift processing procedures are followed consistently and accurately.

Finance and Reporting

·Reconcile fundraising income and investigate discrepancies between fundraising systems and financial records.

·Work with Finance colleagues to support the accurate and timely reconciliation of monthly fundraising income.

·Support the preparation and submission of Gift Aid claims, including identifying and resolving exceptions or errors.

·Support the development and maintenance of reporting dashboards and standard reports within Raiser’s Edge NXT and other systems.

·Provide accurate data and analysis to support fundraising planning and decision-making.

Data Selections and Campaign Analysis

·Prepare and run accurate, targeted data selections for fundraising and supporter communications, including direct mail, email and other campaigns.

·Translate selection requirements into clear data selection briefs and identify any data issues or limitations.

·Prepare, clean and validate data for use in fundraising campaigns and mass communications.

·Support colleagues with data and analysis required for campaign planning and evaluation, measuring results against agreed KPIs and identifying relevant trends, insights and areas for further investigation.

Supporter Engagement

·Respond to supporter enquiries received by phone, email and post, ensuring queries are handled accurately and promptly.

·Process supporter requests and updates in accordance with agreed procedures.

·Maintain accurate records of supporter interactions and communication preferences.

·Contribute to a positive and consistent supporter experience across fundraising channels.

Compliance and Best Practice

·Apply relevant data protection, Gift Aid and fundraising regulations and organisational policies to day-to-day activities.

·Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support compliance and audit requirements.

·Identify and escalate potential compliance, data quality or financial risks to the Fundraising Operations Manager.

·Contribute to the review and improvement of operational procedures and controls.

·Keep up to date with relevant changes to legislation, regulation and best practice

Process and Systems Improvements

·Participate in the development and implementation of fundraising operations policies, procedures and systems.

·Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, data quality and the supporter experience.

·Support testing and implementation of system changes and new processes.

·Document processes clearly and contribute to maintaining up-to-date operational guidance.

·Participate in relevant fundraising operations projects and provide analytical or administrative support as required.

Accountability to Participants and Stakeholders

Mercy Corps team members are expected to support all efforts toward accountability, specifically to our program participants, community partners, other stakeholders, and to international standards guiding international relief and development work. We are committed to actively engaging communities as equal partners in the design, monitoring and evaluation of our country projects.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:None

ACCOUNTABILITY:

Reports To:Fundraising Operations Manager

Works closely with:Members of the global Fundraising Operations Team, the wider Fundraising Team in Europe, the Corporate Finance colleagues, and colleagues across the global organisation.

The role works closely with U.S.-based colleagueson a daily basisas part of the global fundraising operations function, collaborating across teams and time zones to deliver shared processes, systems and fundraising activity.

The postholder is expected to manage their own workload and day-to-day responsibilities, seeking guidance from the Fundraising Operations Manager on complex issues, competing priorities or matters requiring escalation.

KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE

Essential

  • Experience working in an operational, administrative, fundraising, finance, data or similar role.
  • Experience working with a CRM or relational database and managing substantial volumes of data.
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to processing and checking information.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with the ability to manipulate, analyse and present data.
  • Experience producing reports and summarising data to identify trends, anomalies or areas requiring further investigation.
  • Experience working with financial information, reconciliation or transaction processing.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies, identify problems and take appropriate action to resolve them.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work to deadlines and maintain accuracy under pressure.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly to colleagues.
  • Understanding of the importance of data protection, confidentiality and data quality.

Desirable

  • Experience working within a fundraising or charity environment.
  • Experience using Raiser’s Edge NXT or another fundraising CRM.
  • Experience processing charitable donations and/or Gift Aid claims.
  • Experience preparing data selections for direct marketing campaigns.
  • Experience cleaning, manipulating and preparing data for mass communications.
  • Experience producing fundraising campaign performance reports and KPIs.
  • Familiarity with UK data protection, Gift Aid and fundraising regulations.

Success Factors

The ideal candidate will:

·Take ownership of their responsibilities and work independently within agreed processes and priorities.

·Be highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

·Have a logical and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail.

·Be confident working with data and able to identify, investigate and resolve discrepancies or problems.

·Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve processes, systems and data quality.

·Communicate clearly and confidently with colleagues, including when explaining data, processes or issues.

·Be adaptable and comfortable working in a changing environment.

·Demonstrate good judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek advice or escalate it.

·Build effective working relationships with colleagues across teams and geographies.

·Maintain a high level of accuracy and professionalism when working to tight deadlines.

·Demonstrate an interest in and empathy for international development and humanitarian issues, aligning with Mercy Corps’ mission and values.

Living Conditions / Environmental Conditions

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a developer productivity engineer to take responsibility for our monorepo and the “path to production” for over 50 engineers pushing over 75 commits a day with continuous deployment to production. This presents an exciting challenge where you can apply your expertise in helping teams ship fast and safe to meaningfully improve the productivity of our engineering team. This role also provides a unique opportunity to work on a multi-cloud and multi-region infrastructure that supports a global customer base. Our monorepo is primarily Javascript/Typescript with some Go and Python. While the primary responsibility of this job is developer productivity, to fit in with the team and be productive in our codebase generally, strong computer science and development fundamentals will be required. As part of your onboarding, you’ll spend significant time writing and delivering features to gain empathy for the current dev flow.

We believe in enabling our engineers to do their best work for our customers by giving them extremely high levels of ownership and autonomy. This comes in different forms: you will own and deliver projects from start to finish, you will work directly with customers to solve their hardest scaling problems, and you will have a lot of influence over what we work on as a team and company.

Some of the problems we’ll be working on include:

  • Own the build: You’ll be the single threaded owner for the build/test/deploy of our software and how each team fits into it
  • Monorepo productivity: Detangle our build/test/deploy patterns so teams can move fast and not block each other. Investigate/implement a tool like turbo repo to speed builds and separate concerns
  • Drive excellence in testing: We need to improve our top-down and team-level views into test coverage + support an ever growing matrix of data sources, data destinations, and enrichment patterns. An excellent engineer in this role will be able to “hold up a mirror” to our dev teams, helping each team understand where they have gaps
  • Multi-Region and Multi-Cloud: Supporting our multi-region and multi-cloud backend, including extending it to launch Hightouch on in new regions to support data residency requirements of our global customer base
  • Operational excellence: Support an increase in our ability to catch issues before they reach production and respond quickly if they do

We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $180,000 - $400,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

About You

You are an engineer with a passion for solving hard technical problems that generate real value for customers. You’re motivated by high ownership and are comfortable in a fast-paced, startup environment.

You’ve driven significant improvement in the productivity of a 50+ person development team by making high-leverage changes to their build/test/deploy processes. While you likely have some infra chops, this is not an infra role: you have strong development fundamentals and are comfortable driving framework-level improvements across multiple teams. This could take several forms:

  • You’ve been a member of a developer-productivity team/function for an outstanding development team
  • You’ve organically become “the build person” at a fast-growing startup and helped bring order to chaos
  • You’ve personally delivered code that has improved cross-team metrics related to developer productivity (e.g., DORA metrics, coverage, etc)

In addition to any of the above, we’re looking for someone who can dive into feature code, including complicated backend code, as needed.

Interview Process

Our goal with the interview process is to balance speed with giving both parties opportunities to assess whether there is a strong mutual fit. We will ask you questions, but we want you to ask us questions! Our technical interviews focus on how you design systems because we believe this is the best way for us to see how you work and for you to see how we collaborate. We don’t ask you to write code to solve technical brainteasers that don’t appear in your day to day job.

  • Apply: Curl jobapi.hightouchdata.com on port 13784 and have followed those instructions before applying. It'll only take a minute!
  • Recruiter Screen: Introductory call with our recruiting team to get to know each other and see if the role could be a good mutual fit
  • System Design Screen: Designing a data processing feature end-to-end.
  • Developer Productivity Skills Interview: We’ll dive into your experience making teams productive through a discussion of past projects and tooling you've used.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: Chat with hiring manager about past experiences and future operating preferences to assess fit on company values and operating principles.
  • System Design Interview: Work with the interviewer to architect a system at a conceptual level. The problem will be at a pretty high level - and have both product and customer requirements as well as technical.

We have limited inbound applications to one application per candidate. You will be auto-rejected if you apply to multiple roles. Please only apply to the position you are most qualified for.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

  • Assist with overall design, development and implementation strategy for products and services.

Communication and collaboration

  • Builds connections and relationships between people, teams/projects, and A1M and clients in ways that prevent and break down silos, enabling new opportunities for improved delivery.
  • Gets buy-in from relevant parties (teammates, team leads, government stakeholders, etc.) to make sure necessary work happens.
  • Proactively recognize risks and conflicts within the team and clients, help identify approaches, and take action – manage up (understanding timing, context and other pressures, etc.) and escalate when appropriate.
  • Evaluate your own skills and deliverables and take action based on self-assessment. This might include proactively reaching out to other team members for help upskilling in skill gap areas.

Cross-domain understanding

  • Initiate and drive projects that require working with multiple people in other disciplines and practices on challenging problems.
  • Coach and mentor people not just within your own practice or discipline, but across practice areas – for example, designers coaching engineers.
  • Anticipate and proactively provide information needed by other practices and disciplines.

Government domain acumen

  • Proactively identify and respond to government requirements or policy that may impact project work, such as accessibility, PRA, FOIA, acquisition regulations, and security compliance.
  • Sufficient government understanding to anticipate needs of government partners and users, and be prepared to speak to them proactively.
  • Trusted to represent the company and team to clients, including in challenging situations.

Qualifications

8+ years of relevant professional experience.

Your portfolio or resume should demonstrate:

  • College degree in political science, communications, or a related field
  • Personal experience with government health and human services programs
  • Expertise with applying policy expertise (understanding of policy hierarchy, analysis and interpretations of statutes, regulations, and agency guidance) within a team
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, the ACA, and Medicaid and CHIP
  • Previous work with and/or within a state or the federal government. Specifically, experience is required with a government health agency, Medicaid agency, and/or similar government agencies or offices.
  • Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, engineers, and subject matter experts
  • Flexibility pivoting with our client’s evolving strategic priorities

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of Public Law 119-21, which the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) refers to as the “Working Families Tax Cut” (WFTC) legislation
  • Experience working in government consulting engagements, preferably with the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and/or the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS)
  • Experience working with a social impact-focused product team or in civic tech
  • Experience working in government consulting engagements
  • Familiarity with SAFe and agile methodologies
  • Familiarity with Human-centered design

Applicant requirements

  • Our contracts require employees to work from the United States. That includes all 50 US states, the District of Columbia, and all US territories.
  • A1M employees must have been residents in the United States for 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Due to tax reasons, A1M employees cannot reside in New York state.
  • You must already have legal authorization to work within the US and not require ongoing visa sponsorship to maintain legal authorization to work.
  • You must be a permanent US resident.
  • Because A1M employees have access to government data and systems, new hires will need to complete a Public Trust form. Public Trust is a type of background investigation, but it is not a security clearance. Depending on the role, you must complete either the Standard Form 85 (SF85) or 85P (SF85P) questionnaire. You will at the very least get asked questions about where you’ve lived, worked, went to school, military history, police records, and substance use. You’ll also need to have your fingerprints taken.
  • Our partners primarily work on Eastern Standard Time (EST), and will require flexibility in your hours if you reside outside of EST. We do offer flexibility for non-work-related life responsibilities during the day.
  • Active participation in client virtual meetings, including being on camera, is an essential function that helps strengthen trust and open communication.

Compensation and benefits

This is a fully remote full-time, permanent position. The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $155,000. This range is set by our contracts and reflects the full range for someone in this position over time, so you may not start at the top of the range.

A1M offers a benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Life insurance, short-term disability, and optional voluntary benefits
  • 401(k) retirement benefits with employer matching
  • Four weeks of paid time off, seven company holidays, two personal days, and your birthday off
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Wellness reimbursements
  • Budgets to support training, development, travel, and office supply needs
  • Donations to a nonprofit of your choice upon hire and a few times throughout each year

Interview process

We typically have five rounds of conversations to help ensure every employee we hire is the right addition for us and that we’re the right fit for them. Each interview is about 45–60 minutes long.

  1. A1M Overview - We like to start off by getting to know more about you, how you work, what you are looking for in your next role, and what you’re passionate about. This is your opportunity to ask questions and get a feel for us as A1M. We’ll talk about our mission and vision, and what we hope to accomplish through the business. We’ll also cover some particulars about federal contracting that may affect the timelines of when folks can expect to start. We talk about the type of contracts we have, and how our team tends to work.
  2. Technical Assessment - If our work at A1M broadly matches what you’re looking for, we’ll set up time to get into the nitty-gritty of your technical skills. In this conversation, you’ll meet with one of our managers to walk through one or two projects in-depth that you feel are most relevant to A1M’s work so that we can get an in-depth understanding of your skill set and interests. Please be prepared to speak about one or two projects you feel are most relevant to the work of A1M.
  3. Values Interview - After the technical assessment, we’ll schedule a conversation focused on A1M’s core values. This interview helps us understand how you approach your work, collaborate with others, and align with the way we operate as an organization, including areas like impact, collaboration, relationship management, curiosity, and active listening.
  4. Project Overview - Based on what we’ve learned in our prior conversations, we will match your unique background and goals with the right opportunity. Members of the project team will share the day-to-day of the project to outline its vision, objectives, and team dynamics. This conversation ensures the specific position aligns with your career goals as well as ensuring you’ll be successful on the team.
  5. Offer - At this point, you’ve made it! You'll meet with our leadership to go over the offer letter and have a chance to ask any remaining questions.

Equal employment opportunity

A1M Solutions is building a culturally diverse and pluralistic organization committed to working in a multicultural environment where differences are valued and respected. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.

As a federal contractor and subcontractor, we certify that we do not operate any programs that violate any applicable Federal anti-discrimination laws.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
