Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Albert helps chemists change the world by building technology that understands how they work.
jobs.description:
Albert helps chemists change the world by building technology that understands how they work. As chemists ourselves, we know what it’s like when software doesn’t work the way you do — stuck with systems built by people who never spent a day at the bench. That’s why we created Albert OS, the first AI-native operating system for materials science, designed to remove every obstacle between curiosity and discovery.

We’re looking for an ambitious and results-driven Strategic Account Executive to join our growing team. This role, with a focus on driving high-value, consultative sales across Germany and the broader EU region, will play a key part in driving successful outcomes for Albert’s most strategically important customers and internal initiatives.

If you’re passionate about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, we want to hear from you.

You’ll take full ownership of pipeline generation and deal strategy for chemical, materials science, life sciences, and pharmaceutical companies across Germany and the EU region, drawing on an existing senior network in these sectors to open doors and build trust quickly. Acting as a trusted advisor rather than a feature-led seller, you’ll connect chemists, lab leaders, and R&D executives to the revenue and value impact Albert OS creates for their teams.

What you’ll do:

Strategy & Delivery

  • Own pipeline generation and deal strategy end-to-end for Germany and the DACH region, proactively building and prioritizing your own book of business rather than waiting for leads or direction.
  • Translate deep knowledge of chemistry, materials science, and life sciences R&D workflows into a point of view that resonates with technical and executive buyers.
  • Prepare accurate pipeline forecasts and account plans, and report progress against goals to sales leadership.

Execution & Collaboration

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in large accounts, consistently exceeding quota through consultative, value- and revenue-led selling rather than feature-led pitches.
  • Engage at the C-level as a trusted advisor, leveraging an existing senior network across chemical, materials science, and life sciences companies to build credibility quickly.
  • Work cross-functionally with Solutions Scientists, Customer Engagement, and Marketing to shape proposals, demos, and account strategy.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms that balance long-term partner success with Albert’s commercial goals.

Leadership & Impact

  • Act as the voice of the partner inside Albert, feeding market and product feedback to marketing, product and leadership.
  • Represent Albert at industry conferences and events across Germany and the DACH region.
  • Collaborate with Solutions Scientists and other pre and post sales stakeholders effectively

You will have:

  • 10+ years of experience in sales or account management, ideally within SaaS, enterprise software, or scientific/R&D solutions.
  • A strong, existing senior network in the chemical, materials science, life sciences, and pharmaceutical sectors.
  • Credible knowledge of AI solutions that drive enterprise business value
  • Proven enterprise SaaS or AI sales experience, with a track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in large accounts and consistently exceeding quota.
  • A proactive “hunter” mindset — someone who takes full ownership of pipeline generation and deal strategy rather than waiting for direction.
  • C-level presence and consultative selling skills, acting as a trusted advisor and focusing on value and revenue impact rather than feature-led selling or pure logo acquisition.
  • High personal autonomy and resilience, able to operate effectively in a fast-changing startup environment with evolving product, pricing, and internal structures.
  • Fluent in German and English, with the ability to work effectively across both languages with internal teams and partners.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools and standard sales processes like MEDDPICC and value selling motions
  • Willingness to travel across Germany and the broader DACH/European region as needed.

Key competencies:

  • Grit: Self-starter, persistent problem solver, relentless in their pursuit of progress.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable in dynamic, evolving customer and company environments.
  • Innovator: Passionate about improving customer outcomes through digital tools and scientific rigor.
  • Empathy: Strong active listening across multiple personas and cultures.
  • Leadership: Ability to lead initiatives and drive projects to completion with little or no oversight.

Why Albert?

We have a huge impact. Albert is a growing team with a global reach. We’re building toward a future where discovery feels like exploration, not administration. Where chemists can pursue their most ambitious ideas without friction. We love our global team. Albert’s home-base is in the California Bay Area, but we have multiple offices and employees sprinkled around the globe: India, Germany and Japan. In fact, over 50% of our employees work outside of California! An international hybrid culture is in our DNA. We care about you. Albert works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We work hard and we play hard. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful — every day. We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Albert team. If you think you might be a fit, please apply!

We are recruiting for a growing US-based outsourced business development agency that partners with B2B companies to build and manage their outbound sales pipelines.

The company provides clients with a complete outbound business development function, including prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn outreach and appointment setting.

They are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) who is confident speaking with US decision-makers and can independently manage outbound activity from prospecting through to qualified meeting booking.

This is not a traditional call-centre position. The successful candidate will operate with a high degree of autonomy and will be expected to take ownership of their pipeline, follow-ups and activity without requiring constant supervision.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-volume B2B cold calling into the US market.
  • Engage founders, sales leaders, Heads of Growth and other senior decision-makers.
  • Book qualified sales meetings with prospective clients.
  • Manage follow-up activity independently and consistently.
  • Use email and LinkedIn outreach alongside cold calling to engage prospects.
  • Research and identify relevant prospects within defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs).
  • Maintain accurate prospect, activity and pipeline information within the CRM.
  • Write clear, professional and personalised follow-up emails.
  • Manage prospects through multiple touchpoints until a meeting is secured.
  • Provide daily activity updates and weekly reporting on meetings booked and pipeline activity.
  • Initially support the company's own new-business pipeline before transitioning to outbound campaigns for its clients.
  • Professionally represent different client brands when conducting outbound campaigns.
  • Maintain excellent CRM hygiene, notes and follow-up tasks.

Key Requirements

  • 3+ years of B2B outbound sales, SDR, BDR or appointment-setting experience.
  • Strong track record of cold calling as a primary sales activity.
  • Previous experience engaging US-based B2B prospects is strongly preferred.
  • US or Australian outbound campaign experience would be advantageous.
  • Confident communicating with founders, sales leaders and senior business decision-makers.
  • Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral and professional phone manner.
  • Strong written English and the ability to write professional follow-up emails without relying heavily on templates.
  • Comfortable conducting unscripted, natural sales conversations.
  • Strong objection-handling and qualification skills.
  • Highly self-directed and able to manage follow-ups without being chased.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Commercially driven and motivated by targets and commission.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to CRM and pipeline management.
  • Must be genuinely comfortable working 17:00–02:00 SAST on a long-term basis.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable professional remote-working environment.

Technology & Sales Tools

Experience with the following would be beneficial:

  • Go High Level
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Gmail
  • Explorium
  • Vibe
  • CRM and sales dialling platforms
  • Prospecting and list-building tools

Candidates with experience using comparable CRM, dialler and sales engagement platforms will also be considered.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–6 years of B2B outbound sales experience and has previously worked on international campaigns, particularly within the US market.

You should be someone who can be given a target market and take ownership of it. You understand that successful outbound sales requires more than simply making calls — you research prospects, manage follow-ups, personalise communication, maintain your pipeline and consistently work towards qualified meetings.

Experience within SaaS, outsourced business development, lead generation, sales agencies, marketing agencies or other B2B environments would be particularly relevant.

Candidates who have previously built their own outbound sequences, conducted prospect research, developed target lists or supported/led small outbound teams are also encouraged to apply.

Performance & Commission

In addition to monthly compensation, the position offers a performance-based commission structure:

  • USD $75 for every qualified meeting held.
  • 10% of the first month's revenue for any new client deal closed from a meeting you booked.

A qualified meeting must match the defined target customer profile, include an appropriate decision-maker or influencer and successfully take place.

What Success Looks Like

During the first 90 days, success will be measured by:

  • Consistent outbound activity.
  • A predictable flow of qualified meetings.
  • Strong cold-calling performance.
  • Effective prospect qualification.
  • Consistent and proactive follow-up.
  • Accurate CRM and pipeline management.
  • Professional communication with US prospects.
  • The ability to operate independently and take ownership of results.

As the role develops, you will have the opportunity to work across additional client campaigns and take greater ownership of outbound business development activity.

Interview Process

Candidates should be comfortable completing an introductory video as part of the application process.

The interview process may also include a live mock cold call and follow-up sales scenario to assess phone presence, communication, objection handling and follow-up ability.

About third

Third is a modern-commerce growth company helping brands turn new and emerging platforms into real sales channels.

Our integrated acquisition strategy connects best-in-class teams across TikTok, Whatnot, Meta, Snap, and beyond - eliminating the need to stitch together multiple partners.

Third blends deep niche expertise with modern execution to launch,operate, and scale commerce on new platforms, transforming culture, creators, and content into real product sales.

The Role

We’re looking for a Director of Affiliate Strategy to build and scale Third’s affiliate strategy across our portfolio of consumer brands and retail partners. This role owns the development, execution, and optimization of affiliate programs that drive measurable GMV growth, with an initial focus on TikTok Shop.

Reporting to the VP of Delivery, you’ll sit at the center of creator partnerships, commerce strategy, platform expertise, and operational execution.

You’ll define how affiliate programs are structured end to end, from recruitment and activation through engagement, retention, and ongoing performance optimization.

Beyond strategy, you’ll build and lead a team responsible for execution, building scalable systems and workflows that ensure affiliate programs consistently perform at a high standard across clients.

You’ll partner closely with Client Services, Paid Media, Livestream, Creative, and Commerce Operations to ensure affiliate strategy is fully embedded into broader performance efforts.

At its core, this role is about building systems where everyone wins — the brand, the affiliate, and the platform — and making that model work at scale.

Shape the Affiliate Ecosystem

  • Own affiliate strategy across our client portfolio, with an initial focus on TikTok Shop.
  • Develop scalable frameworks for affiliate recruitment, activation, engagement, and retention.
  • Create programs that drive measurable GMV growth while aligning with client goals and budgets.
  • Define when and how brands should engage with affiliates, influencers, and creator networks.
  • Continuously test, measure, and optimize performance to improve results over time.

Activate the Network

  • Build and lead a best-in-class affiliate community that attracts high-performing creators and sellers.
  • Develop communications, incentives, and resources that help affiliates succeed.
  • Ensure creators receive strong campaign briefs, content direction, and performance insights.
  • Create an ecosystem built around long-term partnership, not one-time transactions.

Lead the Category

  • Stay ahead of platform updates, affiliate programs, incentives, and policy changes across social commerce.
  • Monitor competitive ecosystems including Amazon, Shopify, Whatnot, and emerging commerce platforms.
  • Identify new opportunities that create a competitive advantage for Third and our clients.
  • Serve as the company's subject matter expert on affiliate commerce and creator partnerships.

Build the Operating System

  • Manage, coach, and develop the team responsible for affiliate recruitment and program execution.
  • Establish performance metrics, workflows, and quality standards.
  • Build scalable systems that improve efficiency while maintaining a high-quality affiliate experience.
  • Partner closely with Client Success, Paid Media, Livestream, Creative, and Commerce Operations teams.

Measure What Matters

  • Own the relationship with Cruva and maximize platform capabilities across sourcing, outreach, management, and reporting.
  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks that clearly demonstrate affiliate impact.
  • Use performance data to identify growth opportunities and improve program effectiveness.
  • Turn data into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.

Advise and Influence

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to clients on affiliate commerce opportunities and growth strategies.
  • Present performance insights, recommendations, and program roadmaps to stakeholders.
  • Build trust through expertise, communication, and measurable results.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7-10 years of experience in affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, influencer marketing, social commerce, or related fields.
  • At least 3 years of direct experience managing social affiliate programs.
  • Solid understanding of TikTok Shop affiliates and creator ecosystems; understanding of TikTok Shop's Affiliate Center and its core functionality and capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of TSP incentives, Seller incentives and Creator incentives across TikTok Shop.
  • Hands-on experience with Lark's suite of office tools.
  • Strong understanding of affiliate business models, incentives, attribution, and performance measurement.
  • Experience building and scaling affiliate programs that drive measurable revenue growth.
  • Experience managing affiliate technology platforms, creator tools, or affiliate SaaS solutions.
  • Proven leadership experience, including managing remote or distributed teams.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn performance data into strategic action.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
  • Experience working with consumer brands, retailers, agencies, or commerce-focused organizations is preferred.

Who You Are

You think in systems, not silos.

You understand what drives performance across creators, platforms, and brands.

You care about outcomes and how they’re achieved.

You’re highly collaborative, low ego, and accountable for results.

You move quickly and improve things as you go.

You balance strategy with execution.

Why This Role Matters

The way brands grow is shifting quickly, with affiliate ecosystems now at the center.

The brands that win won't simply have the largest affiliate programs.

They'll have the strongest ecosystems.

This role will define how Third recruits creators, activates affiliates, and turns influence into measurable revenue growth.

Success here won't just impact our clients. It will establish Third as a category leader in affiliate-driven commerce.

jobs.excerpt: WME is building the next generation of internal platforms that power one of the world's leading entertainment companies.
jobs.description:
WME is building the next generation of internal platforms that power one of the world's leading entertainment companies. The software we build helps agents and teams manage relationships, deals, and opportunities across the global entertainment industry.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to take ownership of a major area of our platform. This is a senior ownership role rather than a senior individual contributor role. You'll be accountable for whether your area is staffed well, moving at the speed the business needs, aligned with product, and making deliberate architectural choices. You'll be working through the team leads who run day-to-day execution rather than driving that execution yourself.

Deep technical judgment still matters here. You can't set a technical bar you couldn't personally meet, and you'll make the calls that shape how these systems evolve. But the work happens a level up from the ticket queue, and the engineers who thrive in this role are the ones who find that shift energizing rather than limiting.

We're building this engineering organization largely from the ground up, so we're looking for people who enjoy scrappy environments, are comfortable navigating ambiguity, and want to help shape how a team operates. We're also investing heavily in AI-assisted development, and engineers here actively use modern AI tools and workflows to improve development velocity and product quality. We take the work seriously, but not ourselves.

What You'll Do

  • Own an area of the platform. You'll be responsible for the outcomes of one or more teams working across a connected set of product surfaces. Scope is assigned based on business need and shifts as the org grows.
  • Keep leadership ahead of risk. Your manager should hear about slippage, resourcing gaps, or a bad bet before they have to ask. That includes pushing back if a timeline isn't realistic, or a product ask will create debt worth knowing about. Raising risk early is never treated as a failure here.
  • Give your teams context. Engineers in your area should understand why a priority exists, why a tradeoff was made, and why something changed. You're the connection between company direction and day-to-day execution.
  • Own technical health. Staffing mix, delivery pace, product alignment, and architectural direction all sit with you. A team can be fully staffed and shipping quickly while quietly accumulating problems, so tracking velocity isn't the same as setting the technical bar — you're responsible for both.
  • Own the roadmap. You should be able to articulate what your area is building over the next quarter and defend the sequencing on your own.
  • Grow leads. Identifying and developing engineers who can own execution is a core part of the job, not a side effect of it.
  • Hire. You'll source and interview for your own teams and weigh in on candidates joining them.
  • Partner with a technical program manager. You'll work alongside a TPM who runs planning cadence, cross-team dependencies, and operational execution. You set the direction and make the calls; they keep the machinery of delivery running, so you're not absorbed into it.
  • Make architectural calls. Including the uncomfortable ones. You decide where to take on debt and where to pay it down, rather than letting either drift by default.
  • Shape architecture beyond your own area. You'll work with engineering leadership and peer Staff Engineers on overall system architecture and the shared components that cut across products.

Example Problems You Might Own

  • Designing systems that capture and connect relationships across the entertainment industry
  • Building modern CRM workflows that replace fragmented legacy tools and spreadsheets
  • Developing AI-powered features that surface insights from operational data
  • Creating APIs and services that support complex deal and workflow management
  • Migrating legacy applications into modern web-based systems

What We're Looking For

Ownership and judgment

  • Experience owning outcomes across multiple teams or workstreams at once, through leads rather than direct execution
  • A track record of surfacing risk early and pushing back constructively on unrealistic scope or timelines
  • Experience growing engineers into technical leadership
  • Comfort owning a roadmap and defending its prioritization
  • Hiring and interviewing experience
  • Comfort working where systems, processes, and org structure are still forming

Technical depth

  • Extensive software engineering experience, typically 15+ years
  • Strong full-stack background building modern web applications, with deep proficiency in React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Solid backend experience with Node.js, building scalable services and APIs (REST and gRPC)
  • Experience designing and managing relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure; Azure preferred, including cloud-native services such as serverless functions, managed databases, queues, and blob storage
  • Containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code with Terraform
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar)
  • Strong product instincts and a collaborative mindset

How We Build

  • Ship practical software that solves real problems
  • Favor simple, maintainable architectures
  • Work closely across engineering, product, and design
  • Use modern cloud infrastructure (Azure), Terraform, and containerized deployments
  • Maintain automated CI/CD pipelines to keep shipping fast and safe
  • Leverage AI-assisted development across the engineering workflow

AI-First Engineering

AI tools are part of our everyday engineering workflow. We encourage engineers to use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and system design, and we're actively exploring how AI can enhance the systems we build.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager, New Channels Strategy
jobs.excerpt: About the TeamDoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies.
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. To further this mission, we’re looking for a marketer who will sit at the intersection of growth, brand, product, and operations to lead DoorDash’s new channels strategy — identifying, testing, and scaling net-new marketing channels (such as Influencer & Affiliate, SMS, and other emerging channels) to drive incremental new customer and MAU (Monthly Average User) growth. This role owns a portfolio of channel bets end-to-end, from early-stage testing through to scaled, always-on programs. The integrated marketing team is a group of marketing generalists responsible for translating business goals into marketing strategies and serving as the general manager across the organization to bring those strategies to market.

About the Role

The Consumer Integrated Marketing team is looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial, and data-driven marketer to lead DoorDash’s new channels strategy — identifying, testing, and scaling new marketing channels to drive incremental new customer and MAU (monthly active users) growth efficiently. This role will report into the MAU Marketing lead, and will own end-to-end strategy — from ideation and testing through to scaled execution and measurement — across a portfolio of new channel bets that support our broader new customer acquisition goals. This includes DoorDash’s Influencer & Affiliate program (creator recruitment, commission structure, content strategy, and measurement) as one flagship bet in that portfolio, alongside a handful of additional new channel tests. It’s an awesome blend of working on 0 to 1 nascent bets and driving impact at scale while overseeing a substantial marketing budget.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for DoorDash’s portfolio of new channel bets — identifying, testing, and scaling channels (including Influencer & Affiliate) that drive incremental New Cx and MAU growth
  • Lead the build-out of DoorDash’s Influencer & Affiliate program as a flagship bet in that portfolio — from creator recruitment and onboarding to commission structure and content strategy — modeled after category leaders like Amazon
  • Partner closely with Eng, MarTech, and Analytics to build durable measurement and attribution infrastructure (deeplinking, tracking, incrementality) across new channel bets
  • Design and evolve incentive and budget structures that balance DoorDash’s efficiency goals with the dynamics of each channel (e.g., influencer earning potential)
  • Set content and channel strategy across verticals (Rx, New Verticals, DashPass) and seasonal moments to drive GOV, New Cx, and brand awareness
  • Act as the “glue” across the marketing org, aligning new channel plans with priorities from Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance
  • Communicate with cross-functional partners and senior leadership on program performance, risks, and roadmap progress across the full channel portfolio

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher; MBA a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in performance, growth, or lifecycle marketing, with a track record of identifying, testing, and scaling new marketing channels from 0 to 1 (e.g., affiliate/influencer, SMS, or other emerging channels)
  • Experience collaborating and leading cross- functional workstreams with Product, CRM, paid media, creative, analytics, and finance teams
  • The ability to think about the business like a GM, drive forward highly cross-functional projects like a product manager, and speak to consumers (and, where relevant, external partners) like a seasoned marketer
  • Comfort operating with imperfect attribution — able to synthesize detailed data to make data-driven decisions while using judgment when full visibility isn’t available
  • A creative and entrepreneurial mindset — you enjoy building 0-to-1 programs and finding creative solutions with limited resources
  • Excellent verbal / written communication skills, able to manage relationships with external partners as well as brief senior stakeholders
  • Nice to have: familiarity with affiliate networks and creator platforms (e.g., Impact, CJ, CreatorIQ, Tagger) and how to evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs for program infrastructure

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…

  • We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
  • We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
  • We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
  • We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
  • We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

We expect this position to be filled by 11/03/2026.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. We're looking for a Lead Generation Specialist to own outbound email outreach and email automation for a fast-growing better-for-you snack brand with retail placement across 15 or more regional grocery chains. You will build and manage outbound email sequences, set up and optimize automation workflows, identify and qualify prospects, and keep the pipeline moving through consistent, high-quality written outreach.

This is an email-first role. You will be writing sharp, personalized cold emails, building automated sequences, managing prospect lists, and tracking what works. If you are a strong writer, comfortable with outreach automation tools, and take pride in crafting email campaigns that actually get responses, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time

  • High-ownership outreach role with a clear playbook, defined metrics, and a repeatable email motion

Outbound Email Outreach

  • Write clear, personalized, non-spammy cold emails to prospective accounts, buyers, and distribution partners
  • Build and manage multi-step outbound email sequences that nurture prospects from cold to engaged
  • Test subject lines, messaging, and calls to action to continuously improve open and reply rates
  • Follow up on open email threads and move engaged prospects forward in the pipeline

Email Automation and Workflow Setup

  • Set up, manage, and optimize outbound email automation workflows using tools such as Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, Outreach, or similar platforms
  • Build and maintain email sequences, cadences, and automation rules that run reliably at scale
  • Monitor deliverability, bounce rates, and spam metrics and take corrective action when needed

Prospect List Building and Management

  • Research and build targeted prospect lists across retail buyers, distributors, brokers, and wholesale accounts
  • Enrich and qualify prospect data before loading into outreach sequences
  • Segment lists based on account type, region, or product fit to improve email relevance and response rates

CRM and Pipeline Management

  • Log all outreach activity and email engagement accurately in Salesforce or the designated CRM
  • Maintain clean pipeline data with clear next steps on every active account
  • Track email campaign performance metrics and report on open rates, reply rates, and pipeline contribution consistently

Account Reactivation and Follow-Up

  • Re-engage inactive or stalled accounts through targeted email campaigns
  • Support reorder and account expansion outreach for existing customers
  • Maintain a structured follow-up cadence across all active and dormant accounts

What You Bring

  • Proven experience in outbound email outreach, lead generation, or a similar email-driven role
  • Strong written English communication skills with the ability to write personalized cold emails that do not read as templates
  • Hands-on experience building and managing outbound email automation workflows using platforms such as Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar
  • Understanding of email deliverability including domain warming, bounce management, and spam avoidance
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM for logging activity and tracking pipeline
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through on open outreach threads
  • Self-directed and disciplined with the ability to manage a high volume of outreach without dropping quality
  • Available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time with reliable high-speed internet

Nice to Have

  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, retail, or consumer brand outreach
  • Familiarity with grocery, natural channel, or regional retail distribution channels
  • Experience with prospect list building tools such as ZoomInfo, Apollo, or similar data platforms
  • Background using AI tools to personalize outreach at scale

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your outbound email experience, and walking through an email sequence or automation workflow you built and the results it produced

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a strong writer who knows how to build email campaigns that get responses and can run outbound automation systems that scale, this role gives you the structure and the direct impact to do your best work.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.title: IT Automation Engineer - Business Technology (Central/Mountain Time - US)
jobs.excerpt: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences.
jobs.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As an Automation Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the scripts, workflows, and tools that let Rithum’s Business Technology team spend less time on manual, repetitive IT work and more time solving problems that matter. You also administer and support the end-user, identity, and collaboration platforms Rithum runs on, so the automation you build is grounded in hands-on ownership of those systems. You partner closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify where automation can reduce risk and free up capacity, and you are accountable for the reliability of the automation you build.

All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, confidentiality, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) that streamline IT service delivery, endpoint provisioning, and systems administration tasks.
  • Design, build, and own automated workflows across user lifecycle, device provisioning, and identity lifecycle using Rithum's existing platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf) and API and webhook integrations.
  • Instrument automations with logging and alerting so every action is auditable and measurable, tracking hours saved and errors reduced rather than only whether a workflow ran.
  • Translate manual, repetitive IT operations processes into reliable, documented, automated solutions, adapting existing scripts and tools to address new and evolving business needs.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot automation failures, and draft technical documentation, verifying outputs before they are applied to production systems.

Enterprise Systems Administration & Support

  • Administer, configure, and monitor end-user and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf, and Tanium, escalating architectural decisions on complex integrations to senior IT Operations teammates.
  • Administer and support collaboration and productivity platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Resolve end-user computing issues across Windows and macOS through the ticketing queue, direct messaging, and voice or video sessions, owning requests end-to-end and escalating critical incidents and system alerts to senior IT Operations.
  • Document technical solutions so they are accurate, secure, and aligned with corporate IT and Information Security standards and policies.
  • Partner with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify recurring manual tasks that are strong candidates for automation.
  • Collaborate with partner teams to test, deploy, and monitor automation workflows, tailoring communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Provide occasional guidance to Service Desk teammates on scripting fundamentals and automation best practices as your experience grows.

Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Document automation workflows, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides so that solutions remain supportable and repeatable across the IT organization.
  • Own the automation knowledge base, keeping runbooks and integration notes current so what you build is repeatable and supportable by others rather than dependent on you.
  • Apply lessons learned from prior automation efforts to improve reliability, reduce inefficiencies, and anticipate dependencies in future builds.
  • Monitor the performance and reliability of deployed automations, escalating and resolving issues within your area of ownership.

AI-Enabled Productivity & Innovation

  • Use AIas your starting point for recurring IT work — configuration research, scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design — so your output is clearer and needs less rework.
  • Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations in non-production environments before applying them, following Rithum's responsible AI use and data security standards.
  • Share effective AI-assisted approaches and prompts with teammates when they meaningfully improve automation quality or speed.
  • Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can be applied to Business Technology workflows, escalating larger opportunities to your manager.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in IT systems administration, service desk operations, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience writing and maintaining automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise identity, collaboration, and productivity platforms such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams.
  • Demonstrated experience adapting or troubleshooting existing automation, scripts, or workflows to resolve moderately complex, ambiguous technical issues.

Job Description:

The VP, Product Pricing Strategy is the strategic architect of how NextGen Healthcare commercializes its complex, interconnected software and services portfolio. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer (CPO), this executive leader operates at the center of a cross-functional "triad" composed of Product Leaders (P&L Owners), Sales/Commercial Leaders, and Finance Leaders to balance market opportunity with financial rigor and sales agility. This role owns the market-facing, value-oriented packaging and pricing architecture across our ambulatory EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, and platform offerings, designing monetization models that simplify the buying experience, drive product-led growth, and maximize customer lifetime value.
  • Monetization & Packaging Strategy: Define the holistic portfolio pricing strategy, subscription tiers, and packaging frameworks; partner with Product GMs to translate product roadmaps and new product introductions (NPI) into modern, value-aligned SaaS and product-led growth (PLG) packaging structures (including standardizing tier structures, modular bundling strategies, and pricing for AI/GenAI add-ons).
  • Sales Enablement & Deal Governance: Collaborate with Sales leadership and Sales Operations to establish clear discounting frameworks, value-based sales playbooks, and contract-term guidance that reduce transaction friction and protect price realization.
  • Finance Partnership & Governance: Partner with the Corporate Finance peer to separate value-based pricing design from financial compliance; co-chair the internal Pricing Committee to ensure all commercial models are both highly competitive and financially disciplined.
  • Market Research & Price Elasticity: Oversee quantitative and qualitative pricing research—including price-elasticity modeling, competitive intelligence, and customer sensitivity analyses—to ground pricing decisions in objective market data.
  • Corporate Pricing Governance: Co-lead corporate pricing governance by partnering with Corporate Finance; this VP owns the market-facing, value-based pricing design and packaging strategy, while partnering with Finance to ensure all models align with corporate margin targets, revenue recognition compliance, billing system capabilities, and corporate financial planning.
  • Price Realization & Optimization: Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the ongoing efficacy of pricing models, actual discount rates, bundle performance, and contract compliance; utilize this data to continuously iterate, optimize, and defend future packaging and pricing strategies.
  • Team Leadership & Executive Influence: Recruit, mentor, and develop a team of monetization managers and pricing analysts; prepare and present complex, data-driven pricing recommendations to secure consensus from the Executive Leadership Team.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Preferred: MBA, Master’s in Economics, or other advanced business degree.

Experience Required:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in monetization strategy, strategic pricing, product strategy, corporate strategy , or business operations within B2B enterprise software or SaaS environments.
  • Proven track record of building and leading a strategic pricing or monetization function, including designing and scaling multi-product SaaS packaging and tiered subscription models.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing sales discounting governance, value-based pricing methodologies, and commercialization strategies for new product launches.
  • Preferred: Experience in healthcare IT, digital health platforms, or private equity-backed technology environments.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

License/Certification Required:

  • None required.
  • Preferred: Certified Pricing Professional (CPP) or other specialized monetization credentials.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Modern monetization models for emerging technologies, including AI, Generative AI, and API/platform integrations. Modern B2B SaaS business models, recurring revenue metrics (LTV, CAC, NRR, Gross Margin), and value-based pricing methodologies. Advanced pricing research frameworks, price elasticity modeling, and market-segmentation techniques. Enterprise sales structures, deal-desk operations, contracting guidelines, and discount-governance practices.
  • Preferred: Healthcare industry commercial structures, clinical software trends, and regulatory impacts on health technology contracts.
  • Skill in: Executive-level communication, with the ability to distill complex financial and quantitative models into simple, persuasive narratives. Cross-functional orchestration within a "triad" governance model (Product, Sales, Finance). Advanced statistical reasoning, quantitative financial modeling, and structured strategic planning. Coaching, mentoring, and leading highly analytical teams of pricing professionals.
  • Ability to: Translate abstract product value propositions into highly structured, defensible, and simple pricing and packaging structures. Collaborate cross-functional and build strong operational partnerships with Product, Finance, Legal, and Sales executives. Jointly govern a corporate Pricing Committee, balancing competitive market positioning with strict financial discipline and revenue compliance.
  • Manage high-impact, visible initiatives under tight timelines and organizational complexity.

POS-11333

Staff Technical Lead - Marketing Studio Intelligence

Location: Ireland - Remote, Flex, or Office

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. Marketing Studio Intelligence is building the intelligence layer behind HubSpot’s next-generation marketing platform. We bring together campaign performance, marketing assets, CRM data, and AI to help marketers understand what’s working, uncover opportunities, and discover what to do next.

This is a deeply customer-focused space, where we work closely with marketers to understand real problems and turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences that deliver meaningful value.

As a Staff Technical Lead, you’ll lead a small team of 2 - 3 engineers while staying deeply hands-on. You’ll partner closely with Product and UX to shape and build AI systems at scale, tackling ambitious problems across agentic systems, intelligent decisioning, AI quality, and evaluation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead a small team of 2 engineers, setting technical direction and helping the team deliver against shared product and engineering goals.
  • Design, build, and evolve backend services that power campaign integrations, measurement, automation, and intelligent capabilities across Marketing Studio.
  • Stay hands on with development, contributing production quality Java code and working directly on the team’s most important technical challenges.
  • Lead technical design for integrations between Marketing Studio, HubSpot campaign systems, marketing assets, CRM data, and other platform capabilities.
  • Build scalable systems that support campaign performance reporting, attribution, analytics, and intelligent recommendations.
  • Help shape backend capabilities for AI powered experiences that use campaign context, CRM data, and engagement history to generate insights and recommendations.
  • Break complex initiatives into clear technical plans and help engineers navigate architecture decisions, dependencies, tradeoffs, and delivery risks.
  • Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, feedback, and day to day technical guidance.
  • Partner with Product and UX to shape priorities and translate customer problems into technical approaches that balance speed, quality, and long term system health.
  • Drive alignment across engineering teams when work spans shared services, campaign infrastructure, data systems, integrations, or Studio platform capabilities.

What You’ll Bring

  • Significant experience designing, building, and operating backend software systems in production environments.
  • Strong Java development skills and experience building production grade backend services, as well as Kafka, MySQL or comparable backend technologies.
  • Experience technically leading a small engineering team while remaining an active contributor to the codebase.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring engineers and helping others grow their technical skills and ownership.
  • Strong understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, performance, fault tolerance, testing, and observability.
  • Experience designing and delivering AI-powered products, agentic workflows, AI agents, recommendation systems, decisioning systems, personalization, or next-best-action experiences.
  • Experience building the backend orchestration, services, APIs, and feedback loops that connect AI or ML models to real customer actions and outcomes.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Direct experience with recommendation systems, decisioning, personalization, ranking, experimentation, or next-best-action products.
  • Experience integrating CRM, marketing, campaign, advertising, or customer data across multiple systems.
  • Experience in marketing technology or other domains where products help customers make data-informed decisions.
  • Experience with Python or another transferable backend language in addition to, or instead of, Java. Check out our engineering blog to learn more.

Direct marketing or recommendation-system experience is a plus, but not required. We also welcome candidates with transferable experience building customer-facing AI products in areas such as customer support, prospecting, content, advertising, or other decision-support domains.

About Kalepa:

Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.

We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.

Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.

Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.

Our Values (This is important):

Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.

Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:

  • Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
  • Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
  • Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
  • Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
  • Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.

In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).

Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

About the role:

Salary range: $220k – $300k USD*

Location: Remote (USA)

We are looking for smart engineers who love to code, seek challenging problems, and appreciate recognition for excellent work. As part of the infrastructure team, you will work on the infrastructure and tooling that power our core platform. You’ll maintain CI/CD pipelines, automate operational workflows, and ensure we stay secure and compliant to the industry standards. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include improving infrastructure performance and reliability, monitoring and optimizing system cost, and collaborating with engineering teams to standardize environments and deployment patterns. You’ll help to maintain observability and incident response processes, and ensure the scalability of our cloud-based systems as we continue to grow.

You'll collaborate with a global team of full-stack, data, AI, and DevOps engineers to build scalable backend solutions as we continue to grow. We're a small team where individual contributions have an outsized impact on both our technology and our business.

You'll be right at home if you:

  • Have 8+ years of software engineering or DevOps experience, ideally with time spent working on infrastructure, performance, security, or compliance.
  • You're excellent at your craft and relentless in pursuing it.
  • Take full ownership of your work and drive projects to completion with minimal oversight.
  • Communicate proactively, surfacing blockers, asking the right questions, keeping stakeholders in the loop.
  • Thrive on experimentation: you're comfortable testing ideas, measuring results, and iterating quickly on problems no one has solved before.
  • Have strong fundamentals in system design, debugging, and problem-solving.
  • Know Python (our main stack), though we're open to strong candidates from other OO backgrounds.
  • Have experience with serverless technologies (Lambda, EC2), asynchronous workflows, and cloud environments.
  • Have strong knowledge of relational databases and their performance tuning, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Know terraform, IaaC best practices, Docker or similar tools.
  • Bonus: experience with LLMs/generative AI, distributed systems

What you’ll get:

  • Competitive salary (based on experience level)*.
  • Significant equity options package.
  • Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $7T global industry.
  • 20 days of PTO a year.
  • Global team offsites (2024 - Lisbon, 2025 - Cartagena).
  • 100% covered medical, 100% covered vision and dental for individuals and families.
  • Healthy living/gym stipend. Mobile phone bill stipend.
  • Continuing education credits.
  • 401(k) plan with employer contribution (regardless of employee contribution)

*The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range.
