jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésData Governance SpecialistDans un environnement de transport public soumis à la directive européenne NIS2, cette mission vise à structurer une gouvernance des données pragmatique afin de renforcer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la valorisation des données.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Data Governance Specialist

Dans un environnement de transport public soumis à la directive européenne NIS2, cette mission vise à structurer une gouvernance des données pragmatique afin de renforcer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la valorisation des données. Le rôle contribue à la conformité réglementaire et au déploiement de la stratégie Data de l'organisation.

La mission s'articule autour de deux axes principaux, dont le premier est prioritaire.

  1. Assurer la conformité aux exigences NIS2 liées à la gestion et à la protection des données critiques

    En étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées en matière de protection des données, cybersécurité, architecture d'entreprise, gestion documentaire, métiers et IT, vous contribuez à définir et mettre en place les dispositifs de gouvernance nécessaires.

    Phase 1 : Gouvernance et identification des données critiques

    • Inventorier, cartographier et classifier les données critiques, ainsi que leurs flux et dépendances.
    • Définir les politiques, standards et procédures de gestion des données.

    Phase 2 : Protection des données

    • Définir les exigences de protection applicables aux données critiques selon leur niveau de classification.
    • Veiller à la mise en œuvre des mesures de sécurité, de sauvegarde et de restauration.

    Phase 3 : Gestion des accès

    • Définir et faire appliquer les règles d'accès aux données selon les besoins métiers et le principe du moindre privilège.
    • Assurer le contrôle et la revue des accès aux données critiques.

    Phase 4 : Sensibilisation et adoption

    • Former et sensibiliser les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques de gestion et de protection des données.
    • Accompagner l'adoption de la gouvernance des données et soutenir les actions de conduite du changement.
  2. Déployer les principes de gouvernance des données dans les initiatives métiers et Data

    En collaboration avec les équipes métiers et les équipes Data, vous veillez à l'intégration des bonnes pratiques de gouvernance dans les projets inscrits à la feuille de route Data.

    • Garantir la qualité, la découvrabilité, l'accessibilité et la documentation des données.
    • Définir et maintenir les rôles, responsabilités et processus de gouvernance.
    • Assurer la maîtrise des données de référence (MDM), du data lineage et de la modélisation des données.
    • Contribuer à la sélection, au déploiement et à l'adoption des outils de gouvernance des données et de gestion des métadonnées.
    • Participer à l'élaboration et au suivi de la roadmap Data Governance.
    • Coordonner les parties prenantes et faciliter l'alignement entre acteurs métiers, Data et IT.

📝 Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d'une expérience significative en gouvernance des données et en qualité des données, avec plus de 7 ans d'expérience.
  • Vous maîtrisez les cadres de gouvernance des données, par exemple DAMA-DMBOK.
  • Vous possédez une excellente compréhension des méthodologies et technologies de la donnée afin de collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Data Management et IT.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des outils de gouvernance des données et de gestion des métadonnées, tels que Collibra, Informatica ou Ovaledge.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec la documentation, la présentation et la communication de concepts complexes de manière claire et accessible.
  • Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, d'une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'un bon sens de l'organisation.
  • Vous savez développer un réseau interne, gérer les parties prenantes et aligner différents acteurs grâce à de solides compétences de négociation.
  • Vous disposez d'une bonne expérience en conduite du changement et êtes capable de soutenir l'adoption de nouveaux principes de gouvernance.
  • Vous démontrez de solides aptitudes de leadership pour piloter ces activités avec impact.
  • La maîtrise du français et/ou du néerlandais est requise ; l'anglais constitue un atout.

Nice to have

  • Connaissance de la réglementation NIS2.
  • Connaissance des standards et réglementations tels que ISO/IEC 38505, ISO 8000 ou GDPR.
  • Connaissance de la modélisation des données (UML).
  • Connaissance de la modélisation des flux de données (ArchiMate).
  • Expérience professionnelle dans des secteurs réglementés, par exemple la finance, la santé ou le secteur public.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

jobs.description:
Benefits and Leave Specialist

Reports to: People and Culture Lead

Remote – US (with preference for an east coast timezone)

About Us

Textile Exchange is a global non-profit driving positive impact on climate change across the fashion and textile industry. It guides a growing community of brands, manufacturers, and farmers towards more purposeful production from the very start of the supply chain.

By 2030, its goal is to guide the industry to achieve a 45% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions within fiber and raw material production. Its focus is holistic and interconnected, accelerating the adoption of practices that improve the state of our water, soil health, and biodiversity too.

For real change to happen, everyone needs a clear path to positive impact. That’s why Textile Exchange believes that approachable, step-by-step instruction paired with collective action can change the system to make preferred materials and fibers an accessible default, mobilizing leaders through attainable strategies, proven solutions, and a driven community.

At Textile Exchange, materials matter. To learn more, visit TextileExchange.org.

Working at Textile Exchange 

We work remotely with a team located in 20+ countries. We are a diverse group committed to harnessing the strengths of the global textile industry to accelerate change toward climate and other key environmental goals. We work collaboratively on important environmental issues around the world by working and interacting with farming groups, processors, brands, retailers, and environmental experts in the textile and fashion industries around the world. We offer an opportunity to join a cutting-edge global environmental nonprofit and to help strengthen the impact of our organization.

Position Summary

The Benefits & Leave Specialist administers Textile Exchange's benefits, leave of absence, time-off, and workers' compensation programs. This role has primary ownership of U.S. benefits and leave administration; involvement in international programs is limited to coordination with our Employer of Record (EOR), escalation support, annual plan review, and communication as needed. The role maintains compliance with applicable regulations and organizational policies and supports accurate employee data and payroll-related processes.

The role partners with employees, managers, vendors, and our EOR provider to deliver consistent, compliant, and effective benefits and leave administration across the organization.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Benefits Administration

  • Lead end-to-end administration of U.S. employee benefits programs, including open enrollment, life event processing, eligibility administration, employee education, new hire orientation, and annual 1095 reporting
  • Serve as primary administrator for the benefit platform, Ease, and manage day-to-day relationships with U.S. benefit vendors and carriers
  • Ensure benefit enrollments and payroll deductions are accurately reflected in BambooHR and vendor systems

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager
jobs.excerpt: About UTOPIAUTOPIA is a venture studio (Utopia Studio) and fund manager platform (Utopia Capital) headquartered in Doha, operating across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa.
jobs.description:
About UTOPIA

UTOPIA is a venture studio (Utopia Studio) and fund manager platform (Utopia Capital) headquartered in Doha, operating across the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Africa. The platform combines early-stage venture funds with an in-house studio that builds companies directly, supported by a proprietary technology infrastructure that shortens the time from idea to build. A team of 30 runs capital deployment, company-building and infrastructure together, giving the platform direct access to markets, data and operating relationships across three regions.

UTOPIA is anchored by sovereign wealth and Qatar's leading development institutions, and is invested in alongside family offices, high-net-worth investors and foundations. The platform is regulated by the Qatar Financial Centre Regulatory Authority (QFCRA), and its investor base sets the standard for the financial rigour, compliance and operational discipline it runs to. UTOPIA builds and backs early-stage ventures led by domain experts, with capital efficiency and disciplined execution central to how it operates.

The Role

The Legal & Compliance Manager keeps the platform's regulatory, compliance and legal obligations current and on time across both Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. The Manager owns the compliance calendar, prepares and coordinates filings, keeps registers and records accurate, and puts the policies and frameworks set by leadership into day-to-day practice. Regulatory strategy and controlled-function accountability sit with the COO and CEO. The MLRO and Compliance Officer functions are held externally through a service provider, and this role works alongside them to make sure the platform meets its obligations on time.

Reports to: COO.

Direct reports: None.

Works closely with: COO, CFO and finance, People & Operations, the outsourced MLRO / Compliance Officer, external counsel and company secretary, and the Utopia Studio and Utopia Capital teams.

Location: Doha, Qatar (full-time, with some remote allowances during the summers)

Compensation: circa US$50,000 per annum.

What you will own

There are four areas of ownership: regulatory filings, compliance operations, legal administration, and governance records. Together they keep the platform's obligations met on time across both entities.

Regulatory filings & reporting

  • Own the platform's regulatory filing calendar across both entities: track every QFCRA (and other applicable) deadline, and support the Compliance Officer with preparing submissions and accurate and on-time filings.

  • Coordinate periodic regulatory returns and maintain a clear record of what has been filed, when, and what is next due, so status is visible at any moment across all group entities

  • Own the compliance and filing cycle for the fund vehicles (Cayman & QFC)

  • Own the reporting calendar to our investors and LPs: track deliverables and milestones, prepare and coordinate the periodic reports, and make sure every submission is complete, accurate and on time.

Compliance operations

  • Run day-to-day compliance monitoring against existing policies, and act as the internal point of contact for the outsourced MLRO and Compliance Officer, gathering information, completing first-line checks and following actions through to closure.

  • Execute onboarding and KYC due diligence, screening, and the upkeep of conflicts, gifts and entertainment registers.

  • Prepare (when needed) compliance reporting packs for the COO and board, and support supervisory engagement and audits by assembling documentation and tracking remediation actions to closure.

  • Coordinate the fund-level AML and economic substance obligations in Cayman with the outsourced administrator and appointed officers, keeping the platform's records aligned with what is filed offshore.

Legal & contract administration

  • Draft, review and process standard-form agreements (NDAs, vendor, engagement and service agreements) and manage the contract lifecycle from request to execution to storage.

  • Maintain the contract register and central legal repository so every agreement is filed, findable and current.

  • Coordinate with external legal counsel on matters beyond standard scope, managing instructions, turnaround and documentation.

  • Own corporate housekeeping across the platform's entities, ensuring that registrations, renewals, licences and statutory records are completed on time.

Governance & records

  • Keep the platform's policies, registers and corporate records organised, version-controlled and up to date.

  • Maintain accurate entity and shareholding records across the Group and keep the corporate register current.

  • Ensure documentation is retained and organised to the standard the platform's regulator and investor base expect.

Who we are looking for

  • 4–6 years in a compliance, regulatory reporting or filings function, ideally within a regulated financial services, fund management or professional services environment.

  • A bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as accounting, finance, business or economics.

  • A law degree or specialist compliance certification is not mandatory, though a legal or compliance background is advantageous. What matters most is the years you have spent working hands-on inside a compliance or reporting function.

  • Practical familiarity with regulatory filing and compliance processes; direct QFCRA, DFSA, FSRA or comparable exposure is a strong advantage.

  • Meticulous and deadline-driven, taking pride in nothing being late, nothing being missed, and every record being accurate.

  • Highly organised and self-directed, comfortable owning a calendar of recurring obligations and chasing the inputs you need from others.

  • Practical and execution-minded, more focused on getting the filing done correctly

  • GCC experience preferred; familiarity with Qatar's institutional and regulatory landscape is an advantage.

  • Temperament: reliable, discreet, calm under deadline pressure, and comfortable holding colleagues to account to get documentation in on time.

Why this Role

  • Real ownership of the platform's day-to-day regulatory and compliance execution across both a fund manager and a venture studio.

  • A clearly defined, hands-on role reporting directly to the COO, focused on day-to-day execution while strategy and accountability sit above you.

  • Institutional context: sovereign-grade anchor partners, a QFCRA-regulated environment, and an investor base that sets a high operational standard.

  • A platform at the point where it scales, giving you the chance to build reliable, repeatable compliance operations for both entities.

We believe innovation should be inclusive and globally distributed. Our team is built on openness, curiosity, and collaboration — with people from across the GCC, Africa, and Southeast Asia working together to build meaningful ventures.

All roles are based in Doha, Qatar, with flexible hybrid options and global travel opportunities (unless otherwise stated). We welcome talent from every background to join us in shaping the future of AI-native innovation.

jobs.description:
About Scale:

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We are hiring a Director of Analytics to lead and scale the data and analytics function across Scale Media. Reporting to Leila Tovbina, VP of Growth, this senior leadership role owns our end-to-end analytics strategy — spanning marketing measurement, financial forecasting, retention, and inventory analytics — and turns data into decisions across marketing, growth, finance, and operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role at a marketing-driven DTC business. You'll set the vision for how Scale measures and grows its brands: how we quantify marketing incrementality, forecast the business, model unit economics, and predict customer value. You'll lead our analytics organization, including direct management of our Manager, Data Analytics, and you'll define and oversee the data engineering roadmap that our analytics depend on. Above all, you'll be obsessed with data accuracy and consistency — the foundation everything else is built on.

What You Will Do:

  • Strategic Planning:
    • Develop and own Scale's companywide analytics strategy, aligned with overall business goals.
    • Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional departments to understand their data needs and ensure analytics solutions support their objectives.
    • Identify opportunities to leverage data, AI, and predictive analytics to improve business performance and decision-making.
  • Marketing Analytics & Measurement:
    • Own Scale's marketing measurement framework, including experimentation design (lift/geo testing), incrementality, MMM, and MTA, and the statistical methodologies that underpin them.
    • Build and maintain retention analytics and LTV models, including churn and contribution-margin prediction.
    • Manage the marketing data pipeline end to end, ensuring channel data is complete, accurate, and analysis-ready.
    • Bring deep familiarity with paid and owned marketing channels and their associated metrics and analytical approaches.
  • Financial Analytics & Forecasting:
    • Build and own financial forecasts for a marketing-driven business.
    • Model unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback, margin) and set marketing targets grounded in those economics and our growth goals.
    • Partner with finance and growth to connect spend, revenue, and profitability into a single, trustworthy view.
  • Team Leadership & Data Engineering Oversight:
    • Lead, manage, and mentor the analytics organization, including direct management of our Manager, Data Analytics, and indirect oversight of the broader analyst team.
    • Define and oversee the data engineering roadmap, setting priorities and standards for the pipelines and infrastructure that power our analytics.
    • Set clear goals, priorities, and professional development plans for the team, fostering a data-driven and collaborative culture.
    • Provide guidance on best practices, methodologies, data structure, and tooling across the function.
  • Data Architecture & Advanced Analytics:
    • Own our data architecture, working across our data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake) and source systems (e.g., Shopify, Amazon) to ensure data is accurate, reliable, and well-structured.
    • Apply statistical methods, machine learning, and predictive modeling to generate forward-looking insights.
    • Implement and maintain the analytics tools and platforms that support data-driven decision-making company-wide.
  • Reporting & Visualization:
    • Develop and deliver regular companywide reporting on key performance indicators (KPIs) for executive leadership.
    • Design and build dashboards and visualizations (e.g., Tableau, Sigma) that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
    • Establish reporting frameworks that ensure data accuracy and consistency across the business, including some inventory and operations analytics.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution:
    • Partner with marketing, growth, finance, IT, and operations to translate business questions into data solutions.
    • Communicate data-driven insights and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership in a clear, compelling manner.
    • Run the function in sprints, with tight project management and clear prioritization against quarterly goals.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in data analytics, with progressive leadership experience managing analytics teams, including managing managers.
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end analytics for a marketing-driven or DTC/ecommerce business.
  • Deep expertise in marketing measurement — experimentation, incrementality, MMM, and MTA — and the statistics behind them.
  • Experience with retention analytics, LTV modeling, and churn/contribution-margin prediction.
  • Financial forecasting and unit-economics modeling experience, including setting marketing targets from unit economics and growth goals.
  • Strong hands-on technical skills: SQL and Python, data modeling, and ML/predictive modeling.
  • Fluency with Claude Code (or comparable AI coding tools) for data manipulation and analytics.
  • Experience with a modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake) and DTC source data (e.g., Shopify, Amazon).
  • Experience maintaining a BI platform and designing dashboards and visualizations (e.g., Tableau, Sigma).
  • Experience defining a data engineering roadmap and partnering with or overseeing data engineers.
  • An obsession with data accuracy and consistency.
  • Experience partnering with executive stakeholders to translate data into business strategy.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in sprints with strong project management discipline.

What Makes You a Fit

  • Strategic thinker who can also roll up their sleeves and execute
  • Data-driven and technical, with an AI-first approach
  • Strong people leader who builds, mentors, and grows talent
  • High degree of ownership and a self-starter mentality
  • Excellent cross-functional communicator who can influence at the executive level
  • Comfortable operating and prioritizing in a fast-paced, fully remote environment

Reporting Structure

You will report directly to Leila Tovbina, VP Growth, and lead our analytics organization, including direct management of our Manager, Data Analytics, indirect oversight of the broader analyst team, and ownership of the data engineering roadmap.

What We Offer:

  • Salary: $180,000 - $220,000 depending on experience
  • Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous Paid Time Off program
  • Discounted Products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

In this role, you will:

System and Process Documentation (40%)

  • Participate in backlog refinement and sprint planning meetings to provide context, clarify requirements, and ensure alignment.

jobs.excerpt: 9th Way Insignia is a service-disabled, veteran-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions.
jobs.description:
9th Way Insignia is a service-disabled, veteran-owned small business bringing transformative technology to our government customers so they can achieve their missions. Our specialties include cybersecurity, cloud modernization, software development, data analytics, enterprise architecture, enterprise IT, analytics, process automation, and artificial intelligence. Learn more about 9th Way Insignia at

Application password: Niner

Team (Project) Introduction
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Cybersecurity Operations Systems Engineering (COSE) project serves as an overarching technical engine that unifies Architecture and Engineering Services throughout the VA Enterprise. This program implements cohesive organizational security architecture and underlying engineering components that utilize national security standards, guidelines, and frameworks. COSE bridges the gap between high-level business requirements and technical structures, enabling the consistent deployment of secure technologies through implementation guidance and the establishment of an analytic library. Systems security engineering within COSE contributes a holistic perspective to the systems engineering effort, ensuring that stakeholder protection needs are addressed throughout the entire system life cycle from concept and development to production, support, and decommissioning. By drawing upon well-established systems engineering and security principles, COSE adapts and supplements practices to protect intellectual property, data, and the methods used to create VA systems. These activities improve the security posture of VA applications to prevent, deter, or detract from cyberattacks by nefarious adversaries or insider threats.

9th Way Insignia is looking for an Engineer, 3, Quantum Computing/Cryptography Engineer to join this team.

Professional Level Information:
An Engineer, 3 typically plans and directs research or development work on complex projects, along with engaging various parties in design and development. Costs and recommendations of new components may also involve part of the job scope. Performs multiple engineering-related tasks in various assignments within the project and firm. An Engineer, 3 oversees the design, development, implementation, and analysis of technical products and systems. An Engineer, 3 has broad knowledge of engineering procedures and assists in the resolution of complex problems. An Engineer, 3 has strong technical skills and background, a knack for learning new technologies, and a blend of good problem-solving and innovation needed to resolve a wide variety of technical production challenges.

Functional Job (LCAT) Information:
The Quantum Computing/Cryptography Engineer will provide specialized engineering and technical expertise in quantum computing, cryptography, post-quantum cryptography (PQC), and cryptographic modernization in support of the VA COSE program. The engineer will assess existing cryptographic technologies, evaluate quantum-related cybersecurity risks, and develop strategies for transitioning VA systems and applications to secure, quantum-resistant cryptographic standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical expertise in quantum computing, quantum information science, cryptography, and post-quantum cryptography to support VA cybersecurity architecture and engineering initiatives.
  • Analyze the potential cybersecurity impact of quantum computing technologies on existing VA systems, applications, infrastructure, data protections, and cryptographic implementations.
  • Apply knowledge of quantum mechanics, quantum information theory, and quantum algorithms, including algorithms such as Shor’s and Grover’s algorithms, to evaluate current and emerging cryptographic risks.
  • Assess existing cryptographic implementations, protocols, algorithms, certificates, keys, and supporting technologies to identify systems that may be vulnerable to current or future quantum-enabled threats.
  • Develop and maintain an enterprise cryptographic inventory identifying cryptographic algorithms, protocols, implementations, dependencies, technologies, and systems across the VA environment.
  • Analyze the cryptographic inventory and establish risk-based migration priorities based on mission criticality, data sensitivity, cryptographic exposure, technology dependencies, and emerging quantum threats.
  • Develop and maintain Cryptographic Inventory and Migration Plans defining strategies, timelines, sequencing, and priorities for transitioning VA systems to approved cryptographic standards, including post-quantum cryptography where applicable.
  • Develop and recommend Post-Quantum Cryptography migration strategies that enable the VA to transition from existing cryptographic approaches to quantum-resistant algorithms in a controlled and secure manner.
  • Provide technical guidance for cryptographic modernization aligned with applicable NIST post-quantum cryptography standards, including FIPS 203, FIPS 204, and FIPS 205.
  • Evaluate and recommend quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms and technologies for use within enterprise systems, applications, networks, cloud environments, data protection solutions, and identity infrastructures.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in traditional cryptographic protocols and technologies, including RSA, AES, public-key cryptography, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), encryption, digital signatures, key management, and related security mechanisms.
  • Evaluate interoperability, compatibility, implementation complexity, performance, security, and operational impacts associated with replacing or upgrading legacy cryptographic technologies.
  • Identify cryptographic dependencies and potential migration challenges across applications, infrastructure, network technologies, cloud platforms, identity systems, security tools, and enterprise services.
  • Support the development of crypto-agile architectures and engineering approaches that enable cryptographic algorithms and technologies to be replaced or upgraded as standards and threats evolve.
  • Perform technical analysis, prototyping, modeling, and testing using classical and quantum simulation tools to evaluate quantum algorithms, cryptographic techniques, and potential security impacts.
  • Develop, implement, and test cryptographic algorithms and related engineering solutions using programming languages such as Python, C++, and Java.
  • Utilize quantum development languages, frameworks, and platforms such as Qiskit, Cirq, Quipper, and the Microsoft Quantum Development Kit to support research, simulation, testing, and technical analysis.
  • Conduct specialized security posture assessments for Post-Quantum Cryptography and other emerging technologies, documenting risks, vulnerabilities, technology implications, and recommended mitigation strategies.
  • Support security architecture reviews and engineering assessments to identify cryptographic weaknesses, architectural gaps, security risks, attack paths, and residual risk associated with existing and proposed systems.
  • Develop technical recommendations for mitigating cryptographic vulnerabilities and reducing exposure to “harvest now, decrypt later” and other quantum-related cybersecurity risks where supported by applicable VA risk assessments and modernization activities.
  • Support development of secure solution architectures, security patterns, reference architectures, and engineering guidance incorporating modern and post-quantum cryptographic protections.
  • Ensure cryptographic solutions and modernization recommendations align with applicable Federal security standards, VA security requirements, NIST guidance, and enterprise cybersecurity architecture.
  • Provide technical input into VA security policies, engineering standards, cryptographic guidance, modernization plans, and governance documentation.
  • Participate in technical design reviews, architecture reviews, modernization initiatives, pilots, engineering working groups, and governance forums requiring cryptography or quantum computing subject matter expertise.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity architects, security engineers, application teams, cloud engineers, DevSecOps personnel, network engineers, identity teams, program managers, and Government stakeholders to coordinate cryptographic modernization and PQC migration activities.
  • Communicate complex quantum computing and cryptographic risks in clear business and mission terms to technical teams, program leadership, and non-technical executives.
  • Develop technical assessments, white papers, implementation recommendations, risk analyses, briefings, and presentations addressing quantum risk, cryptographic posture, migration readiness, and modernization priorities.
  • Track emerging quantum-computing capabilities, cryptographic technologies, and evolving standards to identify potential impacts to the VA enterprise and recommend appropriate engineering or modernization actions.
  • Support project and lifecycle management activities associated with cryptographic modernization, including requirements development, configuration management, risk tracking, implementation planning, and transition sequencing.
  • Core Role Focus
  • May require occasional on-site visits

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years IT experience of which at least 5 years are of Quantum Computing and Cryptography experience at a large corporation or Government agency similar in size/scope to GSA, IRS, DoD or VA.
  • A Master’s degree in a related IT field may substitute for up to 2 years of the required experience
  • Expertise in quantum mechanics, quantum algorithms (e.g., Shor’s algorithm, Grover’s algorithm), and quantum information theory.
  • Expertise in quantum programming languages and frameworks such as Qiskit (IBM), Cirq (Google), Quipper, and Microsoft Quantum Development Kit
  • Expertise in cryptographic protocols (e.g., RSA, AES) and principles of public-key infrastructure (PKI).
  • Expertise in post-quantum cryptography and quantum-resistant algorithms.
  • Expertise in existing cryptographic standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO/IEC 19790).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and Java for implementing and testing cryptographic algorithms.
  • Expertise with classical and quantum simulation tools.
  • Expertise working with and advising on quantum-resistant algorithm migration plans and post-quantum cryptography (PQC) implementation strategies. Expertise assessing organizational cryptographic inventory and identifying migration priorities. Expertise collaborating with cross-functional teams to communicate quantum risk to non-technical leadership. Experience providing policy and guidance inputs for cryptographic modernization aligned with NIST PQC standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205).
  • Expertise in project management or working in a project-oriented environment, with an understanding of how configuration management fits into the overall project lifecycle within a large corporation and Government agency similar in size/scope to GSA, IRS, DoD or VA.

Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space with a large presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche. They are seeking a highly experienced professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer opening.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

jobs.description:
Lead DevOps Engineer

As a Lead DevOps Engineer at Particle41, you will own the DevOps strategy and the design, automation, and operation of the cloud infrastructure that powers our clients’ most complex digital projects. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will champion DevOps culture and practices, set the standards other teams build on, and ensure the delivery of innovative and high-quality projects. Your role will also involve mentoring and coaching team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, automation, and continuous learning.

In This Role, You Will:

Strategy & Practice Ownership

  • Own the DevOps technical roadmap and vision, in collaboration with architects and stakeholders, and align it with business goals.
  • Define the "golden path": reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, pipeline templates, and standards that teams across projects adopt.
  • Be accountable for platform reliability, security posture, and delivery velocity outcomes across the engagements you lead; measured through SLOs, not just activities performed.
  • Represent the DevOps practice with clients: participate in discovery and pre-sales conversations, estimate and scope infrastructure workstreams, and advise client leadership on cloud and platform decisions.
  • Contribute to growing the practice interview and assess DevOps candidates, and help shape team structure and capability development.

Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

  • Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Architect and operate container platforms, including Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) and managed container services, to support scalable, resilient workloads.
  • Define landing zones, account/subscription structures, and network topologies that balance security, cost, and developer velocity.
  • Evaluate and recommend platform tooling and managed services to support business requirements.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Own the CI/CD strategy and pipeline architecture (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) that makes releases fast, repeatable, and safe across teams.
  • Drive an automation-first culture across build, test, deployment, and environment provisioning — setting the standard for eliminating manual toil, and staying hands-on where it matters most.
  • Establish GitOps workflows (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) for declarative, auditable deployments.

Reliability & Observability

  • Define the observability strategy - monitoring, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry) and drive its adoption across teams.
  • Own SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in partnership with engineering and product teams, and hold teams accountable to them.
  • Own incident response, on-call practices, and blameless post-incident reviews to continuously improve system resilience.
  • Plan for capacity, scalability, and disaster recovery, including backup strategies and multi-region considerations.

Security & Cost Optimization

  • Own the DevSecOps posture: define and embed security standards into the delivery pipeline — secrets management, vulnerability scanning, image signing, and policy as code.
  • Support compliance initiatives (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) with automated controls and evidence collection.
  • Own cloud cost outcomes: drive right-sizing, autoscaling, and FinOps practices, and report spend posture to stakeholders.

Mentorship and Coaching

  • Mentor and coach DevOps and software engineers to enhance their technical skills and expertise.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
  • Review infrastructure code and pipeline changes, providing constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability.

Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on infrastructure, platform, and operational decisions.
  • Lead by example through hands-on involvement in automation, tooling, and design discussions.
  • Identify and resolve technical challenges to ensure project success.

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance delivery processes and methodologies.
  • Track DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore) and use them to guide improvements.
  • Facilitate lessons-learned meetings to learn from past experiences and improve future projects.
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices and standards in DevOps, platform engineering, and cloud operations.

Skills and Experience We Value:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years leading teams or owning the DevOps function for multiple products or clients.
  • Extensive hands-on expertise with at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and a working knowledge of the third.
  • Deep experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform strongly preferred) and configuration management (e.g., Ansible).
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation with languages such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Solid grounding in cloud security, IAM, networking, and compliance-driven environments.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience in mentoring and developing engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to technical and business audiences.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies and a collaborative, client-facing mindset; comfort advising senior client stakeholders is a strong plus.
  • Certifications in relevant technologies - such as AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer Professional, Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, or CKA - are a plus.

About Particle41

Our core values of Empowering, Leadership, Innovation, Teamwork,andExcellencedrive everything we do to achieve the ultimate outcomes for our clients. Empowering Leadership for Innovation in Teamwork with Excellence ( ELITE )

E - Empowering: Enabling individuals to reach their full potential.L - Leadership: Taking initiative and guiding each other toward success.I - Innovation: Embracing creativity and new ideas to stay ahead.T - Teamwork: Collaborating with empathy to achieve common goals.E - Excellence: Striving for the highest quality in everything we do.

jobs.description:
Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. Impulsionamos a transformação digital de grandes empresas, habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis para que nossos clientes possam oferecer melhores produtos e experiências digitais.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É ter espaço para contribuir com diferentes perspectivas, aprender, experimentar e construir junto.

Acreditamos que times diversos ampliam a forma como pensamos, criamos e entregamos. Por isso, esta oportunidade faz parte do nosso compromisso de ampliar a representatividade de Pessoas com Deficiência na Sensedia e construir experiências cada vez mais inclusivas.

Nos comprometemos com um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso e, durante o processo seletivo, queremos entender também quais condições podemos oferecer para proporcionar a melhor experiência para cada pessoa.

Conheça mais sobre a Sensedia em: Sensedia Careers

Qual a missão do cargo?

Como Developer Experience Analyst Júnior, sua missão é ser o principal facilitador da jornada do desenvolvedor que utiliza nossas ferramentas, plataformas ou APIs. Você garantirá que a experiência, do onboarding à resolução de problemas complexos, seja fluida, produtiva e inspiradora. O grande desafio deste cargo reside em ser a ponte estratégica entre a comunidade técnica (parceiros) e os nossos clientes. Você precisará entender profundamente as dores, os desejos técnicos e os padrões de uso dos desenvolvedores, transformando esses insights em ações concretas de melhoria junto aos times de Produto, Engenharia e Suporte.

Quais serão suas atividades no dia a dia?

  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Atender e gerenciar chamados técnicos (tickets), responder em canais de comunicação (e-mail, Slack/Teams, fóruns) e acompanhar a resolução de ponta a ponta, garantindo a satisfação do cliente/parceiro desenvolvedor.
  • Análise e Troubleshooting: Realizar a triagem, classificação e acionamento assertivos de alertas, além de investigar e debugar códigos (Java/JavaScript ou a linguagem principal da plataforma) e testar fluxos de APIs em ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção para diagnosticar e solucionar problemas.
  • Análise de Produtos Técnicos: Auxiliar na análise de design de APIs (Restful), propondo melhorias de usabilidade e ajudando os usuários a aplicar as soluções técnicas aos seus desafios de negócio.
  • Observability e Insights: Desenvolver e monitorar dashboards (em ferramentas como Grafana, Kibana, etc.) para medir a saúde da experiência do desenvolvedor, identificando padrões, pontos de fricção e oportunidades de automação de processos internos.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Desenvolver automações e scripts para procedimentos internos, evangelizar as melhores práticas de uso da plataforma (interna e externamente) e garantir que a voz do desenvolvedor seja ouvida e representada internamente.
  • Colaboração Interfuncional: Integrar-se ativamente com as equipes de Engenharia, Produto, Customer Success e Suporte, trabalhando em conjunto para ganhar agilidade na resolução de problemas e na entrega de novas funcionalidades amigáveis.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para este cargo?

  • Experiência com alguma linguagem de programação e scripts (ex. Java, JavaScript, python, go);
  • Excelente capacidade de análise e troubleshooting a sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos e práticas sobre APIs utilizando padrões de design RestFul (Experiência com integrações entre sistemas é um bom começo);
  • Capacidade de gerir ferramentas e interpretar dados de entrada/saída para diagnóstico de comportamento de sistemas, como forma de identificar problemas (Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Testes Funcionais de APIs (Postman, cURL e SoapUI);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de tickets (Zendesk, Jira, etc);
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva.

Quais são os diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência prévia com suporte técnico voltado para desenvolvedores ou produtos com APIs.
  • Inglês / Espanhol técnico (leitura e escrita), suficiente para compreender documentações e comunicar-se com desenvolvedores de fora do Brasil.
  • Capacidade de produzir conteúdo técnico (artigos, tutoriais, exemplos de uso) de forma estruturada e didática.
  • Conhecimento em webservices SOAP;
  • Conhecimentos sobre documentação de APIs utilizando OpenAPI Specification (Swagger) e fluxos de negócio;

Sobre esta oportunidade

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

Sabemos que cada pessoa possui experiências e necessidades diferentes. Por isso, durante a candidatura, teremos algumas perguntas para conhecer melhor você e entender se existe alguma adaptação ou recurso de acessibilidade que possamos oferecer durante o processo seletivo.

Caso precise de alguma adaptação — como recursos de acessibilidade, adequação de uma etapa, apoio de comunicação ou outra necessidade — queremos saber. Nosso time de Talent Acquisition estará disponível para conversar com você.

A necessidade de adaptação não interfere na avaliação das suas competências para a posição.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação — Cartão Flash;
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PPR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Programa Well-Being, destinado à saúde física e mental;
  • Universidade Corporativa — #SensediaAcademy;
  • Parceiros culturais e educacionais com descontos especiais;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.

Temos o #WorkWhereYouBelong como nossa proposta de valor para um modelo flexível de trabalho. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores e queremos que exista uma só Sensedia, independentemente de onde você esteja.

Queremos conhecer você!

Se você se identifica com a oportunidade, candidate-se mesmo que não preencha 100% dos requisitos.

Queremos conhecer sua trajetória, suas experiências e o que você pode construir com a gente.

Durante a candidatura, poderemos solicitar informações relacionadas à deficiência e às necessidades de acessibilidade para viabilizar a participação na oportunidade afirmativa e proporcionar uma experiência adequada durante o processo. Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados — Lei nº 13.709/2018.

Our Mission:

To actively connect people to their next great opportunity.

Who We Are:

ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

Summary:

At ZipRecruiter, we sit on a massive universe of data—over a billion archived job postings, tens of millions of dynamic job seekers, and billions of impressions, clicks, and application events. Connecting the right job seeker with the right employer in real time is a complex two-sided marketplace problem, where precision, scale, and latent intent prediction directly impact millions of lives.

We are seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist to serve as a technical anchor for our machine learning and AI capabilities. Reporting directly to the Director of Recommendation Systems, you will be a core partner in shaping our multi-year ML roadmap, driving foundational algorithmic architecture, and translating complex machine learning research into high-throughput, low-latency production systems.

This is a high-visibility role with org-wide reach. Beyond delivering core algorithmic gains, you will mentor Machine Learning Engineers across the organization and establish best practices for how ML models are built, deployed, and evaluated at scale.

Key Responsibilities & Strategic Impact

  • Drive ML Strategy & Roadmap: Partner directly with Engineering and Product Leadership to define and execute the technical vision for core components in the marketplace, including but not limited to recommendation engines and matching algorithms, ML entity representation platform.
  • Architect High-Scale Systems: Design and own state-of-the-art ML systems handling dynamic interaction prediction, candidate ranking, and candidate/job retrieval across high-throughput production environments.
  • Optimize Two-Sided Marketplace Dynamics: Solve high-complexity matching and recommendation challenges native to two-sided marketplaces, including real-time intent prediction, bilateral relevancy, candidate cold-start problems, and feedback loops between job seekers and employers.
  • Org-Wide Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists across teams to instill a culture of technical excellence, rigorous experimentation, and fast production delivery.
  • Production Excellence: Drive end-to-end model ownership—from initial exploration and feature engineering through distributed training, offline/online evaluation (A/B testing), to real-time latency optimization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Proven track record of architecting and shipping end-to-end ML solutions that serve production traffic at scale.
  • Deep domain expertise in Recommendation Systems, Personalization, Ranking & Retrieval, or Interaction Prediction.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on expertise using modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
  • Proven experience in technical leadership and mentorship, driving technical alignment across cross-functional engineering and product teams.
  • Strong background in statistical modeling, online experimentation (A/B testing methodology), and offline metric design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Two-Sided Marketplaces: Familiarity with supply/demand liquidity, bilateral matching algorithms, dynamic pricing, or auction-based models.
  • Modern deep learning techniques for recommendations, such as Two-Tower Neural Networks, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Transformer-based retrieval models, or Contextual Bandits.
  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with modern MLOps architectures and distributed training frameworks.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan

Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers,
and the community as a whole.
We have a rich and storied history. Colibri is one of the pioneers of online professional education,
introducing some of the first web-based professional education courses in 2001. Today, the company’s
family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets.
We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned
professionals. To learn more, please visit:

Position Overview:

As a core member of the combined Property Professions leadership team, the Single-Threaded Leader (STL) for Pre-License owns the start of the customer relationship. This role owns the end-to-end pre-license outcome for qualifying education across the ecosystem — from acquisition through course completion and licensure — and is accountable for both revenue/contribution and cost.

The role has two inseparable pillars: (1) new-customer acquisition excellence — the modern growth-marketing motion of discovery, funnel, and conversion that wins customers efficiently — and (2) product-experience excellence — the learning experience that keeps students engaged, drives completion, and helps them pass. Together these drive satisfaction and referral and feed the post-license CE, Membership, and Professional Development engine.

This role authors the pre-license engine that every brand runs on, directing matrixed resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes rather than managing those functions directly.

What You'll Do

    • Own the Pre-License outcome end to end. Own revenue and contribution and manage the cost line across the ecosystem, including enrollment growth, first-attempt pass rate, completion rate, and CAC by channel and state, from acquisition through licensure.
    • Drive new-customer acquisition. Lead the growth-marketing motion — modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), paid search/social for license intent, conversion rate optimization (CRO), lead-to-enrollment, and referral/partnership channels.
    • Deliver product-experience excellence. Own the student experience that drives engagement and completion, including exam-prep tooling, at-risk intervention, AI tutor/advisor capability, and instructor quality; first-attempt pass rate is the core product promise.
    • Build satisfaction and referral into a growth engine. Design the pre-license experience to drive NPS, referral, and repeat business, seeding the entire downstream customer lifecycle.
    • Own the QE→CE handoff. Jointly own the attach playbook (the 30- to 90-day post-pass welcome, sales, and campaign motion) with the Post-License STL, with the Ecosystem President as tie-breaker on seam disputes. Hand off newly-licensed customers, along with structured student data (completion velocity, exam performance, at-risk signals), to the post-license engine at the point of licensure.
    • Author and standardize the pre-license operating model. Establish a single acquisition → enrollment → completion → pass motion run by national and LDB brands on a shared platform and shared playbooks, keeping the method uniform while allowing brand-level local execution.
    • Deploy AI across the QE workflow. Drive adoption of acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring) and outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), tracking AI adoption as an operating metric.
    • Direct matrixed functional resources. Pull resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes; own the acquisition and product-experience roadmap, channel and budget allocation within the QE P&L, and conversion/pass-rate targets.
    • Maintain 100% state compliance status for pre-license at all times; this is a non-negotiable operating constraint on the role.
    • Run the operating cadence. Lead a weekly review of funnel and outcome metrics (CAC, conversion, completion, pass) and own the QE quarterly plan within the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
    • Escalate appropriately. Escalate brand-level positioning conflicts, shared-platform tradeoffs, and spend above the agreed threshold to the President, Ecosystem.

What You'll Need to Succeed

    • 12–15+ years in growth, general management, or operations leadership within a high-volume, funnel-driven consumer or prosumer business.
    • Demonstrated ownership of both acquisition and outcome: an acquisition-and-conversion P&L at scale (CAC, conversion, unit economics) combined with ownership of a product or experience that drove completion and outcomes — candidates must show ownership of both, not just one.
    • Growth-marketing fluency across modern discovery/SEO/GEO, paid channels, CRO, and marketing automation, paired with product or experience ownership.
    • Experience in PE-backed or high-accountability environments where execution is measured, reported, and consequential.
    • Preferred: experience with regulated/accredited or state-approved curriculum and multi-state compliance.
    Required Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Operations, or a related field.
    • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
    Required Technical and Specialized Skills
    • Growth marketing: modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), SEM/paid social, CRO, marketing automation, CRM pipeline management, partnership marketing.
    • Product and learning experience: LMS/experience design, exam-prep tooling, at-risk analytics, engagement/completion optimization, instructor-quality signal management.
    • Regulatory and compliance operations: 50-state approval/filing for RE and appraiser QE, in partnership with Shared Services Legal & Compliance.
    • Unit economics: CAC by channel/state, conversion economics, and contribution margin at the enrollment level.
    • AI-first deployment: acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring), outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), and content AI (authoring with subject-matter-expert validation); ability to size a team AI-first and track adoption as an operating metric.
Colibri Group welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we understand that not every candidate will meet every requirement listed in the job description. Research has shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply to jobs unless they feel they meet every qualification, and we want to actively combat this bias in our hiring process. If you're excited about the role and believe you have the skills and experience to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe that diversity of perspectives and experiences is essential to our success. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another position within our organization. Don't hesitate to take the leap and apply today!

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$106,050—$151,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
