jobs.description:
Campus Staff Minister -- University of Wisconsin, Madison (Graduate and Faculty Ministry)

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Full timeGod has called InterVarsity to plant and to build witnessing communities of students and faculty who follow Jesus on college and university campuses. Through these groups, we believe ever- increasing numbers of students and faculty from all ethnic groups and areas of the campus will be transformed by the Gospel. We expect to see campuses increasingly become places where people, ideas, and structures flourish to the glory of God. We confidently anticipate that our InterVarsity alumni will become change agents across the country and around the world. We pursue this calling by discerning and actively participating in what God is already doing on campus. This is the essence of being a Campus Staff Minister (CSM).

ESSENTIAL COMMITMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Spiritual Growth

As a Campus Staff Minister, you pursue maturity as a disciple of Jesus Christ so that your life and work increasingly reflecta growing love for God, God’s Word, God’s people of every ethnicity and culture, and God’s purposes in the world. To do this, you will:

  • Pursue a vibrant relationship with the triune God through engagement with Scripture, prayer, and worship, both individually and incommunity

  • Develop self-leadership (growing in self-awareness, self-management, relational integrity, andresiliency)

  • Embrace Scriptural standards for behavior andattitudes

CampusLeadership

As a Campus Staff Minister, you increase the number of witnessing communities, as well as the size, health, spiritual maturity, and campus-wide influence of existing witnessing communities of students and faculty by being a:

  • Visionary Guide:

You communicate and model InterVarsity’s vision to see students and faculty transformed, campuses renewed,and world changers developed

  • Create a culture of humble dependence on God and bold expectation in God’s intention to start new witnessing communities throughout the campus and on new campuses

  • Model – in person and through programs – InterVarsity’s vision and Core Values, including a biblically-defined commitment to engage every ethnic and social group on campus

  • Lead students and faculty – individually and collectively – through Scripture, prayer, teaching, and discipleship experiences, so that they articulate and align their ministry activities around this vision

  • Set annual goals through prayer, researchand reflection with your teams (students, faculty, and staff) for qualitative and quantitative growth, including conversions and leadershipdevelopment

  • Structural Architect:

You create, develop, align, and leverage ministry plans, programs, teams, and structures to close the gap between current reality and the aspirational goals.

  • Build leadership teams who trust and partner well with you and who demonstrate spiritual vitality, relational health, and missionalignment

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve annual goals, evaluating and modifyingthe plan as needed throughout the year

  • Increase momentum for the vision by aligning programs, structures, conferences, and teams around the goals

  • Mobilize students and faculty to engage their relational networks with the gospel and to start new missionalcommunities

  • Under the direction of the Area Director, may supervise Ministry Interns and Campus Ministry Interns as delegated

  • Missional Developer:

You intentionally gather, invite, and develop diverse groups of students and faculty sothattheynotonlyencounterandfollowJesusasSaviorandLordbutalsoadvance the mission on campus as participants andleaders.

  • Create ways for faculty and students to encounterand follow Jesus through Scripture, worship, prayer, mission experiences, conferences, etc.

  • Equip students and faculty so that they think strategically about campus engagement and so that they proclaim – in word, deed, and power – the good news of Jesus, regularly inviting students and faculty to follow him as Savior and Lord

  • Disciple students and faculty by equipping them to hear the Word, respond actively, and debrief and interpret the experience so that they grow in Christlikeness, reflect our Core Values, and develop ministryskills

  • Invite, coach, and equip students and faculty to become increasingly effective participants and leaders, including starting new witnessing communities on campuses

Organizational Collaboration

As a Campus Staff Minister, you have joined a national mission. Therefore, you work with a network of other local, area, regional, and national InterVarsity staff and volunteers so that our work reflects Biblical standards of excellence, integrity, and partnership.

  • Partner with and respond positively to the direction and coaching of your supervisors and nationalleaders

  • Contribute to collaborative and productive team meetings and relationships

  • Affiliate chapters under your care and submit Graduating Student Forms in order toincrease our partnership with current students and alumni

  • Use national ministry resources and tools, as requested, including recruiting and/or participatingin local, regional, or national conferences as required

  • Complete reporting, planningand review requirements in a timelyway so that you and your supervisors can assess and improve your work as a CSM

  • Comply with all InterVarsity policies and procedures

Ministry Partnership Development

As a Campus Staff Minister, you will develop a team of partners – churches and individuals (including alumni and community members) – who will resource the ministry financially, in prayer, or volunteer service that advances the mission.

  • Raise 100% of the financial budget assigned by yoursupervisor

  • Communicate regularly with your ministry partners, nurturing the relationship through visits, phone calls, emailsand regular prayer letters

  • Develop on-going, long-lasting partnership with alumni and volunteers

  • Comply with all Ministry PartnershipPolicies

  • Identify and invest in advocates who will build networks of volunteers and donors on InterVarsity’sbehalf

Accomplish all other assigned tasks as appropriate

QUALIFICATIONS (common to all levels of CSM)

  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement (Doctrinal Basis and Purpose Statement). Abide by InterVarsity’s Code of Conduct. Believe and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s Human Sexuality Theological Paper. Affirm and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s “Women in Ministry Statement of Affirmation”

  • Bachelor’s degree requiredfor CSMs assigned to a four-year campus. A minimum of an Associate’sdegree requiredfor CSMs assigned to a two-year campus or a community college

  • Strong interpersonal skills (including ability to minister to diverse ethnic communities and faculty)

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated problem solving skills

  • Familiarity with word processing, presentation, email, and spreadsheetsoftware

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The CSM position leads ministry in a college campus environment. A designated office space may or may not be available. The CSM is required to travel to on-campus and off- campus sites as appropriate. Off-campus travel includes, but is not limited to: student ministry conferences, Ministry Partnership Development meetings, and InterVarsity- sponsored training sessions, meetings, and conferences. The CSM is regularly required to communicate with others, and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

Pay Range: $40,476.00 - $53,952.00 per year

Pay: This position is funded through personal fundraising. Accordingly, compensation will vary based on the ability of the individual to secure a donor team to fund the cost of his/her salary. The anticipated salary range for this position on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) is dependent on a variety of factors, including location and cost of living. The actual salary received,including any geographic adjustment to account for location and cost of living, is subject to the individual’s ability to raise funds necessary to cover the full amount of such salary within the range set forth in the job posting details.

Benefits:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including health care and retirement savings with a match. Eligibility is based on employee type and hours worked. Benefits include the following:

  • 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan

  • 403(b) matching contributions

  • Dental insurance

  • Employee assistance program

  • Employee discounts

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Life insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development assistance

  • Vision insurance

jobs.title: Reconciliation & Payments Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Description﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream MakerThis is a hands-on reconciliation role inside Chargeflow's Billing & Collections team.
jobs.description:
Description

﻿Who We're Looking For - The Dream Maker

This is a hands-on reconciliation role inside Chargeflow's Billing & Collections team. Money comes in from customers of every size — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts — across multiple payment channels, and you are the person who makes sure every payment is matched against what the customer was actually invoiced. It's detailed work, it lives largely in Excel, and getting it right matters.

The core of the job is ownership: you reconcile what a customer owes against what they've paid, you close the loop against the invoice we issued, and you don't let it go until it's genuinely resolved — including chasing an open item well after the month has closed. "It'll probably sort itself out" is not part of the role. If a customer hasn't paid their debt, you stay on it until they have.

You'll work across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or simply wrong — so a critical eye is not optional. You need to be the person who notices that two numbers don't agree and cares enough to find out why. It can be frustrating, but the payoff is real: there's genuine satisfaction in untangling a mess and getting it to tie out.

We're also a company that wants to do this smarter over time. You won't be expected to build automation from day one — but we do want someone who is hungry to turn manual, repetitive work into AI-assisted workflows, with Claude as your day-to-day partner for getting there. The role sits within Billing & Collections and reports to the Billing & Collections Manager.

About Chargeflow

Chargeflow is a leading force in fintech innovation, tackling chargeback fraud and the impact it has on online businesses. Born from a deep passion for technology and eCommerce, we’ve developed an AI-driven solution that helps merchants manage credit card disputes, recover lost revenue, and protect their businesses through a unique success-based model.

Backed by $49M from Viola Growth, OpenView, Sequoia Capital, and other top-tier global investors, Chargeflow is on a product-led growth journey. We’re a tight-knit team of passionate builders and entrepreneurs, united by our mission to revolutionize eCommerce and protect online businesses from chargeback fraud.﻿

What You’ll Own

Reconciliation & Collections

  • Reconcile customer payments against invoices across the full customer base — from small SMB merchants to large Enterprise accounts.
  • Match every incoming payment to what the customer was actually invoiced, and close the loop between the payment received and the invoice issued.
  • Investigate every unmatched, partial, or unexpected item down to root cause — don't leave gaps open.
  • Track what each customer owes, confirm the debt has actually been paid, and follow up until it's fully resolved — including items that carry past month-end.
  • Own your accounts end to end: you're responsible for the reconciliation being clean, correct, and complete, not just started.
  • Keep clear, well-documented working papers so anyone can see how a balance was reached.

Working Across the Systems

  • Do the heavy lifting in Excel — this is a spreadsheet-intensive role (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets).
  • Pull and cross-check data across several systems where the data is often broken, incomplete, or inconsistent.
  • Keep a critical eye at all times — assume the data needs verifying, and dig in when two numbers don't agree.
  • Take real ownership of the details: notice the discrepancy, care about it, and drive it to a clean answer.

Communication & Responsiveness

  • Be responsive to the people who depend on you across the company — Billing, Finance, Operations, and Customer Success.
  • Work fluidly across the channels the business runs on: Slack, monday.com, and email.
  • When it's the fastest way to resolve something, get on a call with a customer and walk them through their reconciliation directly.
  • Explain a billing or reconciliation situation in plain, clear language to someone who isn't in finance.

Making the Work Smarter (Over Time)

  • Look for manual, repetitive steps that shouldn't stay manual — and bring the hunger to improve them.
  • Partner with Claude and other AI tools day-to-day to speed up reconciliation and reduce manual effort as you grow into the role.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in reconciliation, collections, billing, or accounts receivable — ideally in fintech, SaaS, or eCommerce - Must
  • A genuine ownership mindset — you take responsibility for your accounts, go down into the detail, and don't consider something done until it's actually resolved - Must
  • The persistence to stay on an unpaid or unreconciled item until it's closed, including well after month-end — you're not comfortable letting things sit - Must
  • Strong Excel skills — this is a spreadsheet-heavy role (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, large data sets) - Must
  • A critical eye for data — comfortable working across multiple systems where the data is broken or inconsistent, and instinctively verifying rather than assuming - Must
  • Strong attention to detail — able to spot when two numbers don't agree and to work a discrepancy down to zero - Must
  • Responsive and easy to work with — comfortable fielding requests across Slack, monday.com, email, and the occasional customer call - Must
  • Clear communicator — able to explain a reconciliation or billing issue simply to people who aren't in finance, including customers - Must
  • Curious about doing the work smarter — interested in using AI tools (Claude included) to reduce manual effort over time. Prior automation experience is not required - Must
  • Native or near-native English — clear, professional written and verbal communication - Must
  • Comfortable working with customers of all sizes, from SMB to Enterprise - Must
  • Familiarity with chargebacks, payment disputes, or PSP data — an advantage.

How We Work

We move quickly, collaborate across teams, and expect people to take ownership from problem to resolution. We build strong customer relationships through responsiveness, transparency, and measurable results.

This is a full-time, Remote position!

If you’re looking to take ownership of strategic enterprise relationships and directly influence customer retention and growth, we’d love to hear from you.

MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior Ad Designer to own performance creative production end to end for a fast-moving performance marketing agency running 30 active accounts across B2B and B2C.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Ad Designer to own performance creative production end to end for a fast-moving performance marketing agency running 30 active accounts across B2B and B2C. You will take approved copy briefs and turn them into finished, on-brand, production-ready static ad sets across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Reddit — without a creative director having to fix details behind you.

This is a performance role, not a brand role. A plain ad with a sharp idea beats a beautiful ad that does not convert, and that is always the call we make. You will be designing for multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system and hard rules, and you will be expected to catch your own errors before anything goes to review. If you are a senior designer who understands the feed, works cleanly inside someone else's brand system, and produces batches that arrive at review ready to be judged on the idea rather than the execution, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires overlap with US business hours
  • Work across a diverse portfolio of B2B and B2C performance marketing accounts with real creative volume
  • High-ownership design role where your output directly drives paid media performance across 30 active accounts

What You'll Work On

Static Ad Production

  • Take approved copy briefs and design full ad batches in Figma from brief through production-ready delivery
  • Design across multiple accounts simultaneously, each with its own brand system, rules, and creative standards
  • Resize every batch across all required formats including square, 4:5, 9:16, and 1.91:1 for each channel
  • Run the client's QC checklist yourself before anything goes to review — every account has one and you own it
  • Flag when a brief is thin or unclear rather than guessing and absorbing the cost quietly

Figma File Management

  • Build files other people can actually work in — named layers, real text layers, components where they make sense, exports set up correctly
  • Maintain clean, organized Figma files that a creative director or another designer can pick up without confusion
  • Work within established component libraries and brand systems without drifting from them

AI-Generated File Handling

  • Some briefs will arrive with an AI-generated first pass attached — treat it as a reference, not a draft to polish
  • Nothing in an AI-generated file is pre-approved and elements may be off-brand even when they look finished
  • If the file is not editable enough to work with, rebuild it and flag it in the ticket — we need to know whether the workflow is saving time

Project Tracking and Communication

  • Keep your work current in the project tracker including stage, delivery date, and review owner
  • Communicate proactively when timelines are at risk or briefs need clarification
  • Participate in two to three review rounds per batch — notes on concept and direction are expected, notes on font sizes and typos are not

What You Bring

  • Proven senior-level experience designing static performance ads for paid channels including Meta, Google, LinkedIn, or Reddit
  • Strong understanding of what makes an ad stop the scroll and make the offer legible in under two seconds
  • Demonstrated ability to work inside multiple brand systems simultaneously without drifting from any of them
  • Figma at a real working level — auto layout, components, variants, clean export setup, and files other people can use
  • Meticulous attention to detail with the ability to catch your own errors before review
  • Comfortable taking direction from a creative director without needing every decision made for you, and able to push back when a brief is wrong
  • Comfortable working with AI tools as part of the production workflow
  • Meaningful overlap with US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience running performance creative across both B2B and B2C accounts simultaneously
  • Familiarity with tools such as Notion, Slack, , or Higgsfield
  • Background in a performance marketing agency handling high creative volume across multiple client accounts
  • Experience building and maintaining Figma component libraries and brand systems for reuse across accounts

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link showing at least 4 to 6 examples of static performance ads you have designed for paid channels, ideally across more than one brand or account
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, walking through one ad batch you are proud of, and explaining the design decisions you made with performance in mind

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you design ads that stop the scroll, work cleanly inside any brand system, and deliver batches that arrive at review ready to be judged on the idea rather than cleaned up for execution quality, this role gives you the volume and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

jobs.excerpt: Somos o banco BV, uma das maiores instituições financeiras da América Latina, com mais de 37 anos de experiência no mercado.
jobs.description:
Somos o banco BV, uma das maiores instituições financeiras da América Latina, com mais de 37 anos de experiência no mercado. Temos como propósito viabilizar os sonhos e projetos dos nossos clientes, transformando crédito em relacionamento. E pelo segundo ano consecutivo, fomos reconhecidos como a Melhor Instituição Financeira para Trabalhar, segundo o ranking 2025 do GPTW!

 A nossa cultura é ágil, digital e centrada no cliente. Combinamos pessoas e tecnologia para orquestrar e impulsionar as nossas entregas. O nosso crédito não é apenas um número. É relacionamento forte e real.

A Auditoria Interna está transformando a forma como monitora riscos e controles por meio de dados, automações e inteligência artificial. Buscamos um profissional para liderar o desenvolvimento de agentes de IA, soluções analíticas e modelos preditivos, desde a concepção até a implantação em produção.​

A posição oferece a oportunidade de atuar comtecnologias avançadas de IA Generativa, arquiteturas multiagentes, machine learning, engenharia de dados e computação em nuvem, construindo soluções inovadoras com aplicação em toda a organização. Procuramos alguém apaixonado por tecnologia, com perfil hands-on e interesse em explorar o potencial da inteligência artificial em escala corporativa.​

Dá uma olhada nos desafios que te esperam aqui no BV:

    • Conduzir o discovery técnico das iniciativas, alinhando as regras de negócio da auditoria, o escopo e a viabilidade técnica antes de seguir para a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento;​

    • Projetar e implementar sistemas avançados baseados em IA Generativa, utilizando arquiteturas multiagente, frameworks de coordenação (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) e implementações complexas de RAG voltadas à análise documental e regulatória;​

    • Implementar práticas deMLOps e GenAIOps para monitoramento de modelos, versionamento de experimentos, rastreamento de custos e tokens e deploys automatizados via CI/CD;​

    • Estruturar, testar e manter pipelines de tratamento de dados massivos provenientes de bases como o BigQuery, integrando diferentes fontes com Python (Pandas, PySpark) e SQL avançado para alimentar as esteiras de testes preventivos;​

    • Desenvolver, executar e otimizar indicadores estatísticos e analíticos em tempo real, aplicando algoritmos de Machine Learning para detecção de anomalias, desvios operacionais e fraudes;​

    • Construir painéis de monitoramento em tempo real (Grafana e equivalentes) que apoiem os times de auditoria na leitura contínua dos riscos e na comunicação dos achados aos comitês;​

    • Atuar como guardião ético das soluções, conduzindo testes de viés, alucinação, jailbreak e segurança de prompts, e preservando o sigilo investigativo frente às demais linhas de defesa.​

E aí, se identificou? Agora gostaríamos de saber se você tem o perfil e os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Sólida experiência profissional como Cientista de Dados, Engenheiro de Machine Learning ou Engenheiro de IA Sênior;​

  • Domínio avançado de Python, com foco em engenharia de software para IA e desenvolvimento de APIs (FastAPI);​

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações baseadas em LLMs, com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph ou CrewAI, integradas a esteiras de GenAIOps;​

  • Experiência profunda em técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), bancos vetoriais e engenharia de prompts avançada para mitigação de alucinação;​

  • Domínio do ecossistema Google Cloud, com foco em Kubernetes (GKE), Vertex AI (Agent Builder, Model Registry) e Cloud Run;​

  • Conhecimento em soluções de persistência e memória de agentes, com prática em bancos de documentos como Firestore ou Datastore;​

  • Sólido conhecimento de SQL avançado para extração, limpeza e agregação de dados transacionais no BigQuery;​

  • Prática com versionamento de código (Git), testes automatizados e esteiras de CI/CD;​

  • Buscamos alguém com curiosidade e proatividade para testar e validar continuamente novas tecnologias de IA emergentes;​

  • Excelente capacidade analítica e atenção à qualidade do dado e à precisão estatística dos modelos;​

  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis, traduzindo resultados complexos em insights de negócio.​

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia ou áreas afins.​

Pra gente conta como diferencial se você tiver:

    • Experiência prévia no desenvolvimento e monitoramento de soluções analíticas para o setor financeiro ou para áreas de GRC;​

    • Vivência com ferramentas de MLOps e GenAIOps, como MLflow ou Vertex Pipelines, para controle de experimentos;​

    • Observabilidade de sistemas em tempo real: Grafana, Prometheus e OpenTelemetry;​

    • Certificações Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer ou Professional Data Engineer.​

Diversidade e inclusão

* Convidamos pessoas negras, mulheres, profissionais com deficiência, comunidade LGBTQIA+ e pessoas de qualquer idade a conhecerem a gente um pouco mais e a se inscreverem nesta vaga.

About Centific

Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.

About Job

AI Research Engineer: Vision AI / VLM / Physical AI

Company: Centific

Location: Seattle, WA (or Remote)

Type: Full‑time

Build the Future of Perception & Embodied Intelligence

Are you pushing the frontier of computer vision, multimodal large models, and embodied/physical AI—and have the publications to show it? Join us to translate cutting-edge‑ research into production systems that perceive, reason, and act in the real world.

The Mission

We are building state of‑ t‑heart Vision AI across 2D/3D perception, egocentric/360° understanding, and multimodal reasoning. As an AI Research Engineer, you will own high‑ ‑leverage experiments from paper → prototype → deployable module in our platform.

We are seeking passionate Engineersto join our cutting-edge labs, you could be part of :

Computer Vision team as a Research Engineer and dive into the world of 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and visual AI. You’ll explore innovative techniques like those used to transform real-world spaces into immersive 3D models—such as the 3D Reconstruction projects —and work with cutting-edge architectures like VGG-T (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformers), known for advancing deep learning in vision tasks. This role is perfect for those excited to develop AI systems that interpret, reconstruct, and interact with the visual world, using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. Physical AI Robotics team, where you’ll work at the intersection of simulation, robotics, and AI. You’ll leverage NVIDIA’s Omniverse for advanced 3D simulation and collaboration, Isaac Sim for robotics training and testing, and GR00T for foundation models in robotics. Experience with Holoscan SDK for real-time medical and industrial robotics pipelines, Newton Physics for dynamic simulation, and NVIDIA’s NERD for neural robot dynamics will be a plus. This role is ideal for those eager to push the boundaries of AI-driven robotics using state-of-the-art tools and frameworks.

What You’ll Do

  • Advance Visual Perception: Build and fine‑tune models for detection, tracking, segmentation (2D/3D), pose & activity recognition, and scene understanding (incl. 360° and multi‑view).
  • Multimodal Reasoning with VLMs: Train/evaluate vision–language models (VLMs) for grounding, dense captioning, temporal QA, and tooluse; design retrieval‑ augmented and agentic loops for perception‑ action‑ tasks.
  • Physical AI & Embodiment: Prototype perception‑in‑the‑loop policies that close the gap from pixels to actions (simulation + real data). Integrate with planners and task graphs for manipulation, navigation, or safety workflows.
  • Data & Evaluation at Scale: Curate datasets, author high‑signal evaluation protocols/KPIs, and run ablations that make results irreproducible impossible.
  • Systems & Deployment: Package research into reliable services on a modern stack (Kubernetes, Docker, Ray, FastAPI), with profiling, telemetry, and CI for reproducible science.
  • Agentic Workflows: Orchestrate multi-agent pipelines (e.g., ‑LangGraphstyle graphs) that combine perception, reasoning, simulation, and ‑codeg eneration to ‑selfc heck and ‑selfcorrect‑.

Example Problems You Might Tackle

  • Long horizon‑ video understanding (events, activities, causality) from egocentric or 360° video.
  • 3D scene grounding: linking language queries to objects, affordances, and trajectories.
  • Fast, privacy preserving perception for ‑ondevice‑ or edge inference.
  • Robust multi‑modal evaluation: temporal consistency, open‑set detection, uncertainty.
  • Vision conditioned‑ policy evaluation in sim (Isaac/MuJoCo) with sim2real stress tests.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Masters/Ph.D in CS/EE/Robotics (or related), actively publishing in CV/ML/Robotics (e.g., CVPR/ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, CoRL/RSS).
  • Strong PyTorch (or JAX) and Python; comfort with CUDA profiling and mixed precision‑ training.
  • Demonstrated research in computer vision and at least one of: VLMs (e.g., LLaVA style, video‑ language‑ models), embodied/physical AI, 3D perception.
  • Proven ability to move from paper → code → ablation → result with rigorous experiment tracking.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with video models (e.g., TimeSFormer/MViT/VideoMAE), diffusion or 3D GS/NeRF pipelines, or SLAM/scene reconstruction.
  • Prior work on multimodal grounding (referring expressions, spatial language, affordances) or temporal reasoning.
  • Familiarity with ROS2, DeepStream/TAO, or edge inference optimizations (TensorRT, ONNX).
  • Scalable training: Ray, distributed data loaders, sharded checkpoints.
  • Strong software craft: testing, linting, profiling, containers, and reproducibility.
  • Public code artifacts (GitHub) and first‑author publications or strong open source‑ impact.

Our Stack (you’ll touch a subset)

  • Modeling: PyTorch, torchvision/lightning, Hugging Face, OpenMMLab, xFormers
  • Perception: YOLO/Detectron/MMDet, SAM/Mask2Former, CLIP‑style backbones, optical flow
  • VLM / LLM: Vision encoders + LLMs, RAG for video, toolformer‑/agent loops
  • 3D / Sim: Open3D, PyTorch3D, Isaac/MuJoCo, COLMAP/SLAM, NeRF/3DGS
  • Systems: Python, FastAPI, Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, Triton/TensorRT, Weights & Biases
  • Pipelines: LangGraph‑like orchestration, data versioning, artifact stores

What Success Looks Like

  • A publishable or open‑sourced outcome (with company approval) or a production‑ready module that measurably moves a product KPI (latency, accuracy, robustness).
  • Clean, reproducible code with documented ablations and an evaluation report that a teammate can rerun end‑to‑end.
  • A demo that clearly communicates capabilities, limits, and next steps.

Why Centific

  • Real impact: Your research ships—powering core features in our MVPs and products.
  • Mentorship: Work closely with our Principal Architect and senior engineers/researchers.
  • Velocity + Rigor: We balance top‑tier research practices with pragmatic product focus.

Salary: $180,000-$240,000 + OTB

Centific is an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, familial status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Born from a Department of Defense partnership and trusted by leaders across government and enterprise, Legion embeds intelligence inside complex systems, unlocking data, accelerating human workflows, and strengthening mission-critical systems. We don’t replace workflows—we optimize them, ensuring quality, efficiency, and reliability inside the platforms our partners already use.

With world-class collaborators like Palantir, Nvidia, HPE, and Oracle, we’re building intelligent infrastructure that enhances human capability and drives impact at the edge and across a range of enterprises.

We’re looking for bold thinkers and doers to join us in shaping the future of AI that’s secure, grounded, and built to work.

Creative Director (Remote US)

***You will set the creative bar in, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets***

***Required: A link to your online portfolio or a PDF upload of your work samples is required to be considered for this role. (see options below to provide link or upload***

The Role

Legion produces a steady and growing stream of creative across brand, demand, product, web, social, video, and events. We are bringing that creative capability in-house and closer to the team, and rebuilding it as an AI-native creative function, while keeping our agency partner for the largest and most specialized bets. As Creative Director, you are the hands-on operating core of that function: the senior creative who sets the bar, ships the work, and builds the prompts, templates, and playbooks that let a lean team produce like a much larger one.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role to start, a player-coach who makes the work. You will report to the SVP of Marketing and partner first across the marketing team, including Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital Marketing, and PR. You will work closely with the Product team on product design direction and in-product visuals, and with GTM and Sales on enablement and customer-facing materials. You will build and manage a small flex bench of designers and specialists over time, with limited contractor support to start.

Why This Role Matters

Legion’s work spans national security, defense, intelligence, the public sector, critical infrastructure, and the national research labs, work that often matters most where it cannot be discussed. The creative function you build is how that mission becomes legible to the people who need to understand it. You will be building the creative infrastructure that lets Legion tell a hard, important story at the speed the moment demands.

Legion is a remote-first company and an equal opportunity employer. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a culture built on ownership, discipline, and mission. To apply, submit your resume along with a portfolio or work samples.

You will work at two levels at once

  • At the craft level, setting the creative bar and personally shipping the highest-priority brand, campaign, product, and web work.
  • At the systems level, building the machine-readable brand, prompts, and AI-native workflows that make on-brand speed the default for the whole team.

The way we build for customers is the way you will build here: a human sets intent, AI does the heavy lifting, and a human approves what ships. This is a builder’s seat, not a brand-police seat. If you want to define how a modern, AI-native marketing team creates, ships, governs, and scales creative work, this is that role.

What You Will Own

Creative Direction and Hands-On Execution

  • Set the creative bar across brand, web, campaigns, events, social, video, and sales materials, and personally design and produce the highest-priority work. This is a hands-on role first, a player-coach who still makes the work.
  • Translate complex AI, agent orchestration, edge, and national security concepts into clear, credible visual systems.

Campaign and Go-to-Market Creative

  • Partner with Federal Marketing, Demand Marketing, and Product Marketing on demand generation, ABM, launches, education, and field events.
  • Build modular campaign systems, landing pages, social assets, email graphics, sales collateral, and executive materials that scale across channels and audiences.

AI-Native Creative Systems

  • Use frontier models and AI creative tools daily to build repeatable workflows that compound over time, across video, campaign kits, landing pages, social, product visuals, and decks.
  • Turn Legion’s brand into machine-readable infrastructure: reusable prompts, templates, kits, and playbooks, with human review at the brief and the final gate, plus clear guardrails for AI tooling, IP, and brand safety.

Creative Operations and the Flex Bench

  • Build and manage a flexible bench of freelance designers, motion and video specialists, and other contractors from the ground up, deploying them for surges and specialty work as demand grows.
  • Own intake, prioritization, briefs, review rituals, and clear SLAs from brief to first concept to shipped asset.

Product Design Support

  • Partner with the Product team to help set visual design direction that brings the product in line with the Legion brand, raising the baseline polish of apps, Spaces, and features so the product looks as credible as it is capable.
  • Oversee and produce product and in-product visual support: icons, diagrams, app imagery, feature visuals, and lightweight in-product creative.

Performance and Measurement

  • Run creative as a measurable loop, from brief to shipped asset to performance read to the next iteration, in close partnership with Demand Marketing and Marketing Operations.
  • Use performance signals to sharpen concepts, formats, and priorities, without letting short-term optimization erode brand quality.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in creative, brand design, art direction, or creative services, in high-growth technology, AI, B2B SaaS, or similarly complex and technical markets, with real hands-on production and not just oversight.
  • A portfolio that shows range and craft across brand, campaign, web, social, video, and product or technical storytelling, with both concept and execution.
  • Daily, advanced use of AI in the creative process: frontier models such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, and AI design, image, and video tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway, Google Veo, Sora, and ElevenLabs. You use AI to raise both speed and quality, and you turn what works into reusable systems others can run, from prompts and templates to kits and workflows.
  • Creative coding and prototyping. You can turn a concept into a working prototype using design-to-code and AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Figma Make, v0 by Vercel.
  • A track record of turning brand guidelines into systems that others can run: reusable prompts, templates, kits, or workflows.
  • Experience building, hiring, and managing a freelance or contractor bench, not just briefing existing vendors. You have stood up and run flexible creative capacity and scaled it as demand moved.
  • Hands-on motion and video production. You can storyboard, edit, and ship demo clips, launch videos, social cuts, and event loops, with tools such as Premiere, After Effects, Descript, and AI-assisted video.
  • Product and in-product visual support. You can produce icons, diagrams, app imagery, feature visuals, and lightweight in-product creative, and partner closely with Product Design.
  • Strong command of Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, with the range to pick the right tool for the job.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and a high-ownership, low-ego, fast-moving style. You build the best available draft and invite reaction rather than waiting for perfect information.

Preferred

  • Experience in defense, national security, intelligence, national labs, critical infrastructure, public sector, or other regulated, high-consequence industries.
  • Experience with ABM, demand generation, product launches, or full-funnel B2B campaigns.
  • Experience with lightweight web tools such as Webflow or Framer.
  • Experience building AI brand kits or machine-readable brand guidance that other people adopted.

Ready to be a Titan?

We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability & Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale.

We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us.


What You'll Do

  • Participate in an on-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load).

  • Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

  • Operate and improve our Kubernetes-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure.

  • Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems.

  • Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root-cause analysis and follow-up remediation work.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship.

  • Build and maintain automation that reduces manual, repetitive operational work across the team.

  • Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person.

  • Help define non-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed.

  • Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability.

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly.


What You'll Bring

  • Kubernetes (must-have): strong, hands-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system.

  • SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions.

  • Cloud engineering & networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing).

  • Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools.

  • CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable.

  • Strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in.

  • Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures).

  • Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure.

  • 8-10+ years of relevant hands-on experience.

  • Nice-to-have: database experience (not mandatory — databases are monitored by the same team, not owned individually).

About You

You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business-critical, large-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas.

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. jobs.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.description:
About Pear Suite

Pear Suite is an early-stage digital health company building software for community-based care. Our care navigation platform equips community health workers, doulas, care navigators, and the organizations that support them with tools to collect, visualize, and act on social determinants of health data. We help community-based organizations, health systems, and government-funded care programs deliver more coordinated, person-centered care.

Why Pear Suite?

We’re a mission-driven team committed to health equity and innovation in community-based care. You’ll thrive here if you’re eager to take initiative, value autonomy, and enjoy building structure where none exists. Join us to build scalable, human-centered technology that empowers frontline workers and improves lives across the U.S.

About the role

As Community Marketing Specialist, you'll own the development of Pear Suite's Community Health Worker (CHW) community across the entire customer lifecycle, from acquisition and activation to retention and engagement. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Customer Success, and Sales to create meaningful experiences for CHWs, the community-based organizations (CBOs) they work within, and the payers and healthcare organizations we partner with.

What you'll do

Community Growth & Acquisition

  • Develop and execute acquisition strategies across organic, referral, partnership, influencer sourcing, and paid channels
  • Grow strategic segments aligned with business priorities, including Community Health Workers (CHWs), community-based organizations (CBOs), payers, and healthcare organizations
  • Manage CHW sourcing initiatives and optimize acquisition performance through data-driven insights
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and community health behaviors to continuously improve acquisition strategy

Customer Engagement & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Partner with Marketing Communications to build and optimize activation, education, and retention strategies across the CHW journey
  • Manage CRM lifecycle campaigns in HubSpot to onboard, activate, educate, and re-engage CHW customers
  • Develop community initiatives that activate ambassadors through webinars, newsletters, events, and educational campaigns

Meaningful Social Media Content

  • Partner with Communications on creative social media strategies that support community growth and engagement
  • Co-create CHW-focused campaigns across acquisition, education, and activation, leveraging compelling community storytelling across social channels
  • Align community initiatives, CRM lifecycle campaigns, and social media content to maximize CHW engagement and business impact

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to channel community feedback into product improvements and meaningful new features
  • Produce community insights, reports, and recommendations to support business decisions

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3-4 years of experience in community management, influencer marketing, CRM, or growth marketing. Experience building community in music, entertainment, hospitality, or for national consumer brands like Starbucks is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of influencer marketing, social media platforms, and community engagement strategies
  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, and reporting
  • Data-driven mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations
  • Strong oral presentation and communication skills
  • Super-agile, self-motivated, and capable of working remotely with limited oversight
  • Passion for community health, impact, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing
  • Share an ambition for building cultures, movements, and brands you can be passionate about
  • Bachelor's degree required in related fields

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with the tools we use: Slack, Google Workspace, Claude, Adobe, and Canva
  • Familiarity with community health or social determinants of health (SDOH) landscape
  • MBA or degree in Business, Advertising, or Marketing

Benefits and Perks

  • A mission driven culture that values innovation, collaboration and growth
  • Equity: participation in an early-stage company
  • Fully Remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Comprehensive Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Health and Wellness Stipend
  • Tech Stipend
  • Co-working Stipend
  • Education and professional development allowance ($1,500 annually)
  • Home office setup stipend

Compensation

  • The salary range for this role is $80,000-$95,000.

Compensation Range Disclosure

Pear Suite posts broad salary bands to support pay transparency. The range listed above represents the full compensation band for this role.

While the full band is shown, actual offers within this band are based on a candidate's experience, skills, and internal pay equity. Only a small number of candidates, typically those with highly specialized and directly relevant experience, are placed near the top of the range. Most new hires will fall below the top of the band to allow for long-term progression and growth within the role.

Pear Suite is a fully remote organization so compensation may be adjusted upward for candidates residing in higher-cost labor markets. These geographic adjustments are not reflected in the posted range.
