jobs.title: Intern - Product Strategy
jobs.excerpt: A Career at HARMAN As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better.
jobs.description:
A Career at HARMAN


As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better. Innovation, inclusivity and teamwork are a part of our DNA. When you add that to the challenges we take on and solve together, you’ll discover that at HARMAN you can grow, make a difference and be proud of the work you do every day.

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Pay Transparency

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in your health and wellbeing and offers benefits designed to support your wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your relationship with HARMAN, and may include paid sick leave and medical benefits.

HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard torace, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.excerpt: WHY DEPT®? We are pioneers at heart.  What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today.
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

About You

The Associate Director, Programmatic is responsible for leading the deployment function for one of our largest enterprise clients, ensuring programmatic strategies are translated into flawlessly executed campaigns at scale. Working in close partnership with our Strategy/Performance team in programmatic, Ad Ops, and Delivery teams, this role oversees the people, processes, and operational standards required to build, launch, optimize, and maintain complex enterprise media programs.

This role serves as the senior day-to-day leader for the deployment team, overseeing Managers and Associates across a distributed team structure while fostering a culture of accountability, precision, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The Associate Director is expected to be both a strong people leader and a hands-on programmatic expert, capable of driving deployment excellence, establishing scalable operational frameworks, and maintaining best-in-class quality standards across all campaigns. This role is also responsible for identifying, developing, and scaling AI-enabled workflows that improve deployment efficiency, quality assurance, operational consistency, and team productivity.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of campaign architecture, platform implementation, quality assurance, launch management, and optimization execution. The Associate Director will act as the primary owner of deployment governance, ensuring media is built correctly, launched efficiently, and optimized accurately across all platforms within the programmatic ecosystem.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Managers and Associates across U.S.-based, nearshore, and offshore teams, fostering professional growth, accountability, and a high-performing team culture.
  • Partner closely with the Strategy/Performance and Ad Ops teams to translate strategy into execution and ensure optimizations are implemented accurately and efficiently.
  • Own the successful deployment lifecycle across all campaigns within your team's remit, overseeing campaign build, trafficking, QA, launch, optimization implementation, and post-launch validation to ensure accurate, efficient, and high-quality execution.
  • Lead campaign architecture and account structure development, establishing scalable frameworks that support performance, reporting, optimization, and operational excellence.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for deployment challenges, launch risks, tracking discrepancies, platform troubleshooting, and operational issues while maintaining governance standards, quality assurance processes, and deployment best practices across the account.
  • Identify, test, and operationalize AI-powered solutions that streamline campaign deployment, quality assurance, project management, documentation, and optimization workflows across the team.
  • Lead internal project management across programmatic deployment efforts, developing deployment roadmaps, launch calendars, implementation checklists, and operational documentation that support timely, scalable, and error-free delivery.
  • Collaborate effectively across functional departments, including Ad Operations, Data Science & Analytics, Integrated Media Strategy & Planning, Project Management, and other media craft teams to deliver seamless campaign execution.
  • Continuously identify, build, and scale process improvements, automation, and AI-enabled workflows that enhance deployment velocity, quality assurance, documentation, operational efficiency, and overall team effectiveness.
  • Promote DEPT®'s values while creating an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports learning, innovation, and growth.

You’ll need:

  • 5–7 years of programmatic media experience within an agency environment, including experience supporting large, complex, enterprise-level clients.
  • Advanced proficiency across leading programmatic platforms, including The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP, and Google Ads. Deep expertise in Google Ads and YouTube is required for this role.
  • Deep expertise in campaign architecture, account structure development, media deployment, quality assurance, trafficking, launch management, and optimization implementation.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to coach, influence, and create opportunities for others to grow.
  • Extensive experience managing complex deployment workflows across multiple stakeholders, timelines, and workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles, operational planning, launch governance, and process development within enterprise media environments.
  • Confident mastery of campaign troubleshooting, measurement validation, tracking verification, and quality assurance across complex programmatic campaigns.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust, stay organized, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • A "get sh*t done" mentality when it comes to solving operational challenges, removing blockers, and driving execution forward.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks, improve processes, and translate technical details into actionable recommendations.
  • A collaborative, curious, and solutions-oriented approach aligned with DEPT®'s values and culture. to have:

Additional things that will impress us:

  • Trello or Project Management experience
  • Natural curiosity around AI and automation, with a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities to transform operational workflows through practical application of emerging technologies.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

The anticipated salary range for this position is listed below. Salary is based on a range of factors that include relevant experience, expertise, physical location, and organizational impact. This is based on a 40-hour workweek and leveling. Keep in mind, we’re flexible.

jobs.title: B2B Cold Caller and Appointment Setter
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

This paragraph summarizes the general nature, level and purpose of the job.

Under general direction Senior Accountant is responsible for the more complex activities associated with maintaining general ledger accounts and for developing financial statements and reports. Performs diverse and specialized assignments, in assigned area of expertise, in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. Exercises judgment within broadly defined practices and policies in selecting methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. May determine methods and procedures on new assignments and may provide guidance to other lower level personnel.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The essential functions listed are typical examples of work performed by positions in this job classification. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities. Employees may also perform other duties as assigned.

Employees must abide by all Joint Commission Requirements including but not limited to sensitivity to cultural diversity, patient care, patient rights and ethical treatment, safety and security of physical environments, emergency management, teamwork, respect for others, participation in ongoing education and training, communication and adherence to safety and quality programs, sustaining compliance with National Patient Safety Goals, and licensure and health screenings.

Must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the hospital's policies and procedures, including its Service Standards and its Code of Conduct.

  • Assists in monthly, quarterly and annual period close process, as assigned.

    * Designs, implements and maintains internal controls, reports for financial systems and interfaces.

    * Prepares and/or reviews account reconciliations, cost reports, billings, bank reconciliations and various other financial reports, as assigned.

    * Provides information to auditors and management as needed; prepares audit schedules as necessary.

    * Recommends procedures and implements corrective action wherever indicated in operations, areas out of compliance with hospital policy, internal controls and accounting policies, as assigned.

    * Reviews and/or prepares federal, state and other regulatory reports, ensuring compliance with established guidelines, as assigned.

    * Reviews and/or prepares financial transaction and/or general ledger journal entries and supporting documentation for approved financial transactions journals to ensure their accuracy and takes necessary action to correct any errors.

    * Reviews, maintains, reconciles and updates general ledger accounts, as assigned.
  • Take ownership and accountability over accurate and timely financial reporting to stakeholders.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Any combination of education and experience that would likely provide the required knowledge, skills and abilities as well as possession of any required licenses or certifications is qualifying.

Education: Bachelor's degree in a work-related field/discipline from an accredited college or university.

Experience: Three (3) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

KNOWLEDGE

These are the observable and measurable attributes and skills required to perform successfully the essential functions of the job and are generally demonstrated through qualifying experience, education or licensure/certification.

  • Ability to analyze and develop solutions to complex problems.

    * Ability to apply judgment and informed decisions.

    * Ability to communicate complex concepts in simple form to non-finance users to understand the appropriate use and limits of the information provided.

    * Ability to communicate effective in written and verbal formats including summarizing data, presenting results.

    * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.

    * Ability to manage, organize, prioritize, multi-task and adapt to changing priorities.

    * Ability to work effectively both as a team player and leader.

    * Knowledge of computer systems and software used in accounting.

    * Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.

    * Knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

    * Knowledge of local, state and federal regulatory requirement related to the functional area.

    * Knowledge of regulatory requirements for GAAP, tax issues, and financial reporting.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., Workday), along with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Platforms, specifically Power Automate and Power BI.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The Physical Requirements and Working Conditions in which the job is typically performed are available from the Occupational Health Department. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Pay Range
Compensation is based on the level and requirements of the role.
Salary within our ranges may also be determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, and abilities, as required by the role, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.
Typically, new team members join at the minimum to mid salary range.
Minimum to Midpoint Range (Hourly): $48.02 to $62.43

Stanford Medicine Children's Health (SMCH) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SMCH does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements, and where applicable, in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

At Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford, we know world-renowned care begins with world-class caring. That's why we combine advanced technologies and breakthrough discoveries with family-centered care. It's why we provide our caregivers with continuing education and state-of-the-art facilities, like the newly remodeled Lucile Packard Children's Hospital Stanford. And it's why we need caring, committed people on our team - like you. Join us on our mission to heal humanity, one child and family at a time.

Work Arrangement / Work Shift: Remote Set-up

Role Overview:

We are seeking a detail-oriented NetSuite Consultant. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical capabilities by analyzing client requirements, mapping them to NetSuite functionalities, and managing data migration. You will collaborate closely with technical teams and Project Managers to deliver customized solutions on time and within budget, will drive customer adoption through comprehensive training and provide ongoing post-go-live support to ensure long-term client success.

What Youll Be Doing:

  • Engage with customers to thoroughly document and validate their business requirements.
  • Map these requirements to NetSuite functionalities, ensuring a comprehensive understanding.
  • Analyze diverse data factors to address complex business challenges.
  • Utilize strong analytical and problem-solving skills to propose effective solutions.
  • Customize the NetSuite application to align with specific customer business requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to design and test customizations tailored to different domains.
  • Conduct walkthrough sessions to train customers effectively on NetSuite usage.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, Project Managers, and colleagues to ensure timely and on-budget project delivery.
  • Provide post Go-Live support, addressing day-to-day concerns in specialized areas.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction and successful implementation outcomes.
  • Manage data migration tasks, ensuring seamless transitions during implementations.
  • Handle data migration tasks to ensure a smooth transition during the implementation phase.

What Youll Need:

  • 3+ years of proven experience as a NetSuite Functional Consultant.
  • Expertise in configuring and customizing the NetSuite application.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for addressing diverse business challenges.
  • Experience conducting customer training sessions and providing ongoing support in specialized areas.
  • Proficient in data migration tasks and post Go-Live support activities.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.

Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc. is a specialized remote staffing and IT offshoring firm based in the Philippines, providing vetted, high-quality Filipino talent to global tech startups, SMEs, and consulting firms, focusing heavily on niche areas like ERP (NetSuite), Accounting and Finance and IT, offering integrated recruiting, upskilling, and HR support to ensure high retention and reliable offshore teams.

Atticus provides a comprehensive solution for international companies to build dedicated, outsourced teams and efficiently scale their technical and administrative capabilities by leveraging skilled Filipino talent, managed with a focus on quality and long-term retention. We ensure the teams perform like extensions of the clients own operations.

Who We Are:

We are a customer-focused organization that puts people at the heart of everything we do. We believe great outcomes come from strong collaboration, where ideas are openly shared and teamwork is valued.

Our team members are proactive and confident—they take ownership, speak up, and are not afraid to ask questions. We encourage curiosity and continuous improvement, empowering everyone to challenge the status quo and find better ways of working.

We foster a growth mindset, where learning is continuous, feedback is welcomed, and mistakes are seen as opportunities to grow. Here, you are supported to develop your skills, improve processes, and make a meaningful impact.

Why Join Us:

At Atticus Advisory Solutions Inc, we value our employees and provide a positive and collaborative work environment. We offer competitive compensation, benefits, annual leaves, health and medical insurances. Our culture offers flexible working arrangement and opportunities for growth and development.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Avid Learning is seeking a Learning Content Specialist to help develop, edit, maintain, and modernize educational content for media professionals, educators, students, and enterprise customers worldwide.

This role combines instructional content development, technical editing, software validation, and AI-assisted content creation. The Learning Content Specialist will work closely with product experts, certified instructors, subject matter experts, and internal stakeholders to create engaging learning experiences across Avid's certification programs, instructor-led training, self-paced learning, and digital learning platforms.

As Avid expands its use of AI-assisted content development, this position will play a critical role in ensuring all content remains accurate, technically sound, instructionally effective, and aligned with real-world workflows. Candidates must be comfortable reviewing AI-generated content, validating procedures within Avid software applications, and refining educational materials to meet Avid Learning's quality standards.

The ideal candidate is passionate about education, media technology, storytelling, and helping others develop professional skills.

Key Responsibilities

Content Development

  • Create and maintain educational content for Avid Learning programs
  • Develop student guides, instructor guides, assessments, exercises, learning activities, and online training materials
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging learning experiences
  • Collaborate with instructors, product teams, and subject matter experts to develop new courses and certifications
  • Contribute to course updates associated with major software releases and new product offerings

Content Editing & Quality Assurance

  • Review and edit learning content for clarity, consistency, accuracy, and instructional effectiveness
  • Verify software workflows and procedures through hands-on testing
  • Validate exercises, assessments, and instructional materials before publication
  • Maintain content standards across all Avid Learning offerings
  • Identify and correct technical inaccuracies, outdated procedures, and workflow issues

AI-Assisted Content Development

  • Utilize AI-powered tools to accelerate content creation and maintenance
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated instructional content
  • Test AI-generated procedures directly within Avid applications to ensure accuracy
  • Help establish best practices for responsible and effective use of AI in educational content development
  • Continuously improve workflows that combine AI efficiency with human expertise

Learning Platform Support

  • Prepare content for deployment within Avid Learning Central and other learning platforms
  • Assist with content organization, metadata, accessibility, and learner experience improvements
  • Support ongoing content modernization initiatives and certification program enhancements

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Work closely with Avid Certified Instructors, Learning Partners, product managers, engineers, and content developers

  • Research emerging industry workflows and educational technologies
  • Recommend improvements to learning content, assessments, and delivery methods

Required

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Ability to independently research, verify, and validate technical information
  • Experience creating, editing, or maintaining technical, educational, or instructional content
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Avid Media Composer Specialist certification or ability to obtain certification within six months of hire
  • Avid Pro Tools Specialist certification or ability to obtain certification within six months of hire
  • Experience using Media Composer and/or Pro Tools in professional, educational, or production environments
  • Experience with instructional design, technical writing, curriculum development, or educational publishing
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) platforms
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted writing, editing, and content development tools
  • Experience with video production, audio production, post-production, broadcast, or media technology workflows
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Communications, Media Production, Technical Writing, Instructional Design, or a related field

jobs.description:
About Our Job

Customer Service Agent

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $21.26 and $26.57. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 457B Retirement Plan
  • 140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location & Schedule

The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model, however, this position with the Denver Human Services Call Center is currently working remotely Full Time. A hybrid model may be reinstated. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their telecommuting days. Please note that the schedule for this position is Monday-Friday 8:00am-4:30pm.

Who We Are & What You’ll Do

At Denver Human Services (DHS), we envision a healthy community where people are connected, supported, safe, and well. One in three people in Denver turn to DHS for support at all stages of life. Our employees help children, at-risk adults, families, and individuals navigate social and economic pressures by connecting them to services and experts who support their overall well-being.

Denver Human Services (DHS) is currently seeking a passionate, bilingual (preferred not required), and dedicated individual to serve as a Customer Service Representative in the DHS Call Center. As a Customer Service Representative, you will perform comprehensive and technical customer service through high volume phone calls for the Family and Adult Assistance Division (FAAD). Call Center employees will be required to handle a minimum of 65-80 incoming calls per day from new and current clients receiving benefits through FAAD assistance programs.

The Family and Adult Assistance Division has a dedicated staff that listens, advises, and helps people apply for public assistance programs. In addition, they help connect people to community resources that can help them in a time of need.

Specifically, as a Customer Service Agent you will:

  • Provide comprehensive customer service, in a contact center environment, by responding to a variety of complex customer requests for information on programs and services offered by Denver Human Services (DHS)
  • Assist customers with inquiries or problems related to DHS programs and services by asking questions to determine customer needs; determines the critical nature of a call and if immediate action is required
  • Create or accesses cases in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) module of PeopleSoft to enter information on customer inquiries or problems and to provide updates on previously created cases; enters resolutions provided to customers and assigns cases or creates service orders for various partner departments and agencies
  • Conduct research, using the Colorado Benefits Management System (CBMS), to provide customers with answers to inquiries or problems
  • Provide complete and accurate information to customers, which involves identifying customer needs and explaining applicable regulations, policies, procedures or standards based on a comprehensive knowledge of DHS procedures, programs, services, and CBMS
  • Act as a liaison between the customer and DHS staff by following up on customer requests or complaints and solving problems related to service issues; possesses the authority to resolve discrepancies in DDHS provided services
  • Observe and complies with departmental policies and procedures, customer service quality standards and compliance guidelines
  • Receive on-going training and updates on changes in the operations of departments and agencies; participates in opportunities to cross train with staff in partner departments and agencies to learn procedures and services
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

  • A high level of proficiency using Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • At least two years of experience in high-pressure, quality-oriented professional environments
  • Ability to read, understand, interpret, and apply complex regulations
  • Previous high-volume data-entry experience
  • Bilingual is a plus. Able to read, write, and speak proficiently in both Spanish and English

Required Minimum Qualifications

Education requirement: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.

Experience Requirement: Two (2) years customer service experience in a call center environment.

Education/Experience Equivalency: Additional appropriate education may be substituted for the minimum experience requirements.

License/Certifications: None

Application Deadline

This position is expected to stay open until September 7. Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than September 7 at 11:59 PM.

  • Support deal reviews by validating pricing, profitability, and commercial assumptions before deals advance.

Experience:

Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions.
  • Lead incident response and resolution for production issues, acting as a calm and effective incident commander when needed, and ensuring high-quality post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tooling so that operators have rich, actionable visibility into system behavior.
  • Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation.
  • Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation.
  • Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes.
  • Design CI/CD pipelines that promote safe, frequent, and observable releases, supported by automated testing, canary deployments, feature flags, and progressive rollout strategies.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening.
  • Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization on SRE practices and foster a strong, blameless culture of operational excellence.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be. We believe that mobility is the gateway to opportunity—connecting people to housing, education, employment, commerce, and care. By making transportation more accessible, affordable, and sustainable, we empower communities to thrive and unlock economic and social prosperity.

Our mission is to revolutionize transit with a solution that delivers high capacity, exceptional user experiences, unmatched affordability, and minimal environmental impact.

The Glydways system is a groundbreaking network of carbon-neutral, interconnected transit pathways powered by standardized autonomous vehicles on dedicated roadways. Operating 24/7 with on-demand access, it offers personalized and efficient mobility—without the burden of heavy upfront infrastructure costs or ongoing taxpayer subsidies.

With Glydways, we’re building more than a transportation system; we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere, has the freedom to move.

Meet the team:

The Vehicle Platform Engineering Team is responsible for the design, validation, and delivery of the Glydways Autonomous Transit Vehicle hardware to align with the installation of the Glydways mass transit system. The team works with internal engineering and vendors and is responsible to deliver a vehicle design that generates a fantastic experience for customers while meeting mass transit regulations and all performance criteria. The team works cross functionally with product design (Similar to studio engineering or product requirement team), test validation, external suppliers, and prototype and production manufacturers to design, develop, and build a unique vehicle architecture.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical roadmap and product delivery for Glydways door and closure systems, including structures, mechanisms, rails, latches, seals, actuators, sensors, interfaces, electrical & electronic systems, and related software.
  • Translate vehicle-level requirements into closure-system requirements, architectures, design decisions, verification plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead the design and integration of complex mechanisms, including kinematics, actuator selection, latch and hinge integration, packaging, tolerance definition, and interface management.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across mechanical, electrical, software, systems, product, safety, validation, manufacturing, quality, industrial design, and operations teams.
  • Coordinate technical work with external engineering, manufacturing partners and suppliers, across Japan, the United States, and Europe.
  • Lead prototype builds, vehicle integration, durability testing, root-cause investigations, design iterations, and production-readiness activities within a demanding development and build schedule.
  • Anticipate manufacturing, assembly, service, quality, reliability, and cost challenges through design-for-manufacturability and design-for-assembly practices.
  • Establish effective processes for requirements, issue tracking, design reviews, change management, documentation, and decision-making.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Significant experience developing automotive closures or complex mechanical and electromechanical systems through multiple product-development stages; sliding-door experience is highly valuable.
  • Strong understanding of mechanism design, kinematics, actuators, latches, hinges, seals, tolerance management, design verification, and reliability.
  • Experience collaborating with suppliers, manufacturing partners, and cross-functional teams in automotive, mobility, robotics, aerospace, or a similar complex-product environment.
  • Strong communication, organization, judgment, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently in an ambiguous and rapidly changing international and multicultural environment.
  • Experience taking a closure system or complex mechanism from concept through sourcing, validation, production, and launch.
  • Working knowledge of design for manufacturability, design for assembly, GD&T, tolerance analysis, FMEA, and quality-planning methods.
  • Experience with CATIA, 3DX, or comparable CAD and PLM tools, at least DMU-level proficiency; experience using CAE tools for product development is a plus.
  • Professional fluency in English; Japanese language skills are a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally, including extended collaboration or assignments in Japan and the United States, as business needs require.

Noodle is higher education’s leading strategy, services, and technology partner. We develop infrastructure, provide life-changing learning experiences, and grow the awareness of and the enrollment in some of the best academic institutions in the world. Our vision is “to empower universities to change the world.” We achieve this vision by offering our university partners various products and services that help them be more resilient, responsive, efficient, and interconnected.

We’re looking for a Prompt Systems Engineer to sit at the intersection of AI capability and educational effectiveness. You will own the design, testing, and continuous improvement of the prompts and system instructions that power Noodle’s AI agents across enrollment, learning, and student support use cases.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You’ll work directly with product managers, learning designers, university stakeholders, and engineers to translate operational and pedagogical goals and business requirements into agent behavior — and you’ll build the evaluation frameworks to prove that behavior is working.

As a Prompt Systems Engineer, you will:

Prompt Design & Engineering

  • Write, iterate, and maintain system prompts and instruction sets for Noodle’s AI agents focused on students enrollment, learning, and retention

  • Translate complex educational and operational requirements into clear, reliable agent behavior — including persona definition, tone, scope constraints, fallback handling, and multi-turn conversation logic

  • Design prompt architectures for multi-step and chained agent workflows, including RAG-augmented agents that draw from program-specific knowledge bases

  • Collaborate with the engineering team to configure and deploy agents through Noodle’s AI orchestration platform, including primary prompts, secondary context, knowledge base attachments, and embed definitions

  • Create the learner experiences defined by “three-way” chat between the learner, a campus or Noodle support staff member, and that staff member’s AI assistant

Evaluation & Quality

  • Build and maintain evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, tone, hallucination rate, task completion, and alignment with rubric-based learning objectives

  • Use Langfuse (Noodle’s LLM observability platform) to monitor prompt performance in production, identify regressions, and prioritize prompt improvements

  • Design red-teaming and adversarial testing protocols to surface edge cases and failure modes before agents reach students

  • Establish prompt versioning practices and maintain a library of tested, reusable prompt components

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Partner with Noodle teammates and university stakeholders to design, build, and test agents — translating learning objectives, operational flows, rubric assessments, and more into prompt-level agent instructions

  • Work with enrollment and student success teams to tune companion agents for specific programs and university partner contexts

  • Contribute prompt engineering guidelines and best practices documentation for internal teams who configure their own agents on Noodle’s AI orchestration platform

  • Stay current with model capability changes across OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers integrated into Noodle’s stack, and proactively surface opportunities or risks

  • Perform other duties as assigned

You have:

  • 2+ years of experience designing and iterating on prompts for LLM-powered applications in a production environment

  • Deep familiarity with prompt patterns: few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, system vs. user roles, output formatting constraints, tool-use prompting, and RAG integration

  • Strong written communication — you can write clearly, precisely, and persuasively, because that’s the core of the job

  • Experience building and running prompt evaluations: defining metrics, writing test cases, and interpreting results to make improvement decisions

  • Comfort working across disciplines — you can hold a conversation with an engineer about context windows and with a faculty member about Bloom’s Taxonomy

  • Experience with LLM observability tools (Langfuse, Weights & Biases, or similar)

  • Familiarity with LTI (Learning Tools Interoperability) and how AI tools plug into LMS platforms like Moodle, Canvas, or Instructure

  • Experience with voice agents or multimodal prompting

  • Comfort reading and writing basic code (JavaScript, Python) to support prompt automation and testing pipelines

  • Knowledge of OpenAI, Anthropic, or other model provider APIs

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity and iterate quickly based on user feedback

  • Ability to work effectively in dynamic, rapidly changing, team-based environment

Job Summary

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of customer projects and service engagements by aligning resource capacity with customer demand, driving project execution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met. This role serves as the operational hub between customers, delivery teams, project resources, and leadership to ensure projects are properly staffed, risks are proactively managed, and customer expectations are consistently achieved.

The Service Delivery Manager oversees project governance, resource planning, meeting facilitation, action item management, and escalation resolution while maintaining visibility into project health, resource utilization, timelines, budgets, and overall customer satisfaction.

You will lead end-to-end delivery of Palantir-based programs, ensuring alignment between stakeholders, timelines, and technical teams.

Role Description

Resource Management & Capacity Planning

  • Maintain visibility into all available service delivery resources and project assignments.

  • Align inbound project demand with available resource capacity and skill sets.

  • Coordinate resource assignments across multiple customer engagements and projects.

  • Monitor resource utilization and recommend adjustments to optimize delivery performance.

  • Identify resource constraints and skill gaps and develop mitigation plans.

  • Partner with delivery leaders and functional managers on staffing priorities and future resource needs.

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Track all incoming projects and service engagements from initiation through completion.

  • Ensure projects are appropriately staffed and aligned to customer requirements.

  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate project status meetings, delivery reviews, and customer update meetings.

  • Ensure projects remain on track and proactively address obstacles impacting delivery.

  • Support project teams in developing and executing recovery plans when necessary.

Governance & Accountability

  • Facilitate recurring project and operational review meetings.

  • Document meeting outcomes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

  • Distribute meeting notes within established timelines.

  • Track action items through completion and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.

  • Maintain project dashboards, status reports, risk logs, and delivery metrics.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.

Risk & Escalation Management

  • Identify and manage project risks related to scope, budget, timeline, resources, and technical dependencies.

  • Maintain risk and issue logs for active projects.

  • Work with project teams to develop mitigation plans and corrective actions.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.

  • Drive issue resolution while maintaining alignment among stakeholders.

  • Escalate significant risks and concerns to leadership when appropriate.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams.

  • Provide clear communication regarding project status, risks, resource challenges, and delivery commitments.

  • Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities and delivery challenges.

  • Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication and successful execution.

  • Ensure customer expectations are aligned with project objectives and delivery capabilities.

  • Teamwork: Can work effectively in a team, contributing ideas and effort, and respecting the contributions of others.

  • Customer Service: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable solutions, and handle more complex customer interactions.

  • Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.

  • Time Management: Can generally use time effectively but may occasionally struggle with prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, or maintaining work-life balance.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can apply critical thinking to analyze data, identify patterns, and make basic inferences.

  • Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.

  • Detail-Oriented: Can identify errors or inconsistencies in work and make necessary corrections.

  • Presenting: Can prepare and deliver presentations, addressing key points and responding to questions with clarity.

  • Self-Motivation: Can identify personal or professional growth opportunities, propose self-improvement strategies, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Negotiation: Can identify opportunities for compromise, propose solutions, and take action to influence outcomes without explicit instructions.

  • Initiative: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose solutions, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Consultative Sales: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable products or services, and take action to close sales without explicit instructions.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management.

  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communications.

  • Resource Management and Workforce Planning

  • Project and Program Management

Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement

AbbVie’s Allergan Aesthetics technology organization is seeking an Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement to lead a team of highly senior Engineering Solution Architects responsible for shaping and guiding the technical execution of our most complex initiatives.

This is a senior engineering leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, execution, and organizational influence. You will lead a team of staff-level technical leaders who work across engineering teams, systems, and program increments to define solution architecture, surface dependencies early, develop high-level estimates, orchestrate technical alignment, and help ensure successful execution against delivery commitments.

This role is not about owning day-to-day coding teams. It is about leading the technical function that helps those teams succeed on the work that matters most. You and your team will be trusted to bring clarity to complexity, reduce delivery risk, strengthen technical decision-making, and improve confidence in execution across the portfolio.

This is also a rare opportunity to help shape the technology behind one of the most recognized aesthetics portfolios in the world — including products such as BOTOX® and JUVÉDERM® — and the digital platforms that power the leading loyalty experience in the market. The work is meaningful, visible, and directly connected to customer and business outcomes.

The Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement is a member of the Technology Leadership Team (TLT) for AA Tech and reports directly to the VP Technology, Allergan Aesthetics.

Senior Technical Leadership

You will lead and develop a team of senior, staff-level Engineering Solution Architects who serve as technical leads across major cross-team initiatives. This team plays a central role in helping the organization execute complex work successfully by driving:

  • End-to-end solution architecture across teams and systems
  • Technical dependency mapping and sequencing
  • High-level estimates and level-of-effort alignment
  • Technical orchestration across engineering teams and managers
  • Early identification and resolution of architectural gaps and delivery risks
  • Sustained technical guidance through execution to keep initiatives on track

In addition to leading this team, you will help mature architecture standards, reference patterns, and technical guidelines across the organization. These capabilities matter, but they are secondary to the core mission: enabling strong technical execution and predictable delivery for complex initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior Engineering Solution Architects, setting clear expectations and creating a culture of accountability, sound judgment, and high technical impact.
  • Deploy the architecture team to the organization’s highest-priority and most complex initiatives, ensuring the right technical leadership is applied where it matters most.
  • Oversee end-to-end solution architecture for major cross-team efforts, including technical sequencing, dependency planning, and high-level solution design.
  • Guide high-level estimates and level-of-effort assessments in partnership with engineering leaders to improve planning quality and delivery confidence.
  • Drive alignment across engineering teams, managers, and stakeholders on assumptions, tradeoffs, implementation approach, risks, and constraints.
  • Stay engaged through execution to resolve ambiguity, unblock decisions, and ensure solutions are implemented as intended and remain on track against schedule.
  • Serve as a senior technical leader across AA Tech for initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Program Management leaders to strengthen coordination, execution predictability, and technical delivery outcomes.
  • Oversee the development of practical architecture standards, guidelines, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Establish lightweight architecture review and alignment mechanisms that support speed and execution without adding unnecessary process.
  • Serve as a member of the AA Tech Technology Leadership Team, contributing to broader technology planning, organizational direction, and leadership decision-making.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical leadership roles
  • Significant experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders
  • Experience managing highly senior technical individual contributors, including Staff-level engineers or architects
  • Strong background in solution design, dependency management, technical estimation, and cross-team technical leadership
  • Proven ability to influence engineering managers, technical leaders, and teams without relying on direct delivery ownership
  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, integrations, and engineering delivery practices
  • Experience designing and guiding high-reliability, cloud-based implementations with strong focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and operational excellence
  • Experience with AI-driven engineering implementation, including use of tools such as Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development capabilities to improve engineering workflows and delivery outcomes
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Media Buyer & Creative Strategist
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager. You understand the relationship between creative, data, audiences, and performance—and you know how to turn those insights into campaigns that drive sales.

The Role
As our Media Buyer & Creative Strategist, you'll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid advertising while also helping shape the creative direction behind our ads.
You'll analyze what's working, identify why it's working, develop new creative concepts to test, and work closely with our creative team, content creators, and other marketing partners to turn those ideas into high-performing ads.
We're looking for someone who is data-driven, creative, curious, and obsessed with finding what makes customers click—and buy.

What You'll Do
Media Buying & Campaign Management
  • Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
  • Own campaign setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, pacing, and optimization.
  • Monitor key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, and spend.
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns and quickly address underperforming campaigns.
  • Conduct audience, placement, offer, product, and campaign structure testing.
  • Manage daily and weekly budget pacing to ensure spend aligns with revenue and profitability goals.
  • Stay current on platform updates, advertising trends, and emerging paid media opportunities.
Creative Strategy
  • Develop the creative strategy behind paid advertising campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing hooks, messaging, product benefits, offers, formats, and angles.
  • Analyze winning and losing creatives to understand why they performed.
  • Turn performance data into clear, actionable creative briefs.
  • Partner with graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and UGC creators to develop new ad concepts.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and testing opportunities.
  • Help determine what types of content, messaging, and storytelling will resonate with different audiences.
  • Stay on top of trends in UGC, short-form video, social media, and performance creative.
Testing & Optimization
  • Develop and manage a structured creative testing strategy.
  • Test hooks, headlines, thumbnails, messaging, CTAs, offers, formats, products, and audiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and identify winning creative quickly.
  • Scale winning concepts across campaigns and platforms.
  • Continuously refresh creative to combat ad fatigue.
  • Use performance insights to influence future creative strategy.
Analytics & Reporting
  • Monitor campaign performance and identify trends, opportunities, and problems.
  • Analyze performance by campaign, audience, product, creative, and funnel stage.
  • Create regular performance reports and clearly communicate key takeaways.
  • Turn data into actionable recommendations—not just reports.
  • Work with the broader marketing team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from ad click through purchase.
  • Help develop a deeper understanding of what drives customer acquisition and conversion.
You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at an ad and ask "Did it work?"

You ask:
"Why did it work?"
"Who did it work for?"
"What should we test next?"
"How do we turn this into 10 more winning ads?"

You're equally comfortable looking at a spreadsheet of performance data and brainstorming a killer hook for a new TikTok ad.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to test. You're constantly looking for the next opportunity to improve performance.
