jobs.excerpt: If you're obsessed with the phone, the chase, and closing for the meeting — and you want AI in your corner, not in your way — this is your playground.
jobs.description:
If you're obsessed with the phone, the chase, and closing for the meeting — and you want AI in your corner, not in your way — this is your playground. 🚀

Most outbound sales jobs hand you a dialer and a quota. This one hands you a craft: you'll get the owners of Managed Service Providers on the phone, find the real problem, and book meetings sales is glad to take. We reward meetings that stick, not dials that don't.

🏢 About MSPbots

MSPbots is a US-based AI company that builds intelligent automation tools for Managed Service Providers worldwide—helping IT businesses work smarter by automating workflows, surfacing real-time data, and eliminating manual work. You'll join a lean, high-performing sales team, work directly with US-based leadership, and have real visibility into the pipeline you help build.

🛠️ The Role

You're at the very start of the sales process. You find the right Managed Service Providers, get them on the phone, and book quality meetings for our sales team—the kind they're genuinely glad to take.

Volume matters, but quality wins here. You're measured on the meetings that turn into real opportunities, not the number you dial or book. The habits that get you there: reaching the right accounts, following up without fail, and keeping your notes and records clean.

🌐 Work Setup: Remote (Philippine-based only)

🌙 Work Schedule: 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine Time

🎯 Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead Vetting & Qualification — Confirm a company is a genuine Managed Service Provider and a good fit for our ideal customer profile before outreach; respect account-ownership rules; capture details like their service-desk software, technician count, dispatch method, and pain points where possible.
  • Multi-Channel Outbound — Run the correct sequences per persona across calls and email; keep every cadence active, with nothing paused or stalled. Balance sequence-driven volume with personalized one-off outreach to the accounts that matter most.
  • Prospect Conversations & Discovery — Execute the call process: intro and rapport, gatekeeper navigation, an elevator pitch with storytelling and social proof, probing for pain, pivoting to business intelligence and automation, and handling objections with a structured approach.
  • Booking Meetings (Trial Close & Demo) — Close for a demo once pain or interest is identified; schedule specific next steps.
  • Follow-up & Nurture Discipline — Zero missed follow-ups; respond to high-intent signals the same day; keep your callbacks organized and consistently labeled; enroll prospects in nurture where appropriate; re-work leads the sales team did not accept.
  • HubSpot Hygiene & Data Accuracy — Accurate rep attribution, a disposition on every logged call, detailed notes, correct personas/titles/time zones, and meeting logging.
  • Handoff to Sales — Hand off booked meetings to the sales team with full context, following our handoff process.
  • Pipeline Prioritization — Protect warm and active opportunities before cold outreach; work tradeshow and inbound leads fast.
  • Continuous Improvement — Participate in scorecard reviews, team huddles, and coaching; progress section by section toward call mastery.
  • Tool & Compliance Adherence — Use the approved stack (HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Apollo/Lusha) and our AI-assisted research assistant. LinkedIn is manual review only—no scraping or automation.

🔍 Qualifications & What We Look For

Required

  • Strong US business-to-business phone sales background—proven success in high-volume outbound calling, cold prospecting, and booking meetings over the phone. Top hiring priority.
  • Real phone-selling experience with business owners or service leaders — not appointment-setting or script-reading; can handle nuanced conversations and objections and earn the meeting.
  • Confident, resilient phone presence: comfortable with gatekeepers, objections, and cold opens.
  • Able to write a short, specific, personalized email—30 a day, referencing something real about that account.
  • Disciplined follow-up and record-keeping habits (accurate notes, dispositions, task management).
  • Coachable—willing to be scored on in the prospecting call process and improve section by section.

Preferred (not required)

  • Software-as-a-service sales experience—a plus, not a requirement.
  • Exposure to the Managed Service Provider or IT services space, or technical business-to-business buyers.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, sequences, and prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, Apollo/Lusha).

Fit signals

  • Prioritizes quality conversations over vanity activity.
  • Self-directed on warm follow-through; protects active pipeline over busywork.

🎉 Compensation & Benefits

How you're paid: $8/hour base plus commission. Commission is your main upside — you earn on every deal you help close, along with a bonus for each qualified meeting the sales team accepts. (Meetings you book that aren't accepted count toward your performance but aren't paid.) We'll walk through the full numbers in the interview.

Perks:

  • 💊 Health Insurance (HMO) Reimbursement — $100/month
  • 🛡️ Life Insurance Allowance — $20/month
  • 🦷 Dental & Vision Reimbursement — Dental ($20/month) + Vision ($4/month)
  • 🌴 15 days of paid time off per year (convertible to cash if unused)
  • 📚 Training & Learning Reimbursement — up to $30/month
  • 🇺🇸 US Holiday Pay
  • 🏠 Remote work flexibility
  • 📈 Opportunities for growth in a fast-moving AI company
  • 🌟 And more

jobs.description:
Role Title: Remote Accounting Manager / Senior Accountant- Pack Leader Location: Fully Remote — Kenya-based professional supporting a U.S.-based accounting team Employment Type: Full-Time, 40 hours per week Schedule & Availability: Strong and consistent overlap with U.S. business hours, with reasonable flexibility based on client and team needs Reports To: Quality Control Lead (QCL) Team Alignment: Recurring Services / Client Accounting Client-Facing: Yes — expected to become increasingly client-facing over time This is a leadership position, not simply a senior bookkeeping role. The Pack Leader will: ● Lead and supervise Staff Accountants / pack members. ● Own the quality and timeliness of assigned client financials. ● Ensure work moves from assignment through completion without constant escalation. ● Make sound accounting and operational judgment calls. ● Identify problems, determine solutions, and ensure those solutions are implemented. ● Support Relationship Managers with client-ready financial statements and insights. ● Help improve accounting workflows, systems, and internal processes. ● Develop into an increasingly client-facing accounting leader as transactional accounting becomes more automated. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting expertise, leadership maturity, ownership, curiosity, adaptability, problem-solving ability, and executive presence. Key Responsibilities 1. Pack Leadership & Supervision ● Directly supervise Staff Accountants / pack members through daily leadership,coaching, and oversight. ● Assign, prioritize, and monitor work across the pack. ● Ensure team members understand responsibilities, deadlines, and expected quality standards. ● Conduct regular check-ins to review workload, performance, development, and obstacles. ● Mentor team members in accounting fundamentals, systems, client service, and LCDG standards. ● Provide direct and constructive performance feedback. ● Make appropriate judgment calls on behalf of the pack. ● Take responsibility for team outcomes rather than automatically routing decisions upward. ● Hold team members accountable for completing work accurately and on schedule. ● Develop the technical and professional capabilities of junior team members. ● Demonstrate calm, confident leadership during demanding periods. 2. Ownership, Problem-Solving & Decision-Making ● Take ownership when an accounting, operational, or client-related problem is identified. ● Work through problems independently before escalating. ● Determine what information is needed to reach a solution. ● Research answers when the solution is not immediately obvious. ● Make sound professional judgment calls when appropriate. ● Ensure solutions are actually implemented rather than stopping at problem identification. ● Take responsibility for outcomes. ● Escalate only when necessary and provide: ○ A clear explanation of the issue. ○ What has already been attempted. ○ The remaining obstacle. ○ A recommended path forward. ● Operate confidently in situations where there may be more than one reasonable accounting or operational approach. 3. Workflow Management & Delivery ● Organize daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual responsibilities across the pack. ● Maintain visibility into active work and outstanding deliverables. ● Rebalance workloads when necessary. ● Ensure recurring client responsibilities are completed accurately and on schedule. ● Track open questions and outstanding items through closure. ● Prevent work from stalling while waiting for responses. ● Provide proactive status updates to internal stakeholders. ● Ensure month-end and other deadlines are met consistently. ● Create structure and accountability across multiple simultaneous client workflows. 4. Accounting Execution & Financial Oversight ● Oversee day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting for U.S.-based restaurant and multi-unit clients. ● Record and categorize transactions accurately. ● Perform and review bank and credit card reconciliations. ● Manage and review accounts payable and accounts receivable workflows. ● Maintain full ownership of assigned client Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets ● Prepare, review, and analyze: ○ Profit & Loss Statements. ○ Balance Sheets. ○ Cash Flow Statements. ○ Supporting schedules and reconciliations. ● Identify unusual balances, discrepancies, missing information, or incorrect classifications. ● Resolve accounting issues independently when possible. ● Ensure client records remain complete, accurate, and audit-ready. ● Maintain strong accounting documentation within QuickBooks Online and Restaurant365. 5. Month-End Close, Quality Control & Audit Support ● Lead and oversee month-end close processes. ● Ensure all required reconciliations are completed. ● Review financial statements before submission to Quality Control. ● Resolve open accounting questions within the close cycle whenever reasonably possible. ● Support quarterly hard closes. ● Prepare work for QCL reviews and audits. ● Ensure supporting schedules and documentation are complete. ● Maintain strong internal controls and documentation standards. ● Ensure financial information is useful, understandable, and appropriate for the client environment. 6. Flexible Accounting Judgment ● Apply sound accounting principles without becoming unnecessarily rigid in situations that require professional judgment. ● Understand that restaurant bookkeeping may require practical business judgment alongside technical accounting knowledge. ● Recognize that the most useful presentation or process for a client may evolve as circumstances change. ● Understand the business reason behind financial reporting decisions, not merely the technical rule. ● Be comfortable operating in gray areas where several reasonable options may exist. ● Adapt processes when new information, technology, or client needs justify a better approach. ● Avoid relying on “this is how it has always been done” as the default answer. ● Balance accuracy, consistency, usefulness, and client needs. 7. Client-Facing Accounting Leadership ● Develop into a regular client-facing accounting leader. ● Communicate clearly and confidently with restaurant owners, operators, and financial stakeholders. ● Explain financial information in understandable business language. ● Maintain control of accounting conversations and client calls. ● Remain composed when clients challenge, question, or misunderstand financial information. ● Listen carefully to what a client is asking. ● Identify the underlying issue behind the surface-level question. ● Guide clients toward the appropriate accounting or business solution. ● Adapt communication style to different client personalities. ● Build trust and strong working relationships. ● Work effectively with both casual entrepreneurial clients and more formal corporate stakeholders. ● Demonstrate executive presence and confidence in accounting knowledge. ● Partner with Relationship Managers to prepare financial statements and insights for client review meetings. 8. Client & Cross-Team Collaboration ● Work closely with U.S.-based accountants, Relationship Managers, Quality Control Leads, and internal support teams. ● Communicate professionally regarding financial questions, deadlines, and outstanding issues. ● Provide accounting analysis and context for client discussions. ● Coordinate effectively across teams to ensure deliverables are completed. ● Close communication loops rather than assuming another team member will follow up. ● Surface risks early enough for the team to address them. ● Support a collaborative environment while maintaining clear accountability. 9. Process Improvement & SOP Development ● Document and maintain bookkeeping and accounting workflows. ● Update SOPs as processes evolve. ● Identify inefficient or outdated practices. ● Recommend practical process improvements. ● Help implement approved workflow changes. ● Look for ways to improve: ○ Accuracy. ○ Close speed. ○ Team communication. ○ Client reporting. ○ Workflow visibility. ○ Quality control. ● Encourage team members to understand why a process exists rather than simply following instructions. 10. Technology, AI & Automation ● Demonstrate curiosity toward accounting technology and process automation. ● Use technology to improve accounting efficiency and accuracy. ● Maintain advanced hands-on QuickBooks Online proficiency. ● Learn and use Restaurant365 where required. ● Explore opportunities for AI to improve recurring accounting and administrative processes. ● Use approved AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or comparable platforms where appropriate. ● Ask proactively: “How can AI help me do this better?” ● Review and validate AI-generated work before it enters client files or financial reporting. ● Apply technical accounting judgment rather than relying blindly on automated outputs. ● Remain curious as AI and accounting technology continue to evolve. ● Support client transitions from QuickBooks Online to Restaurant365 when needed. Requirements Required Qualifications & Experience ● Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. ● Minimum 7 - 10+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience. ● Candidates with 10+ years or significantly deeper relevant experience are strongly encouraged to apply. ● CPA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting certification. ● Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience managing accounting or bookkeeping staff. ● Specific experience: ○ Directing the work of others. ○ Managing deadlines. ○ Reviewing accounting work. ○ Delivering corrective feedback. ○ Taking responsibility for team outcomes. ● Strong understanding of: ○ Profit & Loss Statements. ○ Balance Sheets. ○ Cash Flow Statements. ○ Financial reporting. ○ Accrual accounting. ○ Account reconciliations. ○ Month-end close. ○ U.S. accounting principles and best practices. ● Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks Online expertise. ● Ability to work independently in QuickBooks Online without significant assistance. ● Ability to explain the reasoning behind accounting entries and decisions. ● Strong Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets skills. ● Excellent written and spoken English. ● High attention to detail and accuracy. ● Strong organizational and workflow-management skills. ● Ability to manage multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. ● Strong professional judgment. ● Demonstrated ability to solve problems independently. ● Proven ownership and follow-through. ● Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision. ● Ability to work 40 hours per week with strong overlap with U.S. business hours. Preferred Qualifications ● Restaurant365 experience. ● Experience supporting U.S.-based clients. ● Experience working with restaurants, franchises, hospitality businesses, or multi-location organizations. ● Experience in client accounting services, outsourced accounting, or professional services. ● Experience leading client calls or accounting review meetings. ● Experience presenting financial information to business owners or operators. ● Experience documenting SOPs and improving operational processes. ● Experience in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial, or evolving systems environment. ● Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or another major AI platform in professional workflows. ● Experience applying AI or automation to accounting or operational processes. Restaurant365 experience is a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Training can be provided for an otherwise exceptional candidate. QuickBooks Online Expectations Advanced QuickBooks Online proficiency is a major priority for this role. Candidates should be able to: ● Navigate QuickBooks Online confidently and independently. ● Troubleshoot accounting issues without constant guidance. ● Perform reconciliations. ● Review and correct transaction coding. ● Understand account structure. ● Review financial statements. ● Explain accounting decisions and entries. ● Identify errors or unusual activity. ● Demonstrate their practical QuickBooks Online expertise during the interview and assessment process. Restaurant365 Expectations Restaurant365 experience is preferred, not required. The ideal candidate may already have: ● Restaurant365 accounting experience. ● Exposure to restaurant accounting systems. ● Restaurant or hospitality accounting knowledge. Client-Facing Expectations The role is expected to become increasingly client-facing over time. The successful candidate must demonstrate: ● Fluent, easily understandable English. ● Strong verbal communication. ● Confidence. ● Confidence in their accounting knowledge. ● Ability to control and guide a client call. ● Ability to remain composed under pressure. ● Strong relationship-building skills. ● Ability to adjust communication style based on the client. ● Ability to read the room. ● Ability to work with both casual and corporate personalities. ● Ability to listen beyond the immediate question. ● Ability to identify the real issue behind a client’s request. ● Ability to guide clients toward practical solutions. ● Strong executive presence. Working Hours ● Full-Time — 40 hours per week. ● Strong overlap with U.S. business hours is required. ● The candidate should work as closely to normal U.S. business hours as reasonably practical. ● The company serves clients across multiple U.S. time zones. ● The schedule does not need to be an inflexible 8:00 AM–5:00 PM or 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time schedule. ● Reasonable scheduling flexibility is available when needed. ● Occasional early-morning or evening availability may be required depending on client and team needs. Benefits Compensation & Benefits ● Competitive Salary commensurate with relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated expertise, interview performance, and the scope of responsibilities. ● Final Compensation: The final salary offer may fall anywhere within the advertised range and will be determined through a consistent assessment of job-related qualifications, demonstrated capability, relevant experience, internal equity, salary expectations, and the approved compensation budget. ● Performance-based salary reviews and raises ● Remote work flexibility ● Opportunity to work with a diverse, dynamic team

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of compensation/benefits analysts and HR business partners, setting priorities, building capability, and creating a strong service-delivery culture.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, HRIS/IT, and senior HR leadership on budgeting, forecasting, and total rewards strategy tied to business goals.

  • Own vendor management and RFP processes for benefits brokers, carriers, and compensation/HRIS technology partners.

  • Strong, demonstrated experience in compensation and benefits, with ownership of an organization's overall benefits program (plan design, renewals, vendor management, compliance).

  • Solid understanding of compensation structures, market pricing/benchmarking, incentive design, and pay equity practices.

About Us:

Psychiatry UK is the UK’s leading provider of digital psychiatry services, working both privately and with the NHS to support children, teenagers and adults with expert, patient-centred care.

A career with Psychiatry UK allows you to expand your knowledge, enhance your skills, and gain valuable life experience—all while enjoying the flexibility of a remote full-time or part-time role. As part of a leading online mental health service, you'll collaborate with innovative, forward-thinking professionals in a dynamic, multidisciplinary team committed to making a real difference.

A career as an ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber with Psychiatry UK offers:

  • Work for a clinically excellent organisation: Join a team recognised for high standards and innovation, delivering care that truly makes a difference.
  • Manageable caseloads: Focus on quality care without burnout, ensuring you can see the impact of your work.
  • Flexibility and work-life balance: Tailor your role to suit your lifestyle with remote, full-time or part-time (minimum of 30 hours) options, between 8am and 8pm, Monday-Friday (only)
  • Career development opportunities: Access structured training, mentorship, and clear pathways for progression.
  • A sense of belonging and community:Work with a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive team where your contributions are valued.

At Psychiatry UK, your work will not only be rewarding professionally but also personally—you’ll be happy, supported, and making a difference every day.

TheADHD Specialist Independent Prescriberplays a critical role in delivering high-quality, patient-centered care within Psychiatry UK’s ADHD service. Reporting into the Titration Team Lead and working closely with Consultant Psychiatrists, this position is responsible for the treatment and ongoing management of adults with ADHD, including the independent or supplementary prescribing of ADHD medications in line with national guidelines and Psychiatry UK’s clinical policies.

The ADHD Specialist Independent Prescribers exercise autonomous clinical judgment to initiate, titrate and monitor treatment efficacy, manage risk, and ensure safe and effective titration, while maintaining professional and ethical standards of care. Through collaborative, multidisciplinary working, they contribute to continuous service development, clinical governance, and quality improvement initiatives, supporting Psychiatry UK’s commitment to innovation and excellence in mental health care.

This is a home-based role (applicants must reside in the UK), though occasional travel may be required for face-to-face meetings at various locations within the UK.

As an ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber, you will:

  • Provide safe, effective, and evidence-based prescribing for adult ADHD patients in line with NICE guidelines, Psychiatry UK clinical policies, and the Royal Pharmaceutical Society (RPS) Prescribing Framework.
  • Manage a defined caseload of patients during the titration and ongoing treatment phases, ensuring timely review of treatment effectiveness, side effects, and adherence.
  • Communicate with patients through Psychiatry UK’s secure portal, offering clear, supportive, and clinically appropriate responses to medication-related queries.
  • Complete End of Titration Reviews (EOTRs) and conduct annual medication reviews in a timely and thorough manner, ensuring continuity and quality of care.
  • Exercise independent or supplementary prescribing rights within scope of practice, recognising limitations and seeking clinical advice when necessary.
  • Collaborate closely with Consultant Psychiatrists and the wider ADHD service team to ensure coordinated, patient-centred care.
  • Undertake regular risk assessments and review safeguarding concerns, escalating appropriately in line with organisational policy.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed, and confidential clinical records using Psychiatry UK’s digital systems in accordance with professional and legal standards.
  • Participate in audits, quality improvement activities, and the review of prescribing practices to support clinical governance and service development.
  • Engage in regular clinical supervision and team learning to maintain high standards of clinical decision-making.
  • Contribute to the ongoing refinement of Psychiatry UK’s prescribing pathways, titration protocols, and service delivery processes.
  • Remain up to date with relevant legislation, prescribing guidance, and Psychiatry UK policies, with a commitment to continuous professional development.

To succeed as an ADHD Specialist Independent Prescriber, you will have:

Sound clinical experience in the initiation, titration, and management of ADHD in adults. You will demonstrate a strong patient-centred approach, showing empathy, professionalism, and the ability to build rapport with patients and colleagues. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are essential, with the capacity to engage effectively both remotely and in writing, while collaborating seamlessly within multidisciplinary or multi-agency teams.

You will be familiar with ADHD rating scales, validated screening, and monitoring tools, and have a solid awareness of safeguarding procedures, particularly in the context of remote or digital healthcare delivery.

A sound understanding of legislation, professional standards, and current developments in ADHD service provision and prescribing practice is required. You will be able to work autonomously, managing an independent caseload efficiently and responsibly, supported by advanced IT and digital literacy skills necessary for confident use of digital health platforms.

Essential Qualifications and Experience:

Registered Nurses:

  • First-level registered Mental Health nurse (RMN) or
  • First-level registered nurse (Adult Nurse/Children’s Nurse/Learning Disabilities Nurse) (with one year post qualification Secondary Mental Health service experience or further Mental Health qualification).
  • Must have Independent & Supplementary Non-Medical Prescribing (V300) qualification with 1-year post-prescribing qualification experience.
  • 1-year post prescribing qualification experience in Specialist ADHD Service. (Specialist ADHD experience can include working within private and/or NHS Secondary mental health practice) or equivalent.
  • ADHD experience must include managing ADHD patients with prescribing responsibilities, including medication initiation, titration, review, and long-term management.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Further relevant training or qualifications in mental health or neurodevelopmental conditions.
  • Previous experience specifically within ADHD specialist services.
  • Experience in remote clinical service provision or digital healthcare environments.

Desirable Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with titration and long-term management of stimulant and non-stimulant ADHD medications.
  • Understanding of clinical governance, audit, and quality improvement processes related to prescribing.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, technology-enabled clinical environment.
  • Knowledge of safeguarding procedures and risk assessment in mental health and remote care settings.
  • Ability to adapt and contribute to service development in a growing, evolving organisation.

Psychiatry UK:Supporting You

Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Proven ability to manage significant workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven to ten years of progressively responsible middle market commercial lines underwriting experience preferred. Two to five years of sales and business development experience in middle market commercial lines is also preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for small and middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Strong drive for results.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Medical was founded on the belief that if we treat each member like we would our loved ones, we can meaningfully improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for some of America’s most vulnerable patient populations. The Complex Care Department is at the heart of this goal: we are a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, case managers, social work care managers, community health workers, and outreach specialists united by our mission to build a better care delivery system for Devoted’s most complex members. Through a mixture of in-home and virtual interventions, we provide whole-person clinical, social and logistical support for patients with complex chronic conditions, frail elders, and patients at high risk of hospital admissions. Our Outreach Coordinators play the vital role of program ambassador, resourceful connector, and scheduling logistics maestro, working in close partnership with the rest of our multidisciplinary team to ensure we’re treating each patient as we would our own family.

Our Outreach Coordinators partner with a multidisciplinary care team of physicians, NPs, case managers, social workers, and community health workers to establish trusting treatment relationships across a panel of complex patients over a 6-12 month time frame, resulting in meaningful improvements in the panel’s clinical outcomes. Outreach Coordinators play the vital role of consistent program ambassador, resourceful connector, and scheduling logistics coordinator. You will provide caring, accurate guidance in the complex world of health care, primarily via outbound and inbound calls and SMS. You will actively listen to members, see opportunity in the unexpected, respond appropriately, and create a caring atmosphere for our members.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Conducting outreach via telephone and SMS to educate and inform members of available clinical programs or important screenings relevant to them (i.e. eye exams or cancer screenings) and to ensure patients remain connected to care throughout their time in the program, working in close coordination with the care team to coordinate care delivery for the right patients, in the right way, at the right time

  • Scheduling initial appointments, thoughtfully adjusting calendars to meet urgent care needs on a regular basis and also responsible to reschedule the visits for other roles on your team.

  • Providing inbound call support/call routing for patients with clinical or administrative questions

  • Communicating frequently with the care team members and leadership, including routine involvement in daily care team coordination huddles, patient rounds, etc.

  • Developing a solid understanding of our benefit offerings in order to investigate and resolve member questions

  • Documenting accurate information about member needs in our system

  • Supporting the team with daily tasks, including administrative work

  • Piloting new processes and workflows

  • Working hand-in-hand with other Devoted teams to address member needs

Required skills & experience:

  • You have a minimum of 3 years of healthcare experience in customer/patient-serving role, such as a Care Coordinator

  • Must be willing to work M-F 8:30am-5pm Central Standard Time (CST).

Desired skills & experience:

  • 1-2 years of call center experience is a plus!

  • Bilingual Spanish speakers and experience engaging across various cultures

  • Health insurance experience (Medicare Advantage a plus)

  • Have healthcare experience (scheduling, benefits, care coordination, medical terminology, and HIPPA regulations a plus) Availability to work variable shifts to support the needs of our members across multiple time zones

  • Proficient computer skills and ability to learn new systems

  • Google Suite Proficiency a big plus - including Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides

  • Have great communication, problem solving, analytical and documentation skills

  • Use effective time management and organization skills

  • Demonstrate evidence of ability to empathize with patients, relatives and colleagues with dignity and respect

Salary range: $25.00 - $30.00 hourly

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP):Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records.   • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in and may lead global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.

May be mentored and assigned lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL) or operational line manager. This could include participation in business development proposals and/or defense meetings.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

JOB DESCRIPTION – Lead AI Experience Engineer

Location: Remote, United Kingdom

Division: Ticketmaster

Contract Terms: Fulltime

THE TEAM

The TM1 Client & Fan Support Engineering team builds and operates the intelligent, scalable technology that supports Ticketmaster’s client and fan service experiences.

The team develops AI-powered support experiences, automation capabilities, integrations, and platform services that help clients and fans resolve issues quickly and confidently. We work closely with Product, Client Support, Fan Support, Knowledge Management, Data Science, Platform Engineering, Quality Assurance, Security, and other technology teams to deliver reliable and measurable outcomes.

As our capabilities evolve from traditional conversational automation toward agentic AI, the team builds intelligent services that combine large language models, natural language understanding, enterprise knowledge, business logic, and operational systems.

THE JOB

Ticketmaster is seeking an experienced Lead AI Experience Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and evolution of agentic AI services within the TM1 Client & Fan Support Engineering team.

This role is responsible for defining how AI agents understand client and fan needs, maintain context, reason through complex scenarios, apply business rules, use available data and tools, and safely complete support tasks. The Lead AI Engineer will establish the methods, reusable patterns, quality expectations, and evaluation practices used by the AI Engineering team.

The position combines agentic AI design, conversational intelligence, Natural Language Understanding, business-process modeling, AI evaluation, and technical leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Managers, AI Engineers, Client and Fan Support Operations, Data Science, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable and trustworthy AI behaviors.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Provide technical leadership for agentic AI across the TM1 Client & Fan Support Engineering team, partnering with the Engineering Manager to define technical direction and strengthen the team’s AI capabilities.
  • Lead the design of intelligent AI experiences that understand client and fan needs, apply business rules, maintain context, use available tools and data, and safely complete support tasks.
  • Translate business processes, service policies, and customer journeys into agent behaviors, decision logic, conversational patterns, and autonomous workflows.
  • Establish reusable patterns and standards for prompts, NLU, context management, guardrails, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, documentation, and human handoff.
  • Conduct design and quality reviews, identify risks, and guide AI Engineers in delivering reliable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.
  • Define and monitor AI quality measures, including task completion, response quality, grounding, escalation accuracy, containment, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.
  • Partner across Product, Client and Fan Support Operations, Data Science, Platform, QA, Security, and Knowledge Management to align AI solutions with business, customer, and technical needs.
  • Mentor AI Engineers through technical guidance, feedback, design sessions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical approaches that improve quality, delivery, and operational effectiveness.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Significant experience designing and leading conversational AI, intelligent assistant, Generative AI, or agentic AI solutions.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, agent behavior, reasoning patterns, context management, memory, tool calling, and workflow orchestration.
  • Strong expertise in NLU, intent and entity modeling, semantic understanding, dialogue management, clarification strategies, and conversational design.
  • Experience translating business rules and operational workflows into AI decision logic and user experiences.
  • Experience designing guardrails, policy controls, escalation paths, failure handling, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience defining AI evaluation frameworks and using interaction data, testing, and analytics to improve performance.
  • Knowledge of RAG, semantic search, enterprise knowledge systems, grounding, observability, and regression testing.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, cloud services, software architecture, integration patterns, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ability to lead complex initiatives, navigate ambiguity, and balance business value, customer experience, technical constraints, risk, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, systems thinking, and problem-solving skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience operating agentic AI solutions in production.
  • Experience with conversational AI platforms, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt-management tools, or AI evaluation platforms.
  • Experience in customer service, contact center, or high-volume digital support environments.
  • Familiarity with Amelia, Zendesk, Five9, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, privacy, security, accessibility, and multilingual support.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • You are a trusted technical leader who applies deep expertise to complex AI challenges.
  • You establish standards and reusable practices that improve quality, consistency, and team effectiveness.
  • You coach engineers through clear, constructive feedback and help them build greater technical independence.
  • You build strong partnerships across technical and business teams and communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • You balance strategic thinking with practical execution and make sound decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • You act with ownership, integrity, and accountability while fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

About the Role

You'll own the incident lifecycle end-to-end and act as the escalation point when things go wrong — while building the reporting, process, and team rhythm that reduces how often they go wrong in the first place.

Key Responsibilities

Team Management

  • Manage a team of engineers responsible for large-scale infrastructure and platform operations

  • Own rostering and coverage across a 24x7, globally distributed operating model, ensuring continuous operational coverage

  • Run team performance management: 1:1s, goal-setting, skills development, and performance reviews

  • Identify and close skills gaps within the team as scope grows from infrastructure into platform operations

  • Own onboarding of new engineers into live customer environments

Service Delivery & SLA Management

  • Define, track, and report on service KPIs (availability, MTTR, MTTA, ticket aging/backlog, customer satisfaction)

  • Chair regular service review meetings, both internal and customer-facing, backed by clear data

  • Maintain and continuously improve runbooks, escalation paths, and operational documentation

  • Manage SLA risk and escalate commercial impact to leadership where relevant

Incident & Critical Outage Management

  • Own the incident management process end-to-end: detection, triage, escalation, resolution, and post-incident review

  • Act as the primary escalation point for major and critical incidents/outages, coordinating cross-functional resources and communicating status to customers and leadership

  • Understand the technical detail behind incidents well enough to ask the right questions, challenge root-cause analysis, and make good calls under pressure

  • Run blameless post-incident reviews (RCA/PIR) and track corrective actions through to closure

  • Track incident trends over time to drive proactive reliability improvements rather than reactive firefighting

  • Ensure on-call and escalation rotas are staffed, documented, and regularly tested

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Architecture during onboarding of new customers to confirm delivery readiness

  • Represent service delivery performance and improvement plans in customer business reviews

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain structured onboarding/handover documentation for new customer environments

  • Ensure operational readiness reviews are completed before any new customer environment goes live

  • SLA targets consistently met or exceeded across your customer portfolio

  • Incidents detected, escalated, and resolved within target timeframes, with clear customer communication throughout

  • A stable, well-rostered team with a visible skills growth path as scope expands from infrastructure to platform

  • A shrinking rate of repeat incidents, driven by disciplined post-incident follow-through

  • Customers who trust the team because they can see the data, not just hear reassurance

  • Direct experience owning incident management and major incident/outage response, including customer-facing communication during live incidents
  • Strong working knowledge of SLA frameworks, service reporting, and escalation management
  • Experience managing distributed or shift-based teams operating on a 24x7 rotation
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to communicate clearly to both engineers and customer executives
  • Data-driven approach to service management, comfortable building and presenting operational metrics
  • Must be based in the EU and eligible to work there

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience with observability tooling and practices (monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting) — a strong plus
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and platform technologies
  • ITIL or equivalent service management certification
  • Experience in a neocloud, hyperscaler, colocation, or managed hosting environment
  • Experience managing services for customers who own their own physical infrastructure
  • Experience managing teams whose remit expanded over time from infrastructure into platform-layer operations

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.

  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.

Influence & Impact

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking a highly skilled and strategic Hardware ServiceNow Architect supporting the Department of the Air Force (DAF) Enterprise IT as a Service (EITaaS) programwith expertise in Hardware Asset Management (HAM). This role is focused on designing, implementing, and governing the end-to-end HAM solution within the ServiceNow platform. You will leverage ServiceNow to manage the complete lifecycle of hardware assets – from planning and procurement through deployment, maintenance, and eventual disposal. This includes architecting the HAM module, optimizing the CMDB for hardware assets, ensuring data integrity and building robust integrations.

Responsibilities:

HAM Architectural Strategy & Vision:

  • Define the long-term architectural vision, strategy, and roadmap for Hardware Asset Management within the ServiceNow platform, aligning with overall enterprise architecture and business objectives.
  • Lead the design of comprehensive, scalable, and secure HAM solutions that encompass the entire hardware asset lifecycle (planning, procurement, receiving, inventory, deployment, use, maintenance, refresh, disposal).
  • Translate complex business requirements from Finance, Procurement, Operations, and IT into detailed architectural designs and technical specifications for ServiceNow HAM.

ServiceNow HAM Module & CMDB:

  • Act as the subject matter expert and lead architect for the ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) module, ensuring its optimal configuration and utilization.
  • Architect the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB) specifically for hardware assets, focusing on data model integrity, relationships, normalization, reconciliation, and discovery strategies for various hardware types.
  • Design and implement robust automated workflows within ServiceNow using Service Catalog, Flow Designer and custom modules for key HAM processes (e.g., asset requests, procurement approvals, stockroom management, asset assignment, refresh/disposal).

Integration & Data Integrity:

  • Design and oversee complex integrations between ServiceNow HAM and critical enterprise systems, network discovery tools, and other asset inventory systems.
  • Establish and enforce data quality standards, governance frameworks, and reconciliation processes to ensure the accuracy and completeness of hardware asset data in ServiceNow.

Financial & Operational Optimization:

  • Architect solutions to track hardware asset costs, depreciation, lease information, and contract details within ServiceNow, enabling Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis.
  • Drive the automation of asset-related financial processes and reporting, contributing to cost savings and improved financial visibility.
  • Develop strategies for hardware asset utilization tracking, lifecycle optimization, and proactive refresh planning.

Leadership & Governance:

  • Establish and enforce architectural standards, best practices, and governance policies for all aspects of HAM implementation and data management within ServiceNow.
  • Provide expert technical guidance, mentorship, and oversight to ServiceNow developers, administrators, and implementation partners working on HAM initiatives.
  • Lead technical design reviews, ensuring solutions are maintainable, extensible, and align with platform best practices.

Stakeholder Engagement & Innovation:

  • Collaborate extensively with cross-functional leaders (Procurement, Operations, IT, Compliance) to gather requirements, build consensus, and drive adoption of HAM solutions.
  • Stay abreast of the latest ServiceNow HAM features, industry trends, and emerging technologies to recommend innovative solutions.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • 15+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in applicable field may be substituted for 5 years of experience).
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5 years in a ServiceNow Architect role.
  • Deep and demonstrable expertise with ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) module.
  • Extensive hands-on experience and architectural expertise with ServiceNow CMDB and Discovery, specifically tailored for hardware assets.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing complex integrations between ServiceNow HAM and other systems.
  • Comprehensive understanding of the entire hardware asset lifecycle, from strategic planning and procurement through deployment, maintenance, and disposal.
  • Proficiency in ServiceNow platform capabilities, including Flow Designer, Service Portal, Custom Application Development, Scripting (JavaScript) and best practices.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL principles, particularly as they apply to asset management.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and lead technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain secret clearance.

Desired:

  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist - Hardware Asset Management (CIS-HAM) certification is highly advantageous.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and other relevant CIS certifications (e.g., CMDB, ITSM).
  • Experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management (SAM) in relation to hardware dependencies and licensing compliance.
  • Knowledge of industry asset management standards (e.g., ISO 55000).
  • Experience with mobile asset management solutions within ServiceNow.
  • Familiarity with financial concepts related to asset management (e.g., depreciation, amortization, lease accounting).
  • Experience with government contracting.

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

As a Workday Financials Consultant (R2R) in Kainos, you will play a critical role in supporting our global customers post-deployment. You’ll be responsible for configuring, troubleshooting, and optimising solutions, ensuring our clients continue to derive value from their Workday investment.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role suited to experienced consultants who thrive in fast-paced environments and are passionate about delivering exceptional support.

You will also help develop the skills of junior team members and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

 Key Responsibilities

  • Efficiently manage and prioritise incoming Workday tickets to ensure timely resolution and high client satisfaction.
  • Perform accurate triage of support cases, assessing case type, impact, urgency, and priority.
  • Ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs), particularly around Target Response and Fix Times.
  • Collaborate with the Functional Manager to review ticket volumes and drive process improvements and best practices.
  • Participate in client meetings to provide insight, suggest improvements, and deliver enhancements.
  • Mentor junior consultants and actively promote a culture of knowledge sharing, accelerating team capability development.
  • Identify opportunities for improving internal tools, templates, and support delivery processes.

 
What we are looking for: 

  • Deep understanding of Workday Record to Report (Financial Accounting/Budgets/Business Assets) (Product Lead in the Workday ecosystem is ideal but not mandatory) 
    • Excellent customer focus, able to assess customer needs, build relationships and manage customer expectations
    • Excellent communicator, able to communicate with customers and colleagues with impact and credibility
    • Strong commercial awareness and complete understanding of project and business dynamics 
    • Broad business and technology experience and a good awareness of industry trends and their potential impact on product 
    • Ability to work to tight deadlines and make sensible decisions under pressure taking a balanced view of customer demands and Kainos commercials 
    • Ability to widen and maintain a network of external contacts 
    • Excellent consulting skills e.g. leading largescale workshops with multiple stakeholders, liaising confidently and effectively with senior executives 
    • Regular participant in sales activities and responsible providing input to work estimates 
    • Understanding of risk management and able to manage risk within the capability 
    • Support the operations function ensure that our consultant pool is used in the most commercially advantageous way, balancing development needs and personal preferences 
    • Commercial understanding of utilization within a services organization and the importance of these targets 
    • Able to rotate through various Workday delivery services specifically Consulting and Application Management Services 
    • Able, if required, to travel to customer sites in the same region (minimal out of region travel may also be required) 

 

Nice to have: 

  • Professional qualifications where applicable in your Capability
    • Develop and deliver products/offerings and services that differentiate Kainos in the marketplace 
    • Identify talent for rapid development within the capability 
    • Experience of managing, mentoring and developing teams 

Embracing our differences  

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive.   We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are.   We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

jobs.description:
Role Details

Location: Remote (US-based preferred)

Reports To: SVP Marketing

About Us

Crescendo is the AI-Native Customer Experience Platform: one system that runs a company's entire CX operation and continuously improves it. We're replacing the fragmented stack the software industry has sold separately for decades - CCaaS, ticketing, workforce management, quality, knowledge - with specialized AI agents that do the work while people govern it. It's working: AI-handled volume on the platform grew 600% over the past year, brands like Grindr, Headspace and Nothing Bundt Cakes run on Crescendo, and Newsweek named us a 2026 AI Impact Awards winner. We're not competing in an existing category - we're creating one. Join early enough to make your mark on it.

The Role

The Director of Product Marketing owns Crescendo's product marketing function - positioning and messaging strategy, competitive intelligence, segment and pricing strategy, and the go-to-market execution that brings it all to market. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build the product marketing team as the company grows: you'll drive the function through influence and deep partnership with product, sales, and marketing.

What You Own

  • Messaging & Positioning: Continuously develop and refine messaging and competitive positioning based on market feedback.
  • Segment & GTM Strategy: Define priority market segments, positioning, proof points, and go-to-market strategy; recommend where to invest or deprioritize.
  • Competitive Strategy: Own competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, battlecards, and displacement strategy; translate market insights into product and GTM decisions.
  • Launches & Enablement: Orchestrate launches across product, sales, and marketing; build the decks, demos, and training that keep execution on message.
  • Analyst & Market Input: Arm leadership with the positioning, proof points, and briefing materials that shape how the category is understood, and channel what analysts and the market say back into messaging, competitive strategy, and product input.
  • Content Leadership: Own the content strategy and editorial engine - thought leadership, product content, and the narratives that build category authority and fuel demand.
  • Growth Partnership: Partner closely with growth on funnel messaging, campaign narratives, and conversion - ensuring what we say in-market is what wins in-market.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product marketing or related B2B marketing role
  • 4+ years leading product marketing strategy
  • Strong experience in B2B SaaS/technology/AI
  • Advanced, hands-on fluency with agentic AI / coding tools (Claude Code or Codex) - you build your own workflows, prototypes, and analyses with them, not just draft copy
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership - proven ability to align product, sales, and marketing and drive launches and GTM initiatives from plan to delivery.
  • Track record launching new products/features and driving adoption and revenue

Base Salary Ranges Per Region

$180,000-$210,000 | West Coast / Northeast

$160,000-$180,000 | Mid-Atlantic / Mountain / Midwest

$150,000-$170,000 | South / Southeast

This role is eligible for incentive opportunities and a benefits package, including medical, 401(k), paid time off and other company benefits.

Company Culture

Proudly certified as a Great Place to Work®, our culture combines an AI-first mindset with an environment where top talent thrives. Our core values define our operational standard and give us our edge. They set the bar for how we execute, innovate, and partner with the world's leading brands.

  • Care for Others: Empathy drives high performance. When our teams and partners thrive, the operational mission succeeds.
  • Embrace Growth: Curiosity fuels progress. Take calculated risks, sharpen your technical and operational edge, and push boundaries.
  • Manifest Trust: Trust is our primary currency. Earn it through execution, protect it fiercely, and build seamless collaboration.
  • Take Ownership: Act with extreme accountability and integrity. Decisive action drives lasting impact.
  • Be Humble: Humility unlocks better ideas. Listen actively, elevate collective intelligence, and maintain a continuous learning mindset.

Crescendo is an equal-opportunity workplace. We champion diversity, inclusion, equity, and belonging as core pillars of how we operate. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will also be considered in a manner consistent with legal requirements.

We are committed to full inclusion. If you require reasonable accommodations to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us at .

Privacy Notice

Crescendo is committed to protecting your personal data. By submitting your application, you consent to the processing and storage of your information for recruitment and hiring purposes. To learn more about our data protection standards and your rights, please visit our Privacy Center here.

jobs.description:
This position is remote; however, preference will be given to candidates located in the Los Angeles/Cudahy area to support occasional onsite collaboration and business needs.

The Project Manager (PM) will lead and oversee the project execution for key accounts across multiple divisions within the Aerospace & Defense business unit. In this role, the PM will own and lead business review(s), stakeholder engagement/management, and partner with operations and commercial leadership to foster continuous improvement and operational excellence. You will ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the exacting quality and compliance standards required by the aerospace and defense industry.

This position requires strong communication and organizational skills, deep knowledge of aerospace quality systems, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers while driving operational excellence and zero-incident safety performance.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Provide leadership, oversight, and day-to-day management of all MISTRAS Aerospace & Defense projects, including NDT/NDI (UT, RT, PT, MT, VT, PAUT, and related advanced methods), access services, and supporting industrial services.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, resources, budget, and deliverables from planning through closeout; develop and implement planning, cost control, and progress-tracking systems.
  • Build and sustain strong customer relationships; serve as the primary point of contact for clients, delivering regular status updates, KPI reports, and ensuring 100% customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure strict adherence to HSE, quality, and regulatory requirements (including applicable aerospace/defense standards such as Nadcap, AS9100, ITAR, and customer-specific procedures).
  • Lead risk management efforts, resolve field issues and unanticipated complexities promptly, and drive continuous improvement in safety, quality, and efficiency.
  • Assist with proposal development, scope definition, and budget estimation for new and ongoing Aerospace & Defense projects.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate daily/weekly status reports, staffing plans, work-location tracking, and performance metrics to both customers and internal leadership.
  • Demonstrate accessible, visible leadership that promotes positive employee morale, accountability, and adherence to company policies and procedures.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related technical field preferred.
  • 5+ years of Project Management, with at least 3 years managing Tier 1 or Tier 2 Suppliers (Aerospace & Defense experience strongly preferred).
  • Solid technical background in testing, inspections, and certifications, preferably within non-destructive test methods.
  • Prior experience working in regulated industries with strict quality, safety, and compliance requirements (aerospace, defense, or similar highly regulated sectors).
  • Strong customer relationship and communication skills (written and verbal); proven ability to manage stakeholders and deliver under pressure.
  • Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional teams with a track record of maintaining exceptional HSE performance and meeting project KPIs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools; experience with data extraction, KPI reporting, and large worklists/spreadsheets.
  • Willingness and ability to maintain a strong leadership presence, including travel to customer sites as required.
  • S. citizenship or ability to meet ITAR and other security/compliance requirements may be necessary depending on specific projects; active or ability to obtain security clearance preferred for certain defense work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • API, ASNT, or other relevant NDT certifications.
  • Experience with aerospace primes, defense contractors, or FAA-related work.
  • Familiarity with MISTRAS systems or similar asset integrity/project management platforms.

Additional Requirements:

  • Pass pre-employment background check, alcohol/drug screen, and any required medical evaluations.
  • Maintain relevant certifications and continue professional development as required.
  • Demonstrate the highest commitment to safety, quality culture, and ethical conduct in all
The salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
