You're an automation-first QA Engineer who approaches testing as an engineering discipline. Automation isn't a goal you work toward — it's the default approach for repeatable validation. You understand when testing belongs at the UI, API, or integration level, and you build reliable, maintainable automation that provides fast and meaningful feedback to the development team.

Manual testing still has an important place, but you use it intentionally for exploratory testing, usability validation, and one-time scenarios where automation provides limited value. Everything repeatable should be automated.

You write test code with the same discipline you bring to production code: code reviews, refactoring, reusability, reliability, and maintainability. When an automated test fails, you investigate it rather than simply reporting it, working to determine whether the issue is in the product, test, environment, or data.

Bonterra is seeking a QA Engineer – Automation to join our Efforts to Outcomes (ETO) engineering team. ETO is one of Bonterra's flagship products — a large-scale enterprise platform used by nonprofit organizations and public agencies to measure, manage, and improve program outcomes.

You'll work closely with Software Engineers, Product Management, and Customer Success to validate new features, expand automated coverage, improve test reliability, and ensure high-quality releases for clients who depend on ETO every day.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated tests for new features, bug fixes, and regression scenarios, prioritizing repeatable validation over recurring manual execution.
  • Own and evolve the automated test suite as a production-quality codebase, applying sound engineering practices such as reusable components, refactoring, code reviews, and reliable test design.
  • Help shape the team's test strategy and architecture, selecting the appropriate level of testing — UI, API, or integration — based on risk, coverage, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Build API and integration tests to validate business logic beyond the UI, including request/response validation, authentication and authorization, error handling, and data integrity.
  • Participate in design and code reviews with a testability lens, identifying requirements or technical designs that may be difficult to validate and advocating for solutions that make software easier to test.
  • Investigate automated test failures and identify root causes, distinguishing between product defects, test defects, environmental issues, and test-data problems.
  • Identify and eliminate flaky tests, improving the reliability and trustworthiness of the automated test suite rather than routinely ignoring or disabling unstable tests.
  • Identify and close coverage gaps based on product risk, business requirements, and customer impact.
  • Validate features, defects, and releases through functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing, including scenarios based on real customer workflows.
  • Use SQL and other diagnostic tools to validate data and troubleshoot application behavior when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineers and Product Management to understand business requirements and translate them into clear, maintainable, and executable automated tests.
  • Integrate automated testing into the development workflow so tests provide fast feedback during development and release processes.
  • Communicate quality risks, coverage, test results, and release readiness clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve QA practices, tooling, and processes across the ETO engineering team.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in QA Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or test automation for web applications, with a demonstrated history of building and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Strong Playwright experience, with the ability to build and extend a production-grade Playwright suite from day one.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, including the ability to write maintainable TypeScript test automation and comfortably read and understand application code.
  • Experience testing REST APIs, including Swagger/OpenAPI-documented endpoints.
  • Experience designing tests across UI, API, and integration layers and understanding when each approach is appropriate.
  • Understanding of test automation architecture and best practices, including test isolation, reusable components, test data management, assertions, parallel execution, and maintainability.
  • Experience with Git and pull-request-based development workflows, including participating in code reviews.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and running automated tests as part of a development pipeline.
  • Experience using SQL or relational databases to validate data and troubleshoot application behavior.
  • Experience with test management and issue tracking tools such as TestRail, Jira, or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, smoke, and exploratory testing methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex failures, reproduce issues reliably, and determine root causes.
  • Experience working in Agile environments, including Scrum or Kanban.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical findings, quality risks, and coverage gaps to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing or maintaining large-scale automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js beyond test automation.
  • Familiarity with AWS, particularly services such as S3 and CloudWatch, as they relate to validating file storage, application behavior, and logging.
  • Experience testing enterprise applications with complex business workflows and integrations.
  • Experience with API-first or service-level testing strategies that reduce reliance on UI automation.
  • Experience with test reporting, quality metrics, or other approaches for measuring automation effectiveness.
  • Familiarity with performance, accessibility, or security testing practices.
  • Passion for building technology that supports nonprofit organizations and social impact.

What You Can Expect

You can expect growth, continuous learning, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working alongside a collaborative team of engineers. You'll build software that helps nonprofit organizations and public agencies improve outcomes for the communities they serve.

Our engineering culture values curiosity, collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll be encouraged to grow your technical skills, contribute ideas, and take ownership of meaningful work while partnering closely with teammates across Engineering, Product Management, QA, Customer Success, and Support.

As an automation-focused QA Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to influence how quality is built into ETO — from requirements and technical design through development, automated testing, and release.

jobs.title: Senior MDM Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreHIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

  • Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance.

  • Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management.

  • Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems.

  • Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues.

  • Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party.

  • Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team.

  • Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

Identity resolution and matching

  • Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches.

  • Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization.

  • Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

Golden record and survivorship

  • Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage.

  • Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production.

  • Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

Party and relationship data modeling

  • Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data.

  • Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid.

  • Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

Data quality and stewardship

  • Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication.

  • Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient.

  • Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

Integration and pipelines

  • Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems.

  • Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency.

  • Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

Cloud data platform

  • Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold.

  • Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

Graph engineering

  • Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier.

  • Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

Programming and platforms

  • Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services.

  • Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product.

  • Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

Security, governance, and regulatory

  • Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship.

  • Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately.

  • Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed.

  • Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background.

  • Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept.

  • Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity.

  • Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity.

  • Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination.

  • AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master.

  • Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo).

  • A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience.

  • Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

MDM platforms

  • Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials.

  • Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform.

  • Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner).

  • Ataccama ONE certification.

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, the QA Lead will own test strategy and execution across our titles, serving as the connective tissue between our development teams and external test partners. This role is a fit for someone who thinks like an engineer about quality — building tools, automating where possible, instrumenting the pipeline — and who is curious about how AI and ML can evolve how games are tested. We're looking for someone who wants to evaluate, prototype, and integrate AI-assisted tooling thoughtfully into a real production QA practice.

Currently for this role, we can hire remote candidates with legal residence in Arizona, California, Florida, Michigan, New York, North Carolina, Texas, and Washington.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, develop, and oversee the execution of project test plans across one or more titles, ensuring work lands on time and at the quality bar the studio sets.   • Partner with development to provide testing support and feedback across gameplay systems, content, and game balance. You'll build and execute test strategies in lockstep with the engineering & production leadership and represent QA in cross-discipline meetings to ensure testing priorities track with project development priorities.

  • Explore how AI tooling can extend the QA practice — test case generation, log triage, crash clustering, automated repro, smarter bug deduplication, AI-assisted exploratory testing. You'll be expected to evaluate tools critically, prototype where it makes sense, and bring the rest of the team along.
  • Own the operational backbone of QA: 1st party certification coordination with Production and Development, clear and concise status reporting, and proactive prioritization based on where the project actually is.

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

Internal Job Description

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the area of informational technology risk advisory?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a FedRAMP Senior Assessor! Our Risk Advisory practice provides a full spectrum of services to help our clients assess their risks, develop strategies to compete in an ever-changing business environment, and achieve their goals and objectives. All of this is accomplished through deep industry knowledge of risk, governance, internal audit, compliance, IT, and cybersecurity best practices.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

Responsibilities:

  • Be client-centric

  • Lead advisory and assessment engagements

  • Conduct gap analyses

  • Write system security plans, policies, procedures, and other required documents

  • Evaluate and assess evidentiary artifacts and conclude whether or not they are sufficient to meet control

  • Document control test results based on FedRAMP-defined test case procedures

  • Assist in completing the Security Assessment Plan, Security Assessment Report, and Risk Exposure Table

  • Conduct stakeholder interviews, security boundary discussions, control walkthroughs with clients to verify control implementation status

  • Possess strong knowledge of FedRAMP, GovRAMP, and NIST

  • Critical thinking, analytical, writing, and basic editing skills with the ability to write to FedRAMP’s level of detail

Minimum Required Qualifications:

  • 4 year degree

  • Three (3) years of experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; major in cybersecurity, information technology, or information systems preferred

  • Minimum of three years of experience in information security auditing, demonstrating a steady growth of skills & responsibility required

  • Working knowledge of NIST 800-53 controls, FedRAMP requirements, and NIST risk management and security standards

  • Working experience of information security as it relates to audit and compliance

  • CISA, CISM, CISSP, GCED, GSLC, CCSP, CompTIA Cloud+, CASP+ certification or comparable IT security accreditation preferred

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Proven commitment to providing exceptional client service (internal and external)

  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively across functions/departments/teams while building trusted relationships and positively influencing others

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills

  • Effective time management and organizational skills, proven ability to prioritize while simultaneously managing numerous projects/processes often under tight deadlines

  • Ability to travel as needed, approximately 25%

The pay rate ranges for this position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

The national pay rate range is $85,910 to $162,890
In California: pay rate range is $102,000 to $162,890

jobs.description:
Full-time, temporary, fully remote, vacant position

Who We Are

The Canada Homestay Network Society is a non-profit society, that has helped tens of thousands of students find a home away from home in Canada. We connect international students with compassionate and caring families in Canada, creating enriching cultural experiences for both students and host families for the past 30 years.

Be part of something that matters! Join a new team that connects international students with compassionate and caring families in Canada, creating enriching cultural experiences for both students and host families.

About the Care & Support Representative position

The Care & Support Representative (CSR) is an essential team member and plays a critical role in ensuring the overall success of the homestay program. The CSR uses sound and reliable judgement to make decisions that directly impact the various stakeholders, and ultimately CHN’s reputation and client relations. CSRs will naturally be effective at collecting detailed facts, organizing information, participating in ongoing relationship building, reducing inconsistencies, and bringing order out of chaos.

The CSR will report to the Care & Support Lead and/or the National Operations Lead and are responsible for building and maintaining positive working relationships with international students, host families, international agencies, and our clients.

This is a temporary, full- time remote position across Canada with a schedule of30-40 hours per week with hours scheduled between 8:00am to 8:00pm EST, Monday to Friday. This role is a fixed-term contract position with an anticipated end date of January 2027.

The hourly pay ranges from $18.00 to $23.00, inclusive of regional differentials and based on previous experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver meaningful and effective client care through acknowledgement, authenticity, and understanding unique needs

  • Uphold the highest level of Customer Service by being flexible, attentive, reliable and responsive with our clients and colleagues

  • Take ownership and follow-up (TOFU) – take ownership over the customer experience and provide thorough follow-up, collaborating with team members when necessary

  • Communicate and develop effective working relationships with colleagues, clients, students, agents, and hosts following CHN policies and protocols for methods, timing, and documentation of all such communications and transactions

  • Engage with colleagues, host families, and students in order to monitor, manage, and bring closure to homestay inquiries and customer requests

  • Escalate crisis situations in a prompt and caring manner to the Care & Support Lead, Local Relationship Manager, Regional Director, and/or third-party mental health services

  • Collaborate with colleagues for second opinion and support in an organizational culture that encourages and depends on teamwork for positive outcomes

The successful candidate will have

  • 1+ years of Customer Service experience

  • Excellent Word, Excel, Email, and Database skills

  • Post-Secondary Certificate or Diploma in a relevant discipline, preferred

  • Experience working with international students and a variety of cultures is strongly preferred

  • Positive interpersonal skills and highly effective at de-escalating challenging customer interactions

  • Ability to work independently and autonomously in a virtual office environment

  • Ability to work in a team

  • Strong verbal and written English communication

  • Strong problem solving and organizational skills, with high attention to detail

Working Conditions

  • Fully remote

  • 40 hours per week with hours scheduled between 8:00am to 8:00pm EST, Monday to Friday.

  • Seasonal demands for registration, relocations, and respites (Fall and Winter intake)

  • Vacation blackout from August 15th – September 15th annually

How to Apply:

To view the full scope of this role, please viewthe complete job description. If you are interested in communicating with cultures from around the world and helping change international students live while in Canada, please apply with your cover letter and resume.

We thank all those who apply but only those applicants who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Our recruitment process relies on human review. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to screen, select, or assess candidates.

CHN is a Living Wage certified employer and determines our compensation based on where our team members live and work by using geographic differentials. As the living wage varies greatly across Canada, the differentials ensure that CHN is able to invest significantly in fair compensation packages across the country. The posted wage range for this role is inclusive of all regions as we are considering candidates from across the country.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Program Integrity Investigative Coordinator I monitors and maintains all SIU fraud reporting mechanisms (hotline, facets routing, fax, emails) to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Accurately load Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) referrals into the SIU Case Management System
  • Analyze FWA allegation facts and evaluate whether cases can be closed or escalated
  • Interview claimants, providers, members or any other individuals to obtain information relevant to any FWA investigation
  • Review claims for irregular billing patterns, consulting specialists when necessary
  • Generate various reports utilizing multiple fraud detection software systems
  • Conduct rudimentary data analysis to determine financial exposure or risk to FWA allegation across all lines of business
  • Responsible for maintaining anonymity and confidentiality during all phases of intake process
  • Independently identify billing errors and accidental overpayments initiating corrective action through the Research and Resolution Submission portal
  • Request medical records on an as-needed basis and as directed by Team Lead; partner with Clinical staff to resolve any issues
  • Assist Program Integrity in the oversight of Delegated Entities by routing state directed correspondence and generating claims data reports across all lines of business
  • Prepare and document Attestations, De-conflictions and Additional Allegation FWA informational letters, as contractually required, for any state Medicaid agency
  • Attend state Medicaid investigative meetings to transcribe updates provided by the Attorney General’s Office; update any applicable cases
  • Support compliance and regulatory requirements by verifying all state/federal directed provider removals are completed accurately across all lines of business
  • Drive accuracy of database information maintained in Case Management System; proactively verify the accuracy of provider information in concert with Facets and the Medicaid Information Technology System
  • Know and uphold the provisions of the Corporate Compliance Plan
  • Perform any other job related instructions as requested

Education and Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required
  • Associate’s Degree in Health-Related Field, Law Enforcement, or Insurance is preferred
  • Minimum of three (3) years’ experience in a health care related field or Customer Service is required
  • Health care experience preferred (medical/dental claims, auditing, medical office experience, etc.)

Competencies, Knowledge and Skills:

  • Intermediate computer skills consisting of Microsoft Excel, Access, Outlook, Word, and Power Point
  • Ability to navigate multiple software systems at a high proficiency level
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and within a team environment
  • High attention to detail
  • Critical listening and thinking skills
  • Proper grammar usage

  • Proper phone etiquette
  • Customer service oriented
  • Decision making/problem solving skills
  • Strong organization skills
  • Customer service oriented

  • None

jobs.title: Senior Director, Program Operations & Product Enablement
jobs.excerpt: College Board – BigFuture - Recruitment & Enrollment Solutions Location: This is a remote role.
jobs.description:
College Board – BigFuture - Recruitment & Enrollment Solutions

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

Our BigFuture team is committed to supporting all students to make the right first step for them after high school. BigFuture reaches over seven million students each year and is the leading free resource for College, Scholarship, and Career Exploration. BigFuture allows students to demystify the college going process, unlock options to afford college, and explore careers that connect to their skills and interests. In addition to the student-facing platform, we foster rich interactions between students and over 1,500 Higher Education institutions to help them identify strong matches.

Within BigFuture, our Recruitment & Enrollment Solutions (RES) team is comprised of dedicated, experienced professionals committed to the sales, support and long-term success of College Board’s market-leading enrollment solutions. Through consultative engagement and customer success methodologies, we support more than 1,200 higher education institutions annually, providing strategic insights, adoption support, and guidance on how to leverage College Board’s Search & Connections suite to achieve enrollment goals.

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Director, Program Operations & Product Enablement, you are a program leader with deep product fluency who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution. You've built or evolved subscription-based programs before, and you know how to turn data, policy, and customer signal into a portfolio that works for the business and the institutions it serves. You're energized by complexity, and you bring outside perspective and new approaches rather than defaulting to how things have always been done. You care as much about the mission behind the work as you do the mechanics of it.

You serve as the connective tissue between College Board's BigFuture Product team and the customer-facing RES organization, translating product direction into policy, provisioning, and readiness for more than 1,200 higher education institution partners, and carrying their voice and feedback back into product and portfolio decisions. You own the design and execution of the annual RES subscription model, including pricing and packaging, and you steward the governance framework, from eligibility rules to terms of service to data privacy, that protects students, institutions, and the business alike. You lead a team of three who bring deep functional expertise in contracting, compliance, and provisioning, and you partner closely with Legal, BigFuture Product, Customer Success, and Sales. This is a chance to be a genuine change agent for a flagship platform: Search has powered enrollment for decades and Connections is still building market adoption, and you'll help chart the next chapter for both.

In this role, you will:

Program Ownership & Strategic Leadership (30%)

  • Act as the program manager and policy leader for the full RES portfolio (Search, Connections™, and related features)

  • Lead and manage the design and execution of annual subscription model including pricing and packaging strategy for existing and future product launches or enhancements

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for enrollment solutions products, features, and subscription mechanics

  • Manage and direct annual subscription launch process and operations ahead of July 1 Subscription Year start including pilot launch and tracking (when necessary), documentation, internal Customer Success & Sales training, order opening window, eligibility, commercial incentives

Product/Portfolio Analysis and Enhancement (20%)

  • Drive data-informed decision-making across the Enrollment Solutions subscription portfolio by translating product usage, revenue performance, customer behavior, and operational signals into actionable strategic insights

  • Monitor adoption, utilization, renewal, and incentive performance

  • Analyze customer engagement with Search and Connections features

  • Build cohort analyses to evaluate product usage patterns

  • Translate customer behavior patterns into enhancement recommendations

  • Direct policy, documentation, and training for pilots, launches, redesigns, and sunsets

  • Lead portfolio redesign initiatives (e.g., 2027–28 evolution)

  • Serve as the voice of the customer across leadership teams translating feedback from Sales and Customer Success into product, portfolio, and strategy insights

Customer Provisioning & Delivery (10%)

  • Ensure operational excellence across the subscription lifecycle

  • Oversee purchase flow, eligibility determinations, Search access, Connections access, billing accuracy, account lock/unlock

  • Partner with product on incident response protocol and management and customer-impacting issue resolution

  • Establish data delivery standards and clean-file integrity

  • Improve operational and provisioning workflows that enhance customer satisfaction and retention while reducing time and effort of Sales and Customer Success staff

Policy, Compliance & Data Integrity Stewardship (20%)

  • Own the governance framework that protects students, institutions, and enterprise reputation

  • Collaborate with Legal and Product to author and maintain eligibility and usage policies

  • Lead subscription terms and contract updates

  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations and consent standards

  • Embed policy into systems, ordering flows, and contracts

  • Partner with Legal to monitor regulatory shifts

People Leadership & Program Operations (20%)

  • Lead and manage the Recruitment & Enrollment Solutions Program & Product Operations team

  • Lead a team of 3 that oversees purchase flow and contracting, eligibility and compliance, billing and invoicing, customer service and training, product delivery and incident management, third-party vendor partnership agreements and compliance, in partnership with Product & Tech

  • Set vision and priorities for the team, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission

  • Cultivate an inclusive and high-achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles effectively

  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 8-10+ years’ experience in program management within a SaaS or product organization, including significant experience in Higher Education EdTech, with deep subject-matter expertise in subscription-based product models, specifically pricing, packaging, and lifecycle management

  • Experience in higher education enrollment management, recruitment, and admissions is a strong plus

  • 3+ years of recent, direct people management experience

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to lead multiple initiatives independently and collaboratively

  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated experience translating usage, revenue, and customer behavior data (including cohort analysis) into actionable product and business recommendations

  • Experience designing and governing policy, contract, or compliance frameworks, ideally in partnership with Legal, involving eligibility rules, terms of service, or data privacy standards

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote
Annual salary:USD 180,000– USD 220,000
Type: Full-time
Reports to: General Counsel

About the Role

We're looking for a seasoned product counsel to be Nex's primary legal partner to Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Design, and Marketing - advising across the full product lifecycle, with particular depth in privacy and children's privacy compliance. You will own Nex's privacy program day-to-day, including COPPA compliance, camera- and AI-driven data collection practices, and consent and disclosure flows, while also advising on consumer protection, IP, emerging AI regulation, and the broader mix of legal issues that come up as we ship new hardware features, games, and Play Pass content.

This is a senior, largely independent role for someone who wants to build a product legal function from scratch rather than plug into an existing one - you'll be writing our first privacy program, our first product-review processes, and our first AI governance approach, with real opportunity to grow this into a larger function as Nex scales.

What You'll Do

Privacy & Child Safety Program Ownership

  • Own Nex's privacy program end-to-end: COPPA compliance, data mapping for our camera- and AI-driven product, vendor data processing agreements, and consent/disclosure flows for a product used heavily by children.
  • Draft, review, and maintain Nex's privacy policy, terms of service, and parental consent flows, including for new markets as we expand internationally (e.g., GDPR and other regional children's/data protection frameworks).
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety and Design on privacy-by-design principles and age-appropriate product experiences from ideation through launch.
  • Monitor the evolving children's privacy and online safety regulatory landscape (COPPA, state age-appropriate design laws, GDPR-K, and similar frameworks) and translate developments into actionable product guidance.
  • Serve as the point of contact for privacy incidents, regulatory inquiries, and data subject/parental requests, escalating appropriately to the GC and outside counsel.
  • Serve as the escalation point for Legal Operations and Commercial Counsel on any privacy or COPPA questions that surface in vendor, commercial, or operational contexts - they are trained to flag these to you rather than advise on them directly.

Product Counseling Across the Lifecycle

  • Be a trusted, embedded advisor to Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Design, and Marketing - reviewing new features, hardware capabilities, and AI/motion-detection functionality for legal risk from concept through launch.
  • Advise on consumer protection issues relevant to Play Pass and other subscription or in-product offerings, including disclosures, auto-renewal compliance, and promotions or sweepstakes tied to product launches or marketing campaigns.
  • Review product user experiences, in-app disclosures, and marketing/advertising materials to mitigate legal risk while supporting the team's goals.
  • Provide practical guidance on emerging AI regulation as it applies to Nex's computer vision and motion-detection technology, including responsible AI development and deployment considerations.
  • Flag physical product safety and liability considerations that arise from hardware feature design (e.g., camera/sensor placement, physical play mechanics, choking/impact hazards for young users) to the GC and outside counsel during feature review.
  • Support IP strategy for product innovation: facilitate invention harvesting and patent-strategy conversations with Engineering, and advise on trademark use in-product, in partnership with Legal Operations on portfolio docketing.

Building the Function

  • Build the playbooks, guides, and internal training that let Product, Engineering, and Marketing self-serve on lower-risk questions and escalate the right issues early.
  • Design a scalable legal review process for product launches that keeps pace with Nex's release cadence without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Partner with Legal Operations on intake triage and template design for product-related legal requests, and with Commercial Counsel to keep licensing/partnership agreements aligned with product privacy and IP commitments.
  • Manage outside counsel on specialized privacy, AI regulatory, product-safety, or IP matters as needed, with Legal Operations administering the underlying vendor relationship and spend.
  • As Nex scales, help define whether and how this function grows - this role has a credible path to leading a larger product legal team.

What You'll Bring

  • J.D. and active bar membership in good standing (California or another U.S. state, as applicable).
  • 4-7+ years of relevant legal experience, combining law firm and in-house product counseling at a technology or consumer products company.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with children's privacy compliance (COPPA, age-appropriate design frameworks, GDPR-K or similar) - this is the technical core of the role.
  • Experience advising product, engineering, and design teams throughout the full product development lifecycle, not just at launch review.
  • Working knowledge of consumer protection law as applied to subscriptions, promotions, and marketing claims.
  • Comfort advising on emerging AI/computer vision regulatory questions, even without a technical background, and genuine interest in the underlying technology.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable creating playbooks, review processes, and governance frameworks from scratch rather than operating an existing one.
  • Excellent judgment translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal audiences under real deadlines.
  • Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills and a low-ego, collaborative approach.

Nice to Have

  • Privacy certification (CIPP/US, CIPP/E, or similar), or willingness to obtain one.
  • Experience in consumer hardware, consumer electronics, gaming, or toy/kids' products.
  • Experience supporting sweepstakes, contests, or promotions tied to consumer products or subscriptions.
  • Exposure to patent or trademark strategy in a product/engineering context.
  • Experience advising on international product launches and multi-jurisdictional compliance.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Design and Marketing have a legal partner they trust to move fast on new features and launches with confidence.
  • Nex has a documented, defensible privacy and children's data protection program that scales as the company grows and enters new markets.
  • Privacy, consumer protection, and AI regulatory issues are surfaced and resolved at the design stage, not after the fact.
  • Playbooks, templates, and review processes let the product organization self-serve on routine questions, freeing this role to focus on the highest-impact issues.
  • Nex is positioned to expand this function as the business grows, with this person as the natural lead.

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

About the opportunity

Our Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response (CTIR) engineers are the people we count on when something goes wrong, and the people who make sure it goes wrong far less often. This is a hands-on incident response role. You'll lead the response to security events across our platforms and applications: triage, investigate, contain, eradicate and recover, then make sure we come out of it stronger.

We're looking for someone who genuinely loves incident response. Someone who gets calmer and sharper when an incident kicks off, who is confident making decisions when the picture isn't complete, and who doesn't wait to be told what to look at. If you're a self-starter who takes ownership from the first alert to the final report, you'll fit right in.

Some of the other responsibilities include :

  • Own incidents as part of the CTIR team: detect, triage, investigate, contain and eradicate, driving each one until the threat is under control.
  • Work live incidents alongside the team and be ready to step up and take the lead yourself when the situation calls for it.
  • Lead investigations across our systems, digging into logs, endpoints, email and network data to work out what happened, how far it reached, and how to resolve.
  • Perform host and network forensics, malware triage, and email analysis (including PDF and document analysis) to understand attacker activity and build a reliable timeline.
  • Coordinate with engineering, IT and the wider security team during a response, and communicate clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Hunt proactively for threats across system logs, user behaviour and threat intelligence, turning what you find into new detections and indicators of compromise.
  • Build and automate incident response workflows and playbooks so routine response is fast and repeatable.
  • Strengthen our detection coverage using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, closing monitoring gaps, and tuning to reduce noise.
  • Feed what you learn from each incident back into how the team detects and responds, so an attack pattern we've seen once is caught faster next time.
  • Analyse threat intelligence, research emerging threats, and recommend practical mitigation.
  • Be ready to work incidents as they arise, including on-call and out-of-hours cover when needed.

For this position, you'll work fully remote. You need to be based in NZ and have full working rights for this region.

  • Good understanding of ITIL processes and standards such as ISO 27001 and PCI DSS, including change, incident and problem management.

  • Preferred certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AZ-500 or SC-100.

Description

CapsLock builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

﻿Role Overview

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

Responsibilities

﻿

﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

2. User Needs & Automation

  • Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
  • Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

3. Product Development & Delivery

  • Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
  • Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration

  • Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
  • Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

5. Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
  • Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
  • Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
  • Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
  • Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. (Examples will be requested).
  • Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
  • Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
  • Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
  • Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
  • Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

The Senior Strategist, Data & AI strengthens the capacity of RTSL and its government partners to use data, digital systems, and artificial intelligence to improve public health programs and decision-making. Working across RTSL's program portfolio, the role brings together public health strategy, data architecture, digital transformation, and AI governance to identify high-value opportunities and help translate them into practical, sustainable approaches.

The Senior Strategist advises program and country teams on data architecture, interoperability, data governance, and AI readiness; shapes and prioritizes data- and AI-enabled initiatives; and builds RTSL's capacity to use emerging technologies responsibly and effectively. Externally, the role works with governments, technical partners, and the broader global health ecosystem to advance country-owned approaches to stronger data systems and responsible AI.

Data Strategy and Architecture

jobs.description:
Description

Senior Power Integrity Engineer

﻿About DriveNets

﻿DriveNets is a leader in high-scale networking software for AI infrastructure and service providers. The company pioneered a disaggregated networking architecture that transforms the economics of large-scale networks while maximizing performance, utilization, and operational efficiency. DriveNets-powered networks are deployed by global leaders, including AT&T and Comcast, supporting more than 30% of total U.S. internet traffic. DriveNets AI Fabric delivers full-stack networking for AI infrastructures, providing the highest-performance, Ethernet-based alternative to InfiniBand. The solution is deployed by hyperscalers, NeoClouds, and enterprises worldwide. With over $1B raised, DriveNets continues to push the boundaries of modern networking infrastructure.

The Role

DriveNets is seeking a highly motivated Power Integrity Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, analyzing, simulating, and validating power delivery networks (PDNs) for next-generation networking platforms supporting high-performance ASICs, advanced SerDes interfaces, optical modules, and AI-scale networking systems.

You will work closely with hardware architects, PCB designers, ASIC teams, signal integrity engineers, mechanical engineers, and manufacturing partners to ensure robust power delivery, optimal system performance, and successful product deployment.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Power Integrity (PI) activities throughout the hardware development lifecycle, from architecture through production.
  • Define and optimize board-level and package-level Power Delivery Networks (PDNs) for high-current networking ASICs and supporting devices.
  • Perform pre-layout and post-layout PI simulations using industry-standard tools.
  • Establish target impedance requirements and validate compliance across all power rails.
  • Analyze DC voltage drop, AC impedance, transient response, and power distribution performance.
  • Collaborate with PCB layout engineers to optimize stackups, plane structures, decoupling strategies, and power routing.
  • Work closely with Signal Integrity engineers to ensure SI/PI co-optimization of high-speed interfaces.
  • Develop power integrity design guidelines and best practices for next-generation networking products.
  • Support schematic reviews, layout reviews, and design sign-off activities.
  • Perform laboratory measurements and correlation using oscilloscopes, VNAs, power analyzers, current probes, and related equipment.
  • Investigate and resolve PI-related issues during board bring-up, validation, and production.
  • Collaborate with ASIC, FPGA, memory, optics, and power component vendors to optimize overall system performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of PI methodologies, simulation flows, and validation processes.

Why Join DriveNets

  • Work on industry-leading networking systems deployed by top-tier service providers and cloud operators.
  • Influence next-generation networking hardware architecture.
  • Collaborate with world-class hardware, ASIC, and software engineers.
  • Be part of a fast-growing company transforming the networking industry

Requirements

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in Power Integrity, Hardware Design, or related disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of power delivery networks, decoupling methodologies, and target impedance concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with PI simulation tools such as:
  • Cadence Sigrity PowerSI / OptimizePI
  • Ansys SIwave
  • Ansys HFSS
  • PowerDC or equivalent
  • Experience designing high-layer-count PCBs for networking, telecom, server, or data-center products.
  • Knowledge of high-speed digital systems and interaction between Signal Integrity and Power Integrity.
  • Experience with multi-phase voltage regulators, power sequencing, and power management architectures.
  • Strong understanding of PCB materials, stackups, and manufacturing constraints.
  • Experience performing lab validation and correlation measurements.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-performance networking ASICs and switch silicon.
  • Familiarity with 112G/224G/448G PAM4 SerDes technologies.
  • Experience with Ethernet systems ranging from 400G to 1.6T and above.
  • Understanding of package-level PI and advanced packaging technologies.
  • Familiarity with optical networking platforms and co-packaged optics.
  • Experience with thermal and mechanical effects on PDN performance.
  • Knowledge of EMI/EMC considerations in high-density networking systems.
  • Experience working with ODMs, CMs, and global manufacturing partners.

Success Metrics

  • Achieve PI sign-off requirements for all networking platforms.
  • Minimize power-related issues during bring-up and production.
  • Improve first-pass hardware success rate.
  • Enable reliable operation of next-generation high-bandwidth networking systems.
  • Establish scalable PI methodologies for future DriveNets hardware platforms.

More About DriveNets

Based in Israel with locations in Romania, US, India and Japan as well as extended teams, DriveNets operations cover more than twelve countries. With recognition by industry analysts and through partnerships with market leaders such as AMD, Broadcom, Dell and others, DriveNets is pushing market momentum, delivering the scale and efficiency that modern AI workloads demand. Job Summary
We are seeking a GPU Systems Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

jobs.description:
We’re expanding our capabilities across Latin America, and we’re hiring a Senior Clinical Research Associate to support critical studies across Brazil!

As a Senior CRA you'll posses a wide-ranging and broad experience handling our most complex and advanced assignments. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the type and timing of the program to which the Senior CRA is assigned and will, at a minimum, include start-up and study implementation activities, on-site monitoring of clinical research studies as well as on-going site management. Incumbents are expected to be able to manage appropriately sized or complex clinical trials, and support Clinical Trial Managers and/or Project Managers with trials as required. An increased focus on training and mentoring junior staff members may be expected.

Responsibilities:

  • Independently oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions
  • Establishes, updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports
  • Manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager
  • If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues
  • Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre-study/qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH-GCP and Precision SOPs. Performs Monitoring Oversight Visits to assess other CRA team members. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on-site and remote)
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
  • Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision's Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues
  • Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision's high quality and professional image
  • Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned
  • Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies
  • Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process
  • Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with oversight from project team
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face-to-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. May prepare or assist in preparation of study-specific presentations/training materials and tools
  • Assists the team managers in the preparation and review of protocols and other study documentation
  • Supports the design and development of CRFs and clinical trial documents as they pertain to clinical monitoring activities (i.e. operating manuals, monitoring guidelines, etc.)
  • Assists with review of clinical study reports
  • Functions as a mentor, assisting with the training and developing of new employees and junior monitors
  • Interacts with client, participates in proposal activities, including development and client presentations
  • Initiates payment requests for investigators
  • Travels as necessary according to project needs
  • Other job duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Experience:

  • 4-year college degree or equivalent experience in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • 5 years or more as a CRA in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies
  • Significant site management experience or equivalent experience in clinical research
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level)

Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Graduate, postgraduate degree
  • Experience monitoring in rare and complex therapeutic areas
  • Experience monitoring EDC trials and EHR records
  • Experience in biopharma or relevant therapeutic area
  • Relevant site start-up (feasibility, contract negotiations, submissions) experience for the country
  • Ability to monitor study sites, with supervision, according to protocol monitoring guidelines, SOPs, GCP and ICH guidelines
  • Ability to resolves project related problems and prioritize workload to meet deadlines with oversight from management. Can assist junior CRAs in problem resolution
  • Ability to travel overnight. Up to 60% travel on average, based on regional requirements. International travel as needed
  • Select opportunities require Oncology experience preferably in early phases
  • Exhibits self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Understands clinical trials methodology, including a working knowledge of protocols and indications being studied.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including colleagues, investigative staff, and clients with a high level of proficiency.
  • Demonstrated focus on continuous improvement, including the ability to make proactive assessments on how to make processes more efficient and people more effective.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Transitions of Care (TOC) is one of Devoted Medical's largest clinical programs. From admission through 30 days post-discharge, our virtual interdisciplinary teams help thousands of patients get home safely and stay there, clearing the clinical, social, and logistical barriers that usually get in the way. Our Social Worker Case Managers are the advocates, coaches, and connectors in that work — building trusting relationships with patients and caregivers, developing individualized plans of care that align community, clinical, and financial resources, and supporting patients discharging from a behavioral health level of care.

We're looking for a Manager of Social Work Case Management to build, lead, and inspire that team, along with our behavioral health care coordinators. You'll also serve on TOC's interdisciplinary management team alongside managers from our physician, NP/PA, RN case management, and care coordination functions, sharing accountability for the clinical, operational, and cultural success of our front-line care teams.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Building and developing a high-performing team of Social Worker Case Managers and behavioral health care coordinators, with a culture of service that shows up in patient outcomes

  • Tracking staff performance through competency check-offs, audits, shadowing, and 1:1s, and coaching where support is needed

  • Creating workflows, assessments, and plans of care that build efficiency for the team and measurable results for patients

  • Supporting the team on escalated patient needs

  • Leading onboarding for new teammates and ongoing education for existing staff

  • Partnering with cross-functional teams to drive execution and standardize workflows across programs

  • Meeting regularly with the Senior Manager of the RN and SW TOC functions to review team performance, wins, and areas for improvement

  • Spend 30–40% of your time on direct patient outreach and case work, staying close to what your team navigates day to day and where the Social Work care model needs to improve.

Required skills and experience:

  • An active social work license (LMSW or higher)

  • 3+ years of experience in case management

  • 3+ years of experience in people management, including developing and retaining a high-performing team

  • Experience working with — and preferably managing — interdisciplinary care management teams

  • Ability to independently manage a fully remote schedule, M–F, 8:30am–5:00pm CST, MST, or PST

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience leading clinical teams and operations with direct accountability for health outcomes, including driving new initiatives to measurable results

  • Strong analytical instincts paired with strong clinical social work skills — you can set quantitative goals and act on data, and you're confident training a team to manage complex patients so needs don't fall through the cracks

Salary range: $73,000 - $110,000 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees.
