jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

Choice Hotels is seeking a results-driven Senior Director, Group, Meetings & Events to lead the strategy, growth, and performance of the company’s group sales business. This role leads a team of Group Sales Directors, Managers, and the Inside Sales functionand is responsible for developing and executing sales and marketing strategies that increase revenue through group, meetings, and event channels. The position serves as a strategic leader within Global Sales, managing key third-party partnerships, evaluating market opportunities, driving adoption of data-driven sales practices, and supporting hotel engagement across the portfolio. This leader partners cross-functionally to deliver strategic business results, influence organizational priorities, and drive incremental revenue for Choice Hotels. The role functions as part of the leadership team of a sales organization and has significant impact on departmental performance and business outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead, develop, and coach a team responsible for driving group, meetings, and events revenue growth.

  • Establish performance expectations, revenue objectives, pipeline goals, and accountability measures to ensure consistent achievement of business targets.

  • Develop and execute comprehensive sales and marketing strategies that increase revenue and market share across group channels and vertical markets.

  • Identify and cultivate new business opportunities while strengthening existing customer relationships and strategic accounts.

  • Drive adoption of insights-based selling practices leveraging data, analytics, CRM platforms, Tableau, Salesforce, and other business intelligence tools.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key third-party providers and strategic partners that support group and meeting business growth.

  • Lead meeting technology integration initiatives and support connectivity with external group and meeting platforms.

  • Partner closely with Distribution, Marketing, Revenue Management, Sales Enablement, and other internal stakeholders to optimize channel performance and customer engagement.

  • Develop channel-specific business plans and marketing programs designed to increase customer acquisition, retention, and loyalty.

  • Deliver communication, education, and training to hotel operators regarding group channel opportunities, platform utilization, and revenue optimization strategies.

  • Manage budgets, resource allocation, and operational plans supporting assigned channels and strategic initiatives.

  • Analyze business trends, market dynamics, customer insights, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and implement solutions that improve business performance.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives and contribute to the strategic direction of the Global Sales organization.

QUALIFICATIONS

Employment Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive sales, business development, account management, hospitality, travel, meetings, events, or related commercial experience.

  • 7+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing high-performing sales teams.

  • Demonstrated experience creating and executing sales strategies that drive revenue growth and market share.

  • Experience managing strategic partnerships, vendor relationships, and cross-functional business initiatives.

  • Experience with budget ownership, business planning, forecasting, and operational management.

  • Hospitality, lodging, travel, meetings, or events industry experience preferred.

  • Experience leading managers or senior-level sales professionals preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

  • Experience utilizing Salesforce.com or comparable CRM platforms.

  • Experience with Tableau or other business intelligence and reporting tools.

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation capabilities.

  • Experience with sales pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting systems.

  • Familiarity with marketing technology and digital communication platforms preferred.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and business acumen.

  • Exceptional leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities.

  • Strong communication, presentation, and executive influencing skills.

  • Ability to define and lead organizational change initiatives.

  • Proven relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

  • Ability to evaluate market trends and translate insights into business results.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional partnerships and strategic initiatives.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, Sales, Communications, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related discipline preferred or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • Relevant industry certifications are a plus but not required.

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this position is $140,000 to $1850,000 annually, plus variable, performance-based sales commission. In addition to the annual salary and commission, this role is eligible for annual awards of Choice Hotels International common stock through Choice’s Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTI Plan).

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

Nearby.ai is a home services platform that connects homeowners with trusted local service providers — plumbers, electricians, cleaners, landscapers, HVAC technicians, and more. We're building the merchant network that makes that matching possible, and looking for a motivated intern to help drive that growth through local business outreach and partnership development.

We're looking for an MBA-level Business Development & Strategy Intern to own a merchant-acquisition initiative end-to-end — from market research and territory selection, through self-sourced outreach and negotiation, to data-driven analysis and a final recommendation to leadership.

This is not a support role: you'll be measured on real business outcomes — partners signed, pipeline built, and insight generated — not just activity.

What You'll Own, End to End

Market and Territory Research

  • Independently map the local service-provider landscape in an assigned category or geography (for example, HVAC in a specific metro): merchant density, typical acquisition channels, and competitive platforms (Angi, Thumbtack, Yelp, etc.)
  • Size the opportunity and prioritize which merchant categories or neighborhoods to target first, using your own scoring framework

Self-Sourced Outreach and Pipeline Development

  • Build your own target list and reach out directly via phone, email, in-person visits, and social media — no inherited leads
  • Introduce Nearby.ai and pitch the value proposition to local business owners, handling objections yourself
  • Build and maintain a pipeline in a CRM or spreadsheet with real discipline: stage, next step, and expected close
  • Adjust your outreach approach based on the response-rate data you track yourself

Analysis and Business Case Development

  • Analyze outreach and conversion data to identify what's working and quantify results (contacts made, response rates, conversion rates)

  • Build a simple business case (expected partners signed, revenue impact) to justify where to focus next

Solutioning and Partnership Development

  • Independently draft outreach scripts, pitch decks, and partnership proposals tailored to each merchant type
  • Lead onboarding conversations through to close

Reporting and Recommendations

  • Report weekly on outreach metrics and pipeline, framed as insights and next steps, not just raw counts

Who You Are

  • Currently pursuing an MBA (or equivalent graduate business program), ideally with prior experience in consulting, sales, BD, or a startup
  • Comfortable being fully self-directed — you build the plan, not just execute someone else's
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills; genuinely comfortable working in spreadsheets and data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to cold-call and negotiate with small-business owners
  • High tolerance for ambiguity and rejection — energized by 0-to-1, hands-on work

Details

  • Type: Internship, 20–40 hrs/week
  • Duration: 3–6 months
  • Location: Remote
  • Compensation: Paid, $40-60 hourly

Why Join Nearby.ai

  • Own a real merchant-acquisition initiative from research through close — a rare level of end-to-end ownership for an internship

jobs.description:
about the role

Compensation: £82,951 – £97,200 (UK benchmark - the salary will be adjusted to reflect local market for other locations)

Location: Remote (open to candidates based in Singapore or Philippines)

At TransitionZero, Market Development connects the real decisions facing governments, utilities and other energy system stakeholders with the modelling, software and analysis needed to answer them. It then builds the pathway from the first conversation through solution definition, implementation, adoption and evidence of value. We are looking for an Head of Engagement, ASEAN, to help build this capability across Southeast Asia, combining market creation, institutional relationship development, solution discovery, implementation leadership and external positioning.

The role will identify the most valuable decision problems in priority markets, translate them into credible Scenario Builder use cases and progress qualified opportunities into funded pilots, strategic partnerships and future commercial adoption. Early wins will include a clear evidence-based regional market strategy, trusted coverage of priority institutions, a pipeline of well-qualified opportunities, and repeatable market narratives and implementation pathways grounded in real user needs.

Reporting to and working in close partnership with the Head of Market Development, this is a senior regional leadership role that aligns regional priorities, major opportunities, external positioning and implementation with the Head, while providing matrix leadership across cross-functional teams.

The role operates across the full adoption pathway and will draw on product, modelling, engineering and communications expertise where specialist input is required. The role is accountable for external evidence, solution narrative, stakeholder orchestration, opportunity progression and market follow-through.

responsibilities

Market Strategy & Intelligence ~20%

  • Develop and execute, in close partnership with the Head of Market Development, an evidence-based regional market strategy for ASEAN.

  • Build and maintain granular growth maps, stakeholder maps and strategic account plans across priority governments, utilities, system operators, energy companies, financial institutions, advisory firms and ecosystem partners.

  • Conduct and synthesise market, policy, regulatory, institutional, procurement, competitor and buyer analysis, converting evidence into clear market choices, account priorities and internal recommendations.

Discovery & Solution Definition ~20%

  • Lead consultative discovery with users and senior decision-makers to understand the decision question, existing workflow, current tools, data environment, institutional context, procurement route, adoption conditions and evidence of success.

  • Translate external decision problems into well-defined modelling and software use cases, defining intended users and decisions, high-level data and analytical requirements, success criteria, scope boundaries and an implementation pathway before specialist validation.

  • Explain modelling concepts, assumptions, scenarios, outputs and limitations in clear decision language, and lead or support product demonstrations, workshops and solution conversations with credibility.

Opportunity & Implementation Delivery ~15%

  • Progress qualified opportunities through business case development, concept notes, work and action plans, funding or procurement, pilot delivery and adoption, maintaining clear owners, milestones and external commitments.

  • Coordinate the market and stakeholder side of implementation so that technical work, user workflows, decision timelines, communications, training and adoption remain aligned around the intended outcome.

External Positioning & Partnerships ~25%

  • Develop the market-facing narrative and evidence required to build demand, including value propositions, use case stories, briefs, proposals, presentations, case studies, executive talking points, partner materials and event content.

  • Design and lead roundtables, roadshows, conferences, stakeholder workshops and senior meetings with defined audiences, intended decisions, disciplined follow-through and evidence capture.

  • Build and enable an ecosystem of local partners, advisors and institutions that can extend TransitionZero's reach and support credible implementation, referral or co-delivery pathways.

  • Travel across Southeast Asia as required and work flexibly across customer and partner time zones while maintaining disciplined communication and follow-through with the wider team.

Knowledge Management & Product Feedback ~15%

  • Capture complete market, relationship, opportunity and implementation intelligence in HubSpot and shared systems so that knowledge and evidence are current, reusable and organisationally owned.

  • Feed validated user evidence, market signals and implementation learning into Product and technical teams to strengthen reusable capabilities, product positioning and prioritisation while protecting scope boundaries.

about you

You are a structured market builder with enough technical fluency to discuss modelling and software credibly, enough analytical judgement to choose where to invest, and sufficient communication skills to turn complex evidence into a compelling external narrative. You are equally comfortable with senior institutional stakeholders and technical specialists, and you combine relationship building with rigorous implementation follow-through and organisational knowledge capture.

While we are a rapidly growing tech startup, we are also a non-profit, so a high level of adaptability and willingness to approach challenges with creativity and curiosity is essential.

skills & experience

Essential:

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in market development, strategic partnerships, solution consulting, product commercialisation or complex solution implementation, ideally in energy, power, infrastructure, analytics or technology.

  • Substantial experience working across one or more Southeast Asian markets, with a practical understanding of the region's energy sector institutions, stakeholder landscape and commercial or funding dynamics.

  • A track record of building new markets, segments or strategic accounts and progressing complex opportunities with multiple stakeholders and long decision cycles.

  • Experience helping to implement complex software, data, analytics, modelling or advisory solutions, from discovery and scope definition through delivery, user enablement and adoption.

  • A working understanding of how power system, electricity market or infrastructure modelling informs planning, investment, policy or operational decisions, with confidence discussing inputs, assumptions, scenarios, outputs, validation and limitations.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical capabilities and analytical outputs into decision-oriented use cases, implementation pathways and value narratives for senior and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to synthesise market, policy, institutional, customer and competitor evidence into clear choices and recommendations.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce compelling concept notes, proposals, presentations, executive briefs, case studies and meeting outputs.

  • Strong opportunity, account and project planning discipline, including effective use of CRM and shared documentation to manage pipeline and preserve institutional intelligence.

  • Willingness to travel regularly across Southeast Asia and to work with reasonable flexibility around customer and partner time zones.

Desirable:

  • Direct exposure to power system planning, electricity market simulation or energy analytics software such as PLEXOS, PyPSA, OSeMOSYS or comparable tools.

  • Experience working with governments, utilities, system operators, development finance institutions, grant funders, public procurement or multi-organisation programmes.

  • Academic or professional grounding in power systems, energy economics, energy policy, engineering, data analytics or a related field.

  • Experience developing value propositions, market-facing content, case studies, executive events or thought leadership for a complex technical proposition.

  • Experience in a startup, scale-up or mission-driven organisation where market, product and delivery functions work closely together.

  • Professional proficiency in one or more Southeast Asian languages.

salary & benefits

  • Retirement Plan out-enrolment from day 1

  • Enhanced annual leave entitlement

  • Annual allowance to set up your home office

  • Annual budget and dedicated leave time for relevant training courses

  • Enhanced gender-neutral parental leave

  • Private healthcare following the successful completion of the probation period

  • Yearly team offsites

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day operational backbone of a fast-growing better-for-you snack brand.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an Operations Manager to own the day-to-day operational backbone of a fast-growing better-for-you snack brand. You will work across order management, supply chain, procurement, production planning, logistics, inventory, forecasting, vendor management, financial analysis, and operational systems.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. We are not looking for someone who follows existing processes. We want someone who constantly asks how things can be made better, faster, more accurate, or more efficient — and then takes the initiative to make it happen. AI proficiency is a hard requirement for this role. We use AI every day and expect this person to do the same. If you are highly organized, analytically sharp, financially literate, tech-savvy, and proactive by nature, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern Time
  • Own the full operational function of a growing CPG brand with real retail traction across major distributors and retail chains
  • High-ownership, high-variety role where your operational decisions directly impact profitability and growth

What You'll Work On

Order Management and Fulfillment

  • Own the complete order lifecycle from receipt of a customer purchase order through shipment, delivery, invoicing, and issue resolution
  • Process and manage customer POs accurately and on time
  • Coordinate inventory allocation and fulfillment across customers and distributors
  • Work directly with distributors, retailers, warehouses, manufacturers, and logistics providers to ensure orders are fulfilled correctly
  • Manage EDI orders and related operational requirements
  • Proactively identify and resolve shortages, shipment discrepancies, deductions, late deliveries, and other order issues

Logistics and Shipping

  • Coordinate parcel, LTL, and FTL shipments
  • Obtain and evaluate freight quotes and identify cost-effective shipping options
  • Prepare and manage BOLs, shipping documentation, routing requirements, appointments, and retailer and distributor delivery requirements
  • Track shipments through delivery and proactively address delays or exceptions
  • Continuously identify opportunities to reduce freight costs and improve logistics efficiency

Inventory and Production Planning

  • Manage inventory across finished goods, ingredients, raw materials, and packaging
  • Maintain appropriate inventory levels and reorder points to minimize both stockouts and excess inventory
  • Develop and maintain inventory and demand forecasts
  • Coordinate production runs with manufacturers based on forecasts, open POs, inventory levels, lead times, and anticipated demand
  • Monitor production schedules and proactively address potential delays or shortages

Procurement and Vendor Management

  • Procure ingredients, packaging, and other materials required for production
  • Issue and manage purchase orders to suppliers
  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, MOQs, lead times, and other commercial terms
  • Develop strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, freight providers, warehouses, and other outside vendors
  • Hold vendors accountable for commitments, timelines, pricing, and service levels
  • Continuously identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve vendor performance

Forecasting, Data, and Financial Analysis

  • Build and maintain sales and demand forecasts
  • Forecast inventory, ingredients, packaging, production requirements, and cash needs
  • Analyze COGS, landed costs, gross margins, freight costs, promotional costs, distributor margins, and retailer margins
  • Build and maintain pricing and margin models
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities
  • Create reporting that gives management clear visibility into the health of the business

Accounting and Financial Operations

  • Apply strong working knowledge of AP, AR, accrual vs. cash accounting, COGS, gross margin, P&L statements, inventory accounting, purchase orders, and three-way matching
  • Assist with bookkeeping, bill entry, reconciliations, and AP/AR as needed based on business bandwidth
  • Work within QuickBooks to support financial operations

AI, Technology, and Automation

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT daily to analyze data, automate repetitive workflows, research operational problems, create and improve SOPs, and improve personal productivity
  • Identify repetitive tasks that can be automated or streamlined and take initiative to build better systems
  • Learn new software and unfamiliar systems quickly without requiring extensive training
  • Maintain high proficiency across Google Sheets, Gmail, Google Workspace, QuickBooks, Salesforce, and EDI systems

Food Safety, Quality, and Compliance

  • Coordinate operational food safety and quality documentation with manufacturers and suppliers
  • Maintain and organize COAs, product specifications, ingredient documentation, and related records
  • Assist with lot tracking, expiration dates, traceability, and recall readiness
  • Support compliance with applicable FDA, retailer, distributor, and food safety requirements

What You Bring

  • 5 or more years of relevant operations, supply chain, logistics, procurement, or related experience
  • Strong understanding of accounting and financial principles including COGS, margins, P&L, and cash flow
  • Demonstrated experience managing POs, inventory, procurement, production planning, and logistics
  • Experience working with freight carriers, warehouses, manufacturers, suppliers, and other outside vendors
  • Strong forecasting capabilities with the ability to build and maintain operational and financial models
  • Demonstrated proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of daily work, not occasional use
  • Advanced Google Sheets and spreadsheet skills including large datasets, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, financial models, and operational reporting
  • Extremely tech-savvy with the ability to learn new systems quickly
  • Excellent written communication skills with proactive follow-up as a default behavior
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage a high volume of emails, tasks, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously
  • Comfortable making decisions and taking full ownership of outcomes

Nice to Have

  • Food, beverage, CPG, or consumer products experience
  • Experience with QuickBooks
  • Familiarity with inventory management systems, retailer portals, distributor portals, 3PL systems, and shipping platforms
  • Experience managing EDI orders and related operational requirements
  • Background in a high-growth or early-stage consumer brand environment

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your operations experience in supply chain, procurement, or logistics, and walking through how you use AI tools as a regular part of your operational workflow

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a proactive, analytically sharp operator who takes ownership, uses AI every day, and wants to run the operational engine of a growing CPG brand from end to end, this role gives you the scope and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. More about our team and company:

  • Our careers page:

Fleetio is looking for a Partner Development Manager to build and grow a portfolio of strategic reseller relationships — Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), telematics providers, and VARs — across the full partner lifecycle. This is a true hunter-farmer role: you'll be equally accountable for sourcing, qualifying, and signing new reseller partners and for managing and growing the partners already in your book. You're comfortable running a cold or warm partner pipeline from first conversation to signed agreement, and just as comfortable sitting across from an existing partner asking "where's our next dollar of growth together."

You'll work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal to build the partner pipeline, close new agreements, enable partners post-signature, and turn signed relationships into ramped, revenue-generating accounts.

What You'll Do

New Partner Development

  • Identify, prospect, and qualify new reseller partner candidates across FMC, Telematics, and VAR segments, building and managing your own outbound pipeline.
  • Own the full sales cycle for new partner agreements — discovery, pitch, commercial negotiation, legal/redline coordination — through signature.
  • Score and prioritize prospective partners against Fleetio's qualification criteria (market fit, geographic fit, program maturity, pipeline potential) to focus effort on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Build relationships with executive sponsors at prospective partner organizations to secure buy-in and accelerate path-to-close.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date view of the partner pipeline (stage, blockers, next actions, target ETA) in Salesforce/partner tracking tools.

Existing Partner Growth

  • Own a book of signed reseller partners end-to-end — from onboarding and enablement through renewal and expansion.
  • Build and maintain a shared definition of "growth" with each partner: agreed targets for assets under management, ARR, and pipeline, tracked consistently and revisited regularly.
  • Proactively identify incremental revenue opportunities within existing partner accounts — new segments, new use cases, underpenetrated regions, or expanded product attach.
  • Drive partner performance against joint business plans, holding partners (and internal stakeholders) accountable to commitments and timelines.
  • Support QBRs, joint marketing initiatives, and co-selling motions with key partners.

Across Both

  • Partner closely with internal Sales teams to ensure partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities are tracked, supported, and closed efficiently.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business model, competitive position, and channel economics in order to tailor Fleetio's value proposition and identify white space.
  • Represent the voice of the partner internally — surfacing blockers, feedback, and market intelligence to Product, Marketing, and Partnerships leadership.

  • 10+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, or a strategic account management role — ideally in B2B SaaS, fleet, telematics, or a related vertical.

  • Bias toward action and ownership — you don't wait to be told where the next dollar of growth is, whether that's a brand-new partner or an existing one; you go find it.

Transitions of Care (TOC) is one of Devoted Medical's largest clinical programs. From admission through 30 days post-discharge, our virtual interdisciplinary teams help thousands of members get home safely and stay there, clearing the clinical, social, and logistical barriers that usually get in the way. The TOC Behavioral Health team does this work for members leaving a behavioral health level of care — a group that too often loses access because of limited community resources or barriers tied to their own behavioral health needs.

As a TOC Behavioral Health Care Coordinator, you're the person who makes sure they don't fall through. You'll connect members to in-network community providers, book the appointment, and follow through until care actually starts.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Serving as the team's "care traffic controller" — working with members and the interdisciplinary team to track clinical needs to resolution, from locating in-network behavioral health services to scheduling appointments

  • Handling telephonic outreach and support with members and provider offices, meeting every call with patience and genuine regard for the person on the other end

  • Building and maintaining relationships with community behavioral health partners, confirming in-network availability and engaging services on members' behalf

  • Providing ongoing administrative and outreach support as members transition from the hospital to longer-term care in their community

  • Preparing for and actively contributing to weekly Interdisciplinary Team Meetings, flagging high-risk members, resource gaps, and next steps

  • Spotting process problems, proposing fixes, and partnering to implement them — we're still building this model, and your input shapes it

jobs.excerpt: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer, Web to the Engineering team.
jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Staff Software Engineer, Web to the Engineering team.

Why join Sprout’s Front-End Engineering team?

At Sprout, our method of working across teams is about combining our collective strengths and learning from each other. Joining our Engineering team means closely collaborating with cross-functional teams spanning web, mobile, backend and site reliability engineering teams as well as Product and Design teams in R&D and beyond. Our Engineering team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems alongside industry leaders. Our iterative approach ensures that our software solutions meet diverse customer needs. By joining our team, you'll play a pivotal role in driving upcoming transformative product enhancements.

What you’ll do

  • Write clean, performant, and maintainable code.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to other team members, including less experienced engineers.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend developers, designers, and product managers, to deliver world class customer experiences.
  • Participate in and conduct code reviews to maintain code quality, provide feedback, and ensure adherence to coding standards.
  • Continuously improve the codebase by identifying areas for refactoring and optimization to enhance maintainability and scalability.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a creative, highly motivated, and inquisitive learner to build great software with us.

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience with planning, building, and releasing web applications with frontend technologies (Angular or other major framework, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS)
  • Strong expertise in TypeScript
  • Fluency in agentic coding workflows (Claude Code/Codex/Cursor)
  • Communication, project management skills from collaborating with people across different teams and functional areas.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Experience building web applications with Angular, RxJS and/or similar web technologies.
  • Experience working as a full stack engineer.
  • Experience working with Node.js or Scala.
  • Experience working in a large codebase.
  • Experience building and/or maintaining an internal UI library.
  • Business, Product and user-oriented mindset.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout’s New Hire training program alongside other new Sprout team members.
  • Deliver business value by shipping your first code change with active pairing/mentoring from your teammates.
  • Learn how code is deployed to our end users through collaboration with front end developers on your team.
  • Have a firm understanding of the team’s roadmap and the team’s Agile processes by having discussions with your team’s manager.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Independently own and deliver the front end part of small to medium features without peer consultation
  • Adhere to the team’s engineering best practices, such as testing expectations, shared patterns, and documentation.
  • Openly communicate with all disciplines of the team, including back-end engineers, QA, product design and product managers, in order to move the team’s work forward.
  • Contribute to team processes by participating in team activities, such as code review, estimation, technical specification planning, collaboration in requirements definition, and contribution of feedback during retrospectives.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Author a technical specification plan for a roadmap project and collaborate with teammates to create an agreed upon delivery plan.
  • Mentor junior teammates to provide guidance and coaching on code implementation, design review, and other software engineering and Agile practices.
  • Understand how the team uses Angular and Typescript frameworks and be comfortable explaining relevant details to other engineers.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers to ensure that projects are delivered on time and with quality.
  • Understand the how we structure, build and deploy the apps and be comfortable explaining relevant details to other engineers.
  • Have knowledge of your team’s target customer base and their most common use cases within the application.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Have an understanding of all aspects of our web application, including every module, less common use cases and all the Personas within our user base.
  • Demonstrate end-to-end responsibility for delivering roadmap projects on time, from technical planning to performing/guiding implementation to testing to final delivery.
  • Balance the continuum of trade-offs during code design, knowing that solutions can favor faster delivery with less strict technical requirements or solutions can favor future technical maintainability with delayed delivery of customer value.
  • Identify a technical initiative (e.g. technical debt, introduction of a new system, need for a new JavaScript dependency, performance improvement, etc) for your team.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits ProgramWe’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product and culture. Our benefits program includes:

  • Stock Ownership (RSUs): Eligibility for Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 26 paid days off annually, in addition to bank holidays and extra company-wide "Rest & Recharge" days.
  • Paid Parental Leave: We support all growing families with 20 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents and 16 weeks of paid leave for non-birthing parents.
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA): An annual $600 USD fund to support your personal well-being. This can be used for gym memberships, health expenses, hobbies, or other wellness needs.
  • Remote & Hybrid Work Support: A flexible, remote-first model supported by a one-time $550 USD home office setup stipend and a monthly internet reimbursement.
  • Mental Health & Well-being: Access to dedicated mental health resources and company-wide wellness programs.
  • International Travel: Opportunities to travel to our Chicago HQ for team meetups and collaboration.
  • Kraków Office Perks: A daily 50 zł lunch stipend when you choose to work from our office.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: 29,400 - 36,750 monthly on a B2B contract. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth opportunities available as you progress in your role.

The full base pay range for this role is 29,400 - 44,100monthly on a B2B contract.

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

jobs.description:
This position offers the flexibility of being fully remote, but the selected candidate must be currently residing within the United States.

Many structural heart patients suffer from heart failure with limited options. Our Implantable Heart Failure Management (IHFM) team is at the forefront of addressing these unmet patient needs through pioneering technology that enables early, targeted therapeutic intervention. Our innovative solutions are not just transforming patient care but also creating a unique and exciting environment for our team members. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.

As a Senior Manager, Clinical Product Quality, you will be a member of Complaint Handling and Post Market Surveillance/Risk Management team to provide clinical guidance/clinical expert knowledge to Quality, Engineering and other cross functional teams to understand the nature of complaints and possible health risks. In this role you will ensure appropriate investigation of product complaints and adverse events, in order to escalate potential manufacturing, design, labeling and training issues. You will also follow standard practices and procedures in analyzing data, interpreting and drawing conclusions, with the objective of gathering key information and communicating to cross-functional teams who will utilize the information for improvement of product and procedural outcomes.

How you will make an impact:

  • Provides medical/clinical guidance to complaint investigators and engineers related to event interpretation, event investigation, proper coding, required regulatory reporting (Medical Device Reports, Medical Device Vigilance, etc.), and complaint closure. Author and/or review complaint conclusions/closure statements and customer letters. May assist with and help manage Imaging Reviews
  • Educates complaint investigators to understand nature of events and possible health risks
  • Interprets complaint data for complaint investigators, engineers, and other Quality department personnel
  • Authors clinically based product specific scripts to guide complaint investigators in appropriate investigational paths
  • Obtain and evaluate information from clinical specialists, sales staff, physicians, nurses and other hospital staff/customers, as needed to support complaint investigation and drive towards resolution
  • Provides training to complaint investigators on patient anatomy and medical conditions, and IHFM (Implantable Heart Failure Management) products and procedure
  • Provides complaint training to Sales, Marketing and other customer facing roles
  • Works with VP Product Safety and/or Director of Quality to maintain Decision Rationale Matrix to guide complaint investigators with reporting decisions.
  • Reviews complaint codes and FDA Medical Device Reports, reviews and assists with reporting decisions
  • Authors and/or reviews complaint conclusions/closure statements and customer letters
  • Analyzes and interprets complaint data for a specific product line, business unit, regulatory submissions, regulatory agency requests, and/or management report
  • Performs Complaint Trending Analyses and participates in Quality Metrics Review and Quality Data Review meetings where complaints are discussed
  • Communicates complaint data and relevant clinical information to internal customers in quality, manufacturing and new product development in support of complaint investigations
  • Participates in review of/provides clinical guidance for FMEAs (Failure Mode & Effects Analysis) and Risk Management Worksheets
  • Provides clinical input to Product Risk Assessments, and participate in Risk Management Councils and Quality Boards
  • Aid in response to Regulatory Agencies who inquire about complaint /Risk Management related issues

What you'll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree plus 10 years of relevant experience or equivalent work experience based on Edwards’ criteria
  • Registered Nurse (RN) - current state license active or expired
  • Cardiac patient care experience (e.g. cardiac care, ICU, OR, or cardiovascular interventions)
  • Medical device industry experience in Quality/Compliance, with a strong preference for complaint handling, complaint investigation, and/or post-market surveillance

What else we look for (Preferred):

  • RN with Cath Lab, CVOR, or CVICU nursing experience
  • Expert knowledge of the FDA’s Quality System Regulations; experience working within a Quality Management System. Strong working knowledge of Medical Device regulations, such as FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, CMDR, MDD 93/42/EEC, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in clinical product quality, complaint handling, post-market surveillance, risk management, escalation, field action or related quality processes.
  • Proven successful project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as Product Instructions for Use, Training and Procedure Manuals

jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

Our Environment & Culture

  • Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment.

  • Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.

Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in ourofficial blog and ourreliability practices.

About the Role

As a Sr. Software Engineer, Payments Quality, you will serve as a key technical practitioner and quality champion on our Payments Engineering team. You will take ownership of setting, building, and enforcing world-class quality standards across our core payment systems. In this role, you will write software for robust AI-assisted quality strategies covering end-to-end automated regression suites and high-concurrency performance and load testing.

Working closely with feature development engineers, Tech Leads, and Product Management, you will ensure our mission-critical, high-throughput payment platform and applications operate with zero downtime and flawless accuracy. Rather than relying on manual QA or traditional top-down testing scripts, you will leverage AI-native engineering methodologies and integrate test automation across the entire SDLC. You will also be building emulators for external systems, such as card networks and other partner integrations. We are looking for hands-on builders who refuse to settle for the status quo, hate manual friction, and take immense pride in fortifying enterprise-grade financial systems for scalability, reliability, and security.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and Embed Quality Benchmarks: Own the overarching quality strategy for Payments Acceptance, building automated guardrails so seamlessly into our pipelines that rigorous end-to-end validation happens automatically, without slowing down feature teams, accelerating release cycles.

  • Drive Performance & Stress Testing: Architect and execute high-concurrency load, stress, and latency testing to stress-test payment pipelines under extreme transaction volumes. You own the mission of ensuring our platform never drops transactions or degrades in latency during peak periods..

  • Pioneer AI-Native Software Engineering focused on Quality: Actively integrate AI-assisted developer tools and agentic workflows into test creation, synthetic data generation, and automated edge-case analysis to multiply testing velocity. Build high performance emulators for external systems.

  • Deep Observability & Incident Prevention: Implement robust telemetry and telemetry-driven test environments using tools like Prometheus and Grafana to monitor system behavior under load, driving blameless post-mortems and proactive bug prevention.

  • Cross-Functional Velocity & Mentorship: Partner with feature teams to build "Golden Paths" for automated testing, ensuring engineers can validate code rapidly with high confidence. Mentor team members on quality engineering best practices.

What You Bring

  • Ownership in Quality Engineering: 5+ years of software engineering experience focusing on quality engineering, test automation framework design, and performance testing for complex, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Automation & Scripting Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building automated test suites in Java, Python, Go, or TypeScript, with a strong command of REST API testing and microservices validation.

  • Performance & Load Testing Depth: Proven track record designing and running performance, stress, and load tests at scale using tools like JMeter, Locust, Gatling, or k6.

  • CI/CD & Cloud-Native Toolchains: Direct experience embedding automated quality gates into modern CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitOps) within containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) on public clouds (AWS).

  • Data & Messaging Validation: Experience testing event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS) and relational/NoSQL databases, ensuring data consistency and transactional integrity under load.

  • High-Agency Mindset: An innate drive to eliminate manual friction, proactively seek out edge cases, and acquire whatever missing domain context is needed to solve complex quality challenges end-to-end.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Domain expertise in 3DS, Network Tokens, Account Updater, or payment gateway integrations.

  • Experience with AI developer tools, LLM-generated test automation pipelines, or synthetic test data generation.

  • Practical knowledge of compliance and cloud security constraints (PCI-DSS, SOC2).

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Network Solutions, we’ve been trusted for decades to help people get online and stay ahead. We’ve been here since the beginning of the internet, and we’re still building for what comes next.

As the original digital identity authority, we help secure domain names, protect brands, and safeguard the infrastructure businesses rely on. We empower our customers to own and manage the assets that define them online, while delivering enterprise-grade security to protect against virtual threats. Our team leverages modern, AI-accelerated tools to streamline how businesses manage their digital presence, making the most of our decades of experience.

The Network Solutions team is here to help online businesses protect what’s theirs and build for tomorrow. That’s why millions trust us to protect their domains, brands, and websites every day.

The impact you’ll make

We are looking for a hands-on Senior DevOps Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure powering our AI platforms, agent runtimes, web applications, backend services, APIs, and shared platform capabilities. Our environment includes a centralized LLM gateway, Python-based agent runtimes, RAG workers, MCP services, asynchronous processing, databases, caches, queues, and observability services.

You will work with AI engineers, application engineers, and architects who define technical designs, then independently translate those designs into reliable, scalable, secure, and observable production infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

What you’ll do

  • Translate application and platform technical designs into production ready cloud infrastructure with minimal supervision.

  • Design, provision, operate, and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments, primarily Azure Kubernetes Service and Oracle Kubernetes Engine.

  • Support AI workloads including LiteLLM based gateways, Python agent runtimes, RAG workers, MCP services, background workers, and asynchronous processing pipelines.

  • Design and manage ingress and egress networking, load balancers, DNS, TLS, private connectivity, routing, NAT, firewalls, network policies, and service to service communication.

  • Build and operate infrastructure for web applications and backend services, including APIs, databases, caches, queues, scheduled jobs, and event driven workloads.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket, integrating Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, and container registries.

  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Python, Bash, and related tooling.

  • Implement end to end observability using metrics, logs, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and SLOs.

  • Own production readiness, incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, scalability, reliability, and infrastructure cost optimization.

  • Create reusable infrastructure patterns that allow engineering teams to launch new services quickly and consistently.

What we’re looking for

  • 7 or more years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or a related role.

  • Strong hands on experience operating production Kubernetes environments and deep knowledge of networking, scheduling, storage, autoscaling, security, and troubleshooting.

  • Strong Microsoft Azure experience, including AKS, networking, identity, storage, and monitoring. OCI experience is preferred, or demonstrated ability to work across cloud providers.

  • Strong cloud networking knowledge across virtual networks, subnets, routing, NAT, load balancers, private networking, DNS, TLS, firewalls, ingress, and egress.

  • Strong experience with Jenkins, Bitbucket, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Proven experience supporting production web applications and backend services, including REST APIs, microservices, background workers, and asynchronous architectures.

  • Hands on experience with databases, caching, and messaging systems such as PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience implementing production observability using OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, cloud monitoring, or similar tools.

  • Strong Linux, systems, and production troubleshooting skills.

Application engineering knowledge

You do not need to be a full time application developer, but you should understand how modern backend systems work and be able to troubleshoot across application and infrastructure boundaries.

  • Working knowledge of Python, especially backend services built with frameworks such as FastAPI.

  • Familiarity with at least one additional language such as C#, Java, Go, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

  • Understanding of HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, TCP/IP, proxies, authentication, APIs, connection pooling, caching, concurrency, queues, retries, dead letter queues, and asynchronous processing.

  • Ability to read application logs and stack traces and diagnose latency, memory, CPU, connection, and dependency issues.

How you’ll work

You will frequently receive a technical design for a new AI workload, application, backend service, or platform capability. From that design, you should be able to independently determine and implement the infrastructure needed to run it in production.

  • Determine the required cloud resources, Kubernetes configuration, namespaces, scaling model, and supporting services.

  • Configure ingress and egress, private connectivity, DNS, TLS, service communication, identities, and secrets.

  • Provision and operate dependencies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, storage, and other shared services.

  • Build the Jenkins and Bitbucket CI/CD flow for build, test, container publishing, deployment, validation, and rollback.

  • Define observability, health checks, dashboards, alerts, capacity monitoring, and operational runbooks before production launch.

  • Own infrastructure delivery through UAT and production, partnering with architects and engineers when design tradeoffs require discussion.

What will make you stand out

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Account Executive – Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote — Chile
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time (Contractor)
Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Influencer Marketing / Marketing Technology / Advertising
Compensation:$1,000 – $2,000 USD/month base + uncapped variable compensation (OTE approximately 50/50)
Experience: 2+ years
Languages: Native Spanish + Professional English
Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.

Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics. The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.

Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

About the Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion.

You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

What You'll Do

Build & Own Your Pipeline

  • Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG.

  • Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.

  • Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.

  • Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.

Run Full-Cycle Sales

  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.

  • Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.

  • Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.

  • Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.

Build an AI-Native Sales Process

  • Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.

  • Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.

Build the Commercial Playbook

  • Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.

  • Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.

  • Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.

  • Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.

  • Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business.

  • Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.

  • Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers.

  • Native Spanish.

  • Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.

  • Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel, including follow-up and deal progression.

  • Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands.

  • Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.

  • Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.

This Role Is NOT for You If...

  • You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.

  • You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.

  • You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.

  • You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:

  • Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.

  • Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.

  • Full-cycle closing experience.

  • Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.

  • Consultative selling and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.

  • You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.

  • Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.

  • New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.

  • Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.

  • Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Why Join Us?

  • Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.

  • Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.

  • Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy.

  • Build processes rather than simply inherit them.

  • Fully remote work across Latin America.

  • Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.

  • Occasional travel for important brand meetings.

Important Notes

  • This is a highly hands-on individual contributor sales role.

  • Candidates must have personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss previous quota performance and sales results with specific numbers.

  • Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate how they currently use AI and automation in their sales workflow.

  • This position requires significant ownership of pipeline generation, closing, and early account development.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

jobs.excerpt: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate.  We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life.
jobs.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform teams within the Platform Engineering organization. This is a high-impact, high-visibility leadership role responsible for the foundational systems that store, ingest, and evolve the data powering ZoomInfo's entire go-to-market product suite.

You will lead a team of senior engineers across two core areas:

  • GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable), spanning scaling, performance, operational reliability, and the change data capture (CDC) systems that capture and propagate data change events downstream.
  • ZoomInfo Data Platform — ZoomInfo's analytical data store (BigQuery), including the ingestion pipelines and onboarding systems that bring new data in and keep it flowing accurately and efficiently, and the processes that ensure customer data deletion requests are handled promptly and compliantly.

This role sits at the foundation of ZoomInfo's data infrastructure — the reliability, scale, and integrity of these systems directly determine how fast we can onboard new data and how confidently we can serve it to customers. You will manage senior technical talent directly, setting technical direction, unblocking hard problems, and holding a high bar for engineering excellence.

What You'll Do

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a team of senior engineers and tech leads across GTM Store and the ZoomInfo Data Platform.
  • Set the roadmap across both areas, balancing scaling and performance needs, new data onboarding velocity, compliance obligations, security and platform reliability.
  • Build a high-performance engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical rigor, and operational excellence for systems operating at large scale.
  • Manage senior technical individual contributors directly — setting expectations, providing technical guidance, and developing career growth paths for staff-level and senior engineers.
  • Serve as a trusted partner to the VP of Software Engineering, contributing to broader platform engineering strategy.
  • Establish clear prioritization frameworks to manage competing demands across scaling, new data onboarding, compliance, and reliability work.

GTM Store

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the GTM Store — ZoomInfo's core operational data store (BigTable) powering the go-to-market data product.
  • Drive scaling initiatives to keep pace with data growth and increasing query/read-write demands from downstream products.
  • Guide architecture decisions to improve performance, latency, and cost-efficiency at scale.
  • Establish and maintain operational best practices — monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and incident response — to ensure high availability.
  • Own the strategy and architecture for change data capture (CDC), ensuring data change events are captured, propagated, and consumed reliably by downstream systems, including the ZoomInfo Data Platform.
  • Guide the selection and evolution of CDC tooling and patterns to support real-time and near-real-time data change propagation at scale.
  • Ensure CDC systems maintain data consistency, ordering guarantees, and fault tolerance under high event volume.
  • Partner with Product and downstream engineering teams to understand data access patterns and evolve the store's schema, APIs, and change event streams accordingly.

ZoomInfo Data Platform

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the ZoomInfo Data Platform — the analytical data store (BigQuery) that consumes and serves data for downstream analytics and product use cases.
  • Own the architecture and roadmap for data ingestion pipelines, including those consuming CDC streams from the GTM Store, that bring new data sources into the platform.
  • Drive initiatives to ease and accelerate the onboarding of new data sources, reducing the engineering lift required to integrate each new dataset.
  • Establish standardized, repeatable ingestion patterns and tooling that shorten time-to-value for new data.
  • Ensure ingestion pipelines are reliable, observable, and scalable to handle growing data volume and variety.
  • Own the systems and processes that handle customer data deletion requests, ensuring they are executed accurately, promptly, and in compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and related regulations.
  • Partner with Legal/Compliance and Product to evolve data deletion workflows as privacy regulations and customer requirements change.
  • Build observability and auditability into deletion workflows to provide clear evidence of compliance.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements for scaling, new data onboarding, and compliance work that inform the platform roadmap.
  • Drive enablement programs — documentation and tooling — that help internal teams onboard new data sources faster and with less friction.
  • Represent the GTM Store and ZoomInfo Data Platform in strategic planning conversations and technology decisions with company-wide implications.

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in software/platform engineering or data engineering, with experience operating at a senior leadership level.
  • Experience directly managing senior technical talent — staff engineers, tech leads, or senior ICs — and holding a high technical bar.
  • Strong working knowledge of large-scale operational (e.g., BigTable) and analytical (e.g., BigQuery) data stores and distributed systems, including experience scaling data infrastructure to handle high volume and throughput.
  • Experience with data ingestion pipeline architecture and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Debezium, Kafka Connect, Kafka, or similar streaming/CDC tooling).
  • Experience with data privacy and compliance practices, including handling data deletion / right-to-be-forgotten requests under GDPR/CCPA.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance platform reliability and performance work against feature and onboarding velocity.
  • Proven cross-functional partnership skills with product and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data infrastructure, including BigTable and BigQuery.
  • Familiarity with event streaming platforms (Kafka) and workflow/pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, or similar).
  • Experience building self-service tooling that accelerates data onboarding for internal teams.

What Sets You Apart

  • You lead through people. Your strongest technical asset is your ability to hire, develop, and empower exceptional engineers — and then get out of their way.
  • You connect technology to business outcomes. You see infrastructure investments not as technical projects but as enablers of speed, trust, and better decisions across the company.
  • You are a systems thinker. You see the connections between platform architecture, team structure, process design, and stakeholder experience — and you optimize across all four.
  • You are decisive under ambiguity. Competing priorities, legacy systems, organizational change, and imperfect information don't paralyze you — they sharpen your focus.
  • You balance vision with pragmatism. You can articulate a bold multi-year direction and then break it into quarterly deliverables your team can execute with confidence.
  • You build bridges. Engineering, analytics, security, and business teams all see you as someone who understands their world and advocates for shared outcomes.

How We Work

  • Be Relentless. We outpace and outcompete. We are smart, clever, and resourceful in everything we do.
  • Be Entrepreneurs. We hustle, move fast, take ownership, and make decisions. We are accountable and resilient.
  • Be Experts. We understand our customers deeply and demand domain expertise from everyone.
  • Be Innovators. We innovate not just in product, but in how we operate — driving outcomes no one thought were possible.
  • Be a Team. We are one team, working together to win. We collaborate and lean in to help each other.

The architect owns the technology roadmap, architecture standards and design principles for Windows-based infrastructure across on-premises datacenters.

The architect acts as the technical authority for Windows Server and infrastructure-related technologies, translating business requirements into scalable, resilient and secure technology solutions while supporting the organization's digital transformation and hybrid cloud strategy.
